it.name: SnapEdit: Photo Editor AI
it.d:
SnapEdit is one of the best photo editing apps using AI with a mission to make your editing easy, smooth and fun.

Transform your photos like never before with SnapEdit, the ultimate photo editing app designed to effortlessly remove unwanted objects, enhance image quality, and create stunning visual masterpieces. Download SnapEdit now and unlock a world of possibilities for your photos!

KEY FEATURES:

ONE-TOUCH OBJECT REMOVAL: Say goodbye to photobombers, unwanted elements, or distracting objects in your pictures. With just a single touch, SnapEdit intelligently analyzes your photo and seamlessly removes any undesired elements, leaving behind a clean and polished image.

SUPER ERASE (PRO required): Specialized model designed to remove larger distractions. Makes them vanish in a flash, leaving your photos sleek, clean, and distraction-free.

IMAGE ENHANCEMENT: Elevate your photo quality with SnapEdit’s powerful image enhancement tools. Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, and more to bring out the hidden details and make your images truly captivating. Enhance colors, sharpen edges, and create a professional finish with ease.

AI Expand: Let you fix your limited framing in one tap. AI Expand will widen backgrounds, fill missing areas, or adjust photo sizes for social media. Create perfectly balanced images that look natural and complete every time.

VIDEO ENHANCER: Feel free to record your memories without worrying about blurry or low quality videos, SnapEdit will be the solution you are looking for to enhance videos in seconds.

SKY REPLACEMENT: The gloomy weather is just not what you want? Bring the best out of your picture with our sky replacement. Replace the gray, boring sky in your photo with a brand new sky. Choose from clear blue sky, sunny, sunset, storm and even fantasies skies.

BACKGROUND REMOVAL MADE EASY: Need to change the backdrop of your photo? No problem! SnapEdit offers a seamless background removal feature that allows you to isolate the main subject with incredible precision. Replace the background with a solid color, a custom image, or a transparent background for endless creative possibilities.

ARTISTIC FILTERS and ANIME EFFECTS: Unleash your artistic side with a wide range of filters and effects. Transform your photos into stunning works of art with a single tap. From vintage to modern, black and white to vibrant colors, SnapEdit offers a plethora of options to suit your unique style.

EASY-TO-USE: SnapEdit’s user-friendly interface ensures a seamless editing experience for both beginners and professionals. Effortlessly navigate through the app’s features, apply edits, and instantly preview changes. The intuitive design ensures that editing your photos becomes a breeze.

HIGH-QUALITY RESULTS: SnapEdit utilizes cutting-edge algorithms to deliver high-quality results without compromising on detail or resolution. Your edited photos will retain their clarity and sharpness, ensuring that every detail shines through.

SAVE AND SHARE WITH EASE: Once you’re satisfied with your masterpiece, save your edited photos in high resolution to your device’s gallery. Share your creations directly from the app to social media platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and more, and impress your friends and followers with your stunning imagery.

Unlock the true potential of your photos with SnapEdit. Download now and experience the power of one-touch object removal, image enhancement, background removal, and an array of artistic filters. Create captivating visuals that leave a lasting impression and showcase your unique vision. Get SnapEdit today and start transforming your photos like a pro!

it.name: Instagram
it.d:
Little moments lead to big friendships. Share yours on Instagram. 
— From Meta

Connect with friends, find other fans, and see what people around you are up to and into. Explore your interests and post what's going on, from your daily moments to life's highlights.

Share what you’re up to and into:
- Turn your life into a movie and discover short, entertaining videos on Instagram with Reels.
- Keep up with friends on the fly with Stories and Notes that disappear after 24 hours.
- Start group chats and share unfiltered moments with your Close Friends.
- Share memories from recent events or trips in Feed.
- Customize your posts with exclusive templates, music, stickers and filters.

Dive into your interests.
- Watch videos from your favorite creators and discover new content that’s personalized to your interests.
- Get inspired by photos and videos from new accounts in Explore.
- Discover brands and small businesses, and shop products that are relevant to your personal style.

Some Instagram features may not be available in your country or region.

it.name: Captions: AI Edits Your Video
it.d:
AI EDIT THAT EDITS LIKE A PROFESSIONAL VIDEO EDITOR

Built by Mirage™, Captions is an AI video generator and video editor that makes it easy to go from idea to ready-to-share content, no experience needed.

Get started by importing a video or generating engaging content from scratch using text to video. You can create an AI actor or upload a selfie to create a personal avatar, allowing you to produce polished footage of yourself without ever needing to record again. 

From there, skip the hours spent toggling and tweaking manual edits. Our AI video editor applies editorial discernment to cut scenes, overlay B-roll, and integrate sounds based on your video. Whether you polish your video with our AI edit feature or describe desired changes to our chat-based editor, Captions’ intuitive video maker makes it easy to bring your vision to life.


LET AI EDIT FOR YOU

- One-tap AI video editing: Transform raw footage into ready-to-post content instantly with curated effects and trending aesthetics.
- Edit like you text: Just describe your vision in plain language; our chat-based editor will apply effects, transitions, B-roll, and pacing per your direction.


CREATE A PERSONAL AI AVATAR

- AI Twin: Turn a single selfie into a high-quality video of yourself using our AI video generator.
- AI Actors: Generate talking videos with engaging AI avatars, giving you a digital on-brand spokesperson.
- Adjust looks: Change outfits, add objects, and switch backgrounds to feature the same AI avatar across unlimited videos.


 AI-POWERED EDITING TOOLS

- AI Denoise: Automatically remove background noise from talking videos.
- AI Zoom: Instantly add relevant zooms to your content.
- AI Scale: Quickly resize videos for whatever aspect ratio you need.
- AI Hashtags: Automatically generate video captions and hashtags.
- AI Teleprompter: Read directly from your script while recording in-app.
- Multiple AI models: Choose from 20+ models to generate music, sounds, and visuals.


CAPTIONS AND DUBBING

- AI Dubbing: Dub your content into 29 languages with just a tap of a button.
- AI Subtitles: Automatically generate accurate captions or subtitles in 91+ languages. You can choose specific fonts and colors too.

Captions, LLC (US) Developer

it.name: SCRL: Photo Collage Maker
it.d:
Some apps help you post. SCRL helps you create. From structured brand feeds to editorial-style storytelling, SCRL gives you the tools to shape how your social presence is perceived. Whether you're a professional content creator, an artist, or just love sharing your moments, SCRL offers everything you need to make your posts stand out.

• EXCEPTIONAL PHOTO COLLAGE MAKER
SCRL lets you create stunning photo collages with full control over layout, spacing, and visual balance. Move between freeform and structured layouts depending on your workflow - from simple grid collages to complex, layered compositions. SCRL gives you the precision to build exactly what you envision.

• TEMPLATES NO ONE ELSE HAS
A curated library of collage, carousel, and story templates designed in-house by our designers' team. Each one is hand-crafted with focus on composition, proportion, and visual rhythm, not just assembled from generic patterns. Regularly updated with new designs across different styles and use cases.

• PHOTO EDITOR BUILT INTO YOUR WORKFLOW
Adjust exposure, dial in color, apply filters, all without leaving the app. Edit, compose, and publish in one seamless flow. No switching, no quality lost in transit.

• INSTAGRAM CAROUSEL POSTS THAT FLOW
SCRL was designed for creators who think beyond a single post. Build seamless carousels with panoramic layouts, precise alignment, and transitions that flow from slide to slide.

• GRID LAYOUTS FOR A COHESIVE FEED
Multi-post grids that span several photos, giving your feed a structured, unified look. Your profile is a portfolio and SCRL helps it look like one.

• MORE THAN 10 PHOTOS IN ONE POST
Break the limitations of traditional posts & Instagram layouts. With SCRL, you can add more than 10 photos in a single post, providing more room for your creativity and storytelling. 

• FREEFORM CANVAS
Design your way with our freeform canvas. Zoom in and out to perfect every detail or get an overview of your entire project. Create a layout that’s uniquely yours. 

• STICKERS & OVERLAYS
A growing library of overlays and stickers to add texture, depth, and detail to any design. Whatever your style, you’ll find elements that complement your collages and carousels perfectly.

• DIRECT POSTING TO INSTAGRAM & TIKTOK
When it's ready, it goes live - exactly as designed. No exporting, no re-uploading.

• WHERE PROFESSIONAL CONTENT GETS MADE
From property listings to campaign launches, social media schedules to client pitches - SCRL handles the volume without sacrificing the craft.

• SCRL PREMIUM
Every template, every layout, every tool, plus features built for work that demands more. Monthly and yearly plans, starting with a free 7-day trial.

• TRUSTED BY THE BEST
SCRL is trusted by Grammy Award-winning artists, NBA players, and major international music festivals. We’ve been featured numerous times in the App Store and recognized by top industry publications:

"14 Best Apps For Instagram Collages" - Hootsuite
"20 Mobile Apps to Create Stunning Social Media Visuals" - HubSpot
"8 Trendy Apps To Create Collages For Instagram" - Later

TRIAL AND SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Start SCRL Premium Collage Maker with a free 7-day trial. Once the trial is over, you'll be charged an annual subscription fee. SCRL Premium will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 

You can go to your Settings > iTunes Account & App Store > Apple ID > Subscriptions to manage your subscription and turn auto-renew off. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.

Terms of Use: https://scrl.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://scrl.com/privacy-policy

Follow @scrlgallery on Instagram for inspiration from our community. Add #scrlgallery to your posts to get featured on our page. Questions or feedback? DM us at @scrlgallery.

Create unique photo collages, Instagram stories & carousel posts with SCRL. Browse hundreds of curated templates for every occasion.

it.name: Facetune: Photo & Video Editor
it.d:
Welcome to Facetune, where every photo hits.
Your camera captures the moment. Facetune makes it unforgettable. From quick touch-ups to full transformations, we've built the tools that let you show up exactly how you want.

Key Features:

Retouch & Refine:
* Smooth: Achieve a natural, flawless complexion by removing blemishes and imperfections instantly.
* Reshape: Subtly enhance your features with precise, natural-looking adjustments.
* Whiten: Brighten your smile and make your teeth look their best (works on sneakers too).

Style & Transform:
* Hairstyles: Try 20+ styles — from Sleek Bun to Butterfly Cut to Glam Blowout — without touching a single strand.
* Beard & Hair: Try on Stubble, Hipster, Goatee, Long Beard, and more with editing that actually looks real.
* Makeup: Apply virtual makeup for a full glam look with zero commitment.

Pro-Level Editing:
* Headshots: Turn any photo into a polished, professional headshot in seconds, powered by AI.
* Filters & Looks: Instantly set the mood with curated filters and one-tap presets.
* Remove & Vanish: Erase unwanted objects, backgrounds, or photobombers seamlessly.
* Lighting: Get studio-quality light in every shot with precision lighting tools.

Enhance & Polish:
* Enhance: Automatically upgrade your photo's quality with a single tap.
* Color Correction: Correct and elevate colors for a vibrant, polished finish.
* Video Editing: All your favorite tools to perfect your reels and short-form content.
‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿‿

Why Facetune?
Because you deserve photos that match the vision. Whether you're a creator, a professional, or someone who just wants to look good — Facetune gets it done. No experience needed, no excuses.

Download. Edit. Post. Repeat.

it.name: Picsart AI Photo Editor, Video
it.d:
Ignite your creative potential with Picsart — the all-in-one AI photo editor, AI video editor, and design studio that’s free and easy to use. From business designs to AI art, go from inspiration to creation fast. Create with an AI photo generator and AI video generator, edit with an AI image editor, remove backgrounds with Background Remover (BG remover), erase objects with Object Remover (Object Eraser), apply AI effects, filters, and retouch tools, and turn ideas into designs with templates, collages, story maker, and more. Create with new image-to-video tools, AI video avatars, AI try-on, AI avatars, Gen AI Studio, AI Playground, and Picsart Persona.

MEET PICSART AURA
Chat your vision into visuals. Built on Picsart’s platform and trusted by 150M+ creators, Aura is your creative partner. From prompt to design in seconds, Aura creates, edits, and refines in one conversation. It suggests prompts, generates AI photos and AI videos, remembers chats, and lets you share sessions.
Aura combines AI models to create and edit AI images and videos. Use Nano Banana™ for image generation and video models like Veo™ (Veo 3), Kling, Runway, and Luma. Availability may vary. Trademarks belong to their owners.

KICK-START PROJECTS WITH TEMPLATES
• Use customizable templates made by professional editors.
• Create logos with AI logo maker, social posts, stories, business cards, posters, and more.

TRANSFORM DESIGNS WITH BACKGROUND REMOVER
• Remove background for clean cutouts and product shots.
• Smart Background blends seamless backdrops — a fast background changer for ads and promos.
• Remove background, refine edges, and create aesthetic styles for photo editor projects.

REMOVE OBJECTS WITH EASE
• Object Remover / Object Eraser deletes unwanted objects. 
• Remove clutter and imperfections for a clean photo.

GET CREATIVE WITH AI
• AI Image Generator / AI photo generator: turn text into AI art, images, and GIFs.
• AI video generator: create videos from text, images, or ideas in seconds.
• AI Enhance instantly boosts image quality for better photo retouch. 
• Apply stylized AI filters and AI effects to create stunning photo effects in your photo editor workflow.
• AI Replace transforms images with face swaps, hair color changes, and selfie edits.
• AI Retouch perfects portraits with advanced skin, face, and detail enhancements for flawless retouch results.
• AI Expand extends images beyond the frame.
• AI Try-On lets you experiment with outfits and styles instantly.
• AI Writer creates captions, text, and marketing copy for your content needs.
• Upload selfies to generate customized AI avatar in different styles.
• Explore new ideas in AI Playground and create faster with Gen AI Studio.

EDIT VIDEOS LIKE A PRO
• Use the easy video editor to create and edit clips with music.
• Generate and edit videos with AI video tools, effects, text, and trendy filters.
• Turn images into motion with image-to-video tools.
• Create short-form edits that shine on any platform.
• Add your best moments to a video collage.

ADD YOUR FLAVOR WITH THE STICKER MAKER
• Discover 60M+ stickers.
• Add stickers to pictures or business promos.
• Create custom stickers.

TELL YOUR STORY IN TEXT
• Add text with the Picsart Text Editor.
• Discover hundreds of classic & trendy fonts.
• Customize text styles. 

CREATE COLLAGE MAGIC (COLLAGE MAKER)
• Create fun photo collages with your favorite photos.
• Try photo grid collage or freestyle collage for mood boards and frames.

DISCOVER ENDLESS INSPIRATION
From solopreneurs to graphic design enthusiasts, AI art pioneers, and photo editors — share your ideas and get inspiration for your next project with Picsart Spaces.

UPGRADE YOUR DESIGN EXPERIENCE
Picsart Plus: premium content, templates, and extra retouch features.
Picsart Pro: more AI tools, extra team seats for small businesses, and more storage space.

Terms and conditions: https://picsart.com/terms-of-use/
About Ads: https://picsart.com/privacy-policy#interest-base

All widgets support Liquid Glass dreamy style. Real-time weather Liquid Glass widget, Liquid Glass theme sets. Unlock your desktop's hidden beauty!

【Widgets】
Includes popular widgets such as Dynamic Panel, Photo Wall, Weather, Battery, Countdown, Calendar, X-Panel, Emoji Notes, Digital Clock, Ferris Wheel, Windmill, and Air Conditioner. It also offers creative lock screen styles like Emojis, Animations, and Icons, with support for transparent effects — making your phone both fun and practical.

【Couple Widgets】

【Interactive Widgets】
Quickly complete to-do check-ins or play games like Whack-a-Mole and Arcade without opening the app—adding fun to your daily routine.

【Themes & Wallpapers】
A vast collection of daily updated themes and wallpapers, including trending styles like Ins, minimalist, pink & black, AI art, and paper-cut designs. Easily elevate your home screen’s style and personalize your phone!

【Dynamic Island】
We offers a variety of fun features, such as Pet Island, Plant Island, Animation Island, Weather Island, Panel Island, Calendar Island, Signature Island, Launcher Island, Timer Island, and more. it.name: TikTok - Videos, Shop & LIVE
it.d:
TikTok is the global discovery platform for videos, streaming on LIVE, shopping, and more. Our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. Over a billion people come to TikTok to share what they love, learn new things, and find ideas that make everyday life more interesting.

Your experience on TikTok is built around what you're into, not who you know. Just watch, like, and scroll to discover videos, creators, and communities you are delighted to discover. From quick recipes to game highlights, fashion tips to music and trending sounds, your For You feed reflects your current interests and changes based on what surprises and inspires you.

Creating is simple. Capture and post everyday moments and turn them into something special with easy editing tools, effects, sounds, and music. Use our free library of sounds and music in your videos, plus filters and creative tools that help your content stand out. On TikTok, anyone can create, and ideas that inspire pick up momentum.

TikTok is also where discovery becomes part of your everyday life. Find creators to follow, new ideas to try, and products you will love from small businesses and brands around the world. TikTok offers more than 50 preset safety and privacy features, from private accounts and content filters to screen time tools and Family Pairing, so you can choose an experience that works for you. TikTok provides extra support for teens and families on the app, letting you set time and content preferences that feel right for your family. 

■ Personalized discovery
A For You feed that learns what you enjoy. Discover videos, creators, LIVE streams, shopping, and communities based on what you watch, like, and share.
■ Entertainment, learning, and everything in between
Comedy, gaming, DIY, beauty, sports, music, lifestyle, education, and more. Find content that makes you laugh, think, and try something new.
■ Simple, powerful creation tools
Record in clips, pause and resume, trim and merge, add text and stickers, and fine tune your video without leaving the app.
■ Sounds, music, and effects
Use our free library of sounds and music in your videos, plus filters, effects, and creative tools that help you express yourself and make your videos stand out.
■ A global community of creators
Follow your favorite creators and discover new voices every day. Share your own story or support the people who inspire you.
■ Discover and shop with TikTok Shop
Explore trending products, exclusive deals, and seamless shopping experiences inspired by creators and brands you love, all in one place. Shop directly from videos, LIVE, and the Shop tab, track your orders, and enjoy a safe, secure shopping experience.
■ Go LIVE and connect in real time
Start a LIVE to chat with your community, share moments as they happen, and unlock special features and benefits where available.
■ Tools to shape your experience
Use more than 50 safety and privacy features, from private accounts and content filters to screen time tools, Family Pairing, and other controls, to choose how TikTok works for you and your family.

Ready to see what you discover next? Download TikTok to start watching, creating, and exploring your world in a new way.

Note: If you subscribe via Apple, payment will be charged to App Store Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the selected plan. Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase.

Learn more about our safety tools, resources, and policies at the TikTok Safety Center: https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en

it.name: Mojo: AI Video & Reels Editor
it.d:
Creating trending social content has never been simpler. Mojo is an app designed to help you make amazing video content for Instagram and TikTok and more. Mojo is made in Paris and has already been downloaded by over 40 million people worldwide.

To use Mojo, simply download the app and start exploring one of our 1,200+ unique templates. After selecting the template you’d like to edit, choose from a number of our editing features to create the perfect video. You can then easily resize and share your content to any social platform with the touch of a button.

While editing, you can choose from a number of our top features like adding auto-captions, text effects, filters, and creating a grid. You can also select one of our trending templates which is already paired perfectly with a trending sound from Instagram and TikTok!

Mojo is an inclusive app made for everyone. Whether you’re a creator, small business owner, photographer, or a first-time social user - there will be something for you! 

Take a look at our top features and why our users love them:

Trending sounds templates

- Choose from our unique trending sounds templates that connect directly to trending sounds on Instagram and TikTok
- Get inspired in our trending sounds collection and create videos with already identified trends

Auto captions

- Add auto-captions to maximize your views
- Select from a variety of auto-caption styles to stand out on social
- Translate your captions into a different language than the one you’re speaking
- Remove unwanted silences and filler words automatically

Text effects

- Easily add aesthetic text effects to your videos
- Select from a variety of styles like modern, retro, speech bubbles, and calls to action

All-in-one video editor

- Edit all of your videos on one platform
- Trim your clips, add transitions, music, text, and animated elements on Mojo

Background removal

- Remove the background from any image in one tap
- The perfect tool for business owners to showcase their products

Brand kit

- Upload your brand fonts, colors, and logos to the brand kit tool
- Easily stay on brand while creating your content on Mojo

AI templates

- Transform your content with one of our AI templates by selecting a photo and watching our AI tools illustrate it into a work of art
- Select any photo from your camera roll and watch Mojo turn it into a meme

Royalty free music

- Choose from our royalty-free tracks that can be used for commercial purposes
- Upload your own music and add it to any of our templates

Transitions

- Seamlessly add transitions to your videos to elevate visual appeal
- Elevate professionalism with a variety of available transitions like zoom in, fisheye, ripped paper, camera slides in different directions, and so many more
- Apply your transitions to your whole video in just one tap

Share across all social platforms

- Share to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other social platforms in just one tap
- Mojo easily resizes your content depending on the platform you’re sharing to

Edit the animations of all elements

- Animate any element of your video and capture your viewer’s attention

Animated stickers and graphics

- Incorporate animated stickers and graphics into your videos

Terms of Use: https://www.mojo-app.com/terms-of-use

If you subscribe via Apple, your payment will be charged to the App Store Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the selected plan. Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings on your iPhone after purchase.

We're always open to feedback, email us yours at feedback@mojo.video.

From Paris with love,

The Mojo Team

it.name: KineMaster - AI Video Editor
it.d:
No editing skills needed — just tap and go viral.

[ AI Tools for Your Next Video ]
Turn your clips and photos into awesome videos faster with KineMaster’s built-in AI tools! Create captions, generate voices, remove backgrounds, add incredible visual effects, and more!

• AI Auto Captions: Add subtitles instantly from video or audio
• AI Text-to-Speech: Create spoken audio from text with one tap
• AI Voice: Make your audio unique with AI Voices
• AI Music Match: Get song recommendations fast
• AI Magic Removal: Cut out the background around people and faces
• AI Noise Removal: Zap distracting sounds in your video or audio
• AI Vocal Separator: Split a song into vocals and music
• AI Tracking: Make your text and stickers follow moving objects
• AI Upscaling: Boost the resolution of low-resolution media
• AI Style: Add artistic effects to your videos and images
• AI Templates: Get a template recommended for your next awesome video!

[ Professional Video Editing for Everyone ]
KineMaster makes advanced tools easy to use.

• Keyframe Animation: Adjust the size, position, and rotation of every layer
• Chroma Key (Green Screen): Remove backgrounds and combine videos like the pros
• Speed Control: Reverse, slow down, or turn your videos into time-lapse masterpieces

[ Jumpstart Your Creativity ]
Pick a template, replace its photos and videos, and you’re done!

• Thousands of Templates: Build your own from pre-made video projects
• Mix: Save your video project as a template to share with KineMaster editors everywhere
• KineCloud: Back up personal projects to the cloud to continue editing on another day or another device

[ Make Your Video Stand Out with Assets ]
The KineMaster Asset Store has tens of thousands of resources to make your next video amazing! Effects, stickers, music, fonts, transitions, and VFX: everything is ready to use.

• Effects & Transitions: Enhance your videos with amazing visuals
• Stickers & Clip Graphics: Add graphic animations and design elements
• Music & SFX: Make a video that sounds as good as it looks
• Stock Videos & Images: Get pre-made green screen effects, free stock footage, and tons of video backgrounds
• Variety of Fonts: Apply design-ready stylish fonts
• Color Filters: Choose from a huge variety of color filters for the perfect look

[ High-Quality Output or Optimized Video: You Decide ]
Save your edited videos in high resolution or dial the quality to make them load fast on social media.

Incredible 4K 60 FPS: Produce videos in 4K and 60 frames per second

Optimized for Social Media Sharing: Save videos that are ready to upload to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and more

Transparent Background Support: Make videos ready for compositing for use with other videos

[ The Best Tools for Fast, Precise Editing ]
KineMaster is loaded with tools that make editing fun and easy.

• Offers both portrait and landscape editing, the best of both worlds
• Lots of layers: Add and stack photos, videos, and GIFs to all play at once
• Tablet/Chromebook Support: Provides an editing environment optimized for wide screens
• Multiple Undo (and Redo): Revert or reapply your editing history
• Magnetic Guides: Align elements to guides and snap layers in place on the timeline
• Full-Screen Previews: See your edits full screen before saving
• Multi-Selection: Save time by selecting and aligning, duplicating, or repositioning more than one video project layer at a time

• AI Cutout Tool. Automatically remove backgrounds from photos with one tap. Easily layer people, objects, or products over textured backdrops and collage elements.

Whether you're sharing a photo dump, promoting a product, or just curating your visual world. Crsel helps you craft posts that flow!

- Instagram creators & influencers
- Lifestyle bloggers & photographers
- Brands & small businesses
- Anyone building a curated feed or portfolio
- Aspiring Creators

it.name: ProCCD - Digital Film Camera
it.d:
ProCCD is an analog digital film camera application & carousel collage maker. We have reproduced the classic appearance of digital cameras and vintage film & digital camera-inspired retro filter effects. We also create Instagram carousel posts, stories, photo & video collage templates.

#40+ Vintage Film Camera, Digital Camera & VHS Camcorder
2000S & 2014: A tribute to old button phone, featuring 2000s lofi style that adds a Y2K aesthetic to everyday moments.
INST E & INST W: Instant cameras that simulate instant camera filters along with stunning photo papers.
Booth: A vintage photo booth in your pocket that supports single shots and four-shot sequences.
MG330: Retro VHS camcorders that transport you back to the year 1980.
F100: Inspired by the classic negative film filter, the camera edits using RAW files with zero sharpening.
BIGSHOT: An instant camera with vintage pack film, restoring the pulling and peeling process.
ZR1500: A disposable camera ideal for capturing everyday moments and landscapes.
Z50 & A620: Digital camera filters with a dreamy glow effect.
New vintage cameras are added continuously!

#Seamless Carousel & Photo Collage Maker for Instagram & Tiktok
- Create swipeable, panoramic carousel posts, layouts and collages to elevate your Instagram feed.
- Add video, live photos and images to the collage.
- Explore a wide array of photo collage templates for Instagram Stories, Posts and Reels—from instant style and scrapbook styles to minimalist layouts.
- Access 600+ hand-picked stickers and frames, plus 100+ exclusive fonts to personalize your content.
- Easy design tools: remove backgrounds, apply film filters, and use a freeform canvas to combine 30+ photos in one post—break free from traditional layouts.

#Aesthetic Photo Editor & Video Editor
- Supports importing photos & video for editing with oldroll camera filters.
- Effects & Overlays: Vintage photo effects & video effects including glitter, fish eye, light leak, VCR frame, etc.
- Collages & Templates: 100+ templates & layouts to make it easy to create Instagram stories.
- Powerful Editing Tools: Adjust exposure, saturation, film grain, vignette, blur, glow, dispersion and white balance to get a film look.
- Beauty Editor: Beauty function is available for capturing & editing.
- Crop & geometry: Rotate, crop, and resize your files.
- Supports batch editing.
- Supports conversion between video and live photos.

#Profesional Pro Camera:
- Preview effects in real-time through the viewfinder; what you see is what you get.
- Adjustable ISO, shutter speed, exposure, white balance, and more.
- Flash and self-timer functionalities.
- Multiple aspect ratios and configurable resolution options.
- Support for all lens types (ultra-wide, wide, telephoto).
- Various date stamps available.
Stay tuned for more advanced features and new camera releases coming soon!

Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.

it.name: Lightroom Photo Editor & Video
it.d:
Adobe Lightroom is a free AI photo and video editor that helps your content show what makes a moment feel special. From your dog’s goofy grin to that sunset that took your breath away, Adobe Lightroom makes it simple to bring those moments to life, just the way you see them.

Whether you’re snapping pics on the go or curating your social feed, Lightroom puts powerful AI photo editor tools in your pocket to help you create photos you’re proud to share.

Now introducing Generative Expand. Never lose a shot due to the wrong framing. As AI expands, the results are always authentic, meant to enhance your photo, not change it.

AI PHOTO EDITOR THAT EASILY MAKES YOUR PHOTOS LOOK AMAZING
Adobe Lightroom’s one-tap features like Quick Actions, Adaptive Presets let you retouch and enhance photo quality in seconds. These AI photo editor tools suggest the best edits for your images. Perfect for quick photo fixes look better in your selfies and profile photos.

REMOVE DISTRACTIONS AND BLUR BACKGROUND
Adobe Lightroom gives you professional photo editing tools that are easy to use. Blur the photo background for a polished look, adjust finer details, or use AI Generative Remove as an object eraser in photos.

POWERFUL EDITS WITH ZERO HASSLE
Use photo lighting tools to tweak exposure, highlights, and shadows. Fix photos with presets, photo effects, color grading, hue, saturation, or add a blurry bokeh effect to match your vibe.

GET INSPIRATION FROM THE COMMUNITY
Browse photo filters, templates, and presets shared by creators around the world. From vintage film photo effects to retro photo filters and presets to match your aesthetic kick off your edits in a tap. Whether you’re looking to make bold edits with AI expand and photo editor tools or subtle tweaks for polished portrait edits, find a look that matches your style.

EDIT ONCE, APPLY EVERYWHERE
Snapped a whole concert, travel day, or family gathering? Instead of editing each shot one by one, make quick edits with AI photo editor tools. Fix photos in batches with photo editor tools to keep your photo edits looking consistent.

WHY ADOBE LIGHTROOM?
 • It’s for every moment: whether editing photos for fun, capturing memories, gaining confidence, or sharing on social media.
• It’s flexible: Edit photos and grow into a better photographer along the way. Fix photos, crop and resize images, blur background elements, or remove distractions with our object eraser — the editing options are endless with Adobe Lightroom.
• It’s an AI photo editor designed to help build confidence, spark creativity, and showcase your authentic style.

PHOTO EDITOR TOOLS YOU'LL LOVE
• Quick Actions: Fix photos with suggested edits tailored to your pics.
• Preset Edits: Discover film filters or make your own signature look.
• Background Blur: Create depth with a blurry background effortlessly.
• Generative Remove Edits: Take out the things you didn’t want with this AI photo eraser.
• Video Editing: Bring the same creative energy to your clips with tools for light, color, and presets.
• NEW AI Expand with Generative Expand: Extend your photo’s edges to fit any size, readjust your shot, and fill in what’s missing.

FOR EVERY KIND OF PHOTOGRAPHER
Lightroom is here to empower you - to capture sunsets, family moments, or your latest foodie find. With tools to fix pictures, enhance photo quality, and edit videos, Adobe Lightroom gives you the right balance of ease and control.

Download Adobe Lightroom today.

it.name: Bazaart AI Photo Editor Design
it.d:
Bazaart is an easy-to-use AI photo editor, video editor, and design app. No design background needed. Create fast for online selling, digital marketing, and social media. Get your design superpowers today!

What you can make

For your business:
Product photos, model shots, home listings, profile pics, logos, flyers, ads, posters.

For your social media:
Reels, TikTok videos, stories, posts, slideshows, thumbnails, stop motion videos.

For your everyday life: 
Collages, cards, invitations, memes, WhatsApp stickers, backgrounds, wallpapers, GIFs, works of art.

AI tools
• Edit with AI: change or replace anything in a photo with simple prompts
• Remove background: background remover for photos and videos
• Remove: remove objects and people from any photo
• AI models: create on-model product shots
• AI video: turn product photos into videos
• Magic Background: create on-brand, AI-generated scenes for products and portraits
• AI Image: turn text prompts into images
• AI Restyle: restyle photos in one tap (from product try-ons to creative looks)
• Magic Edit: select an area and replace it using a prompt
• Enhance: improve photo quality in a tap
• Expand: extend your photos to any size
• Lift: cut the subject from the background, move and resize it

Photo and video editing tools
• Cut out with crop, scissors, eraser, and shape cut-out
• Adjust exposure, contrast, saturation, vibrance, warmth, tint, shadows, highlights, fade, sharpness, and blur
• Make elements stand out with outlines and shadows
• Combine photos and videos with blending modes
• Batch edit to speed through multiple photos
• Blur background of any photo for a portrait look

Design tools
• Create in custom sizes and popular presets
• Sketch and draw freely
• Curve text on arcs and circles
• Style text with quick presets
• Fine-tune text alignment, letter spacing, and line spacing
• Auto-snapping for perfect alignment
• Nudge tool for precise positioning
• Work with layers; every change is reversible
• Organize projects into folders
• Save projects to the cloud to keep them in sync

Content that speeds you up
• Beautiful templates made by designers
• Thousands of backgrounds, graphics, shapes, and animated graphics
• Photo and video effects
• Large font library, plus add your own
• Use photos and videos from albums, camera, files, or stock

Export and share
• Save images as JPG or PNG with transparency
• Save videos or animated GIFs
• Save as PDF
• Share anywhere

Upgrade your design experience

Bazaart Premium
Unlock AI tools and content, higher AI usage, save without watermark, VIP support.

Bazaart Super (perfect for small businesses)
Everything in Premium, 4x more AI usage, unlock AI video.

Terms of Service: https://www.bazaart.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.bazaart.com/terms/#privacy

Need help? Email support@bazaart.com and we’ll get back to you quickly.

BAZAART is a registered trademark of Bazaart Ltd.

it.name: Infuse
it.d:
Ignite your video content with Infuse – the beautiful way to watch almost any video format on your iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, Mac, and Vision. No need to convert files! Infuse is optimized for iOS 27, with powerful streaming options, Trakt sync, and unmatched AirPlay & subtitle support. Gorgeous interface. Precise controls. And silky-smooth playback.

- PLAY MORE VIDEO TYPES
A powerful video player that plays just about anything, including MP4, MKV, M4V and MOV – plus many others. Includes support for HDR, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, plus Dolby and DTS audio.

- STREAM FROM OTHER DEVICES
Browse and play videos stored on your Mac, PC, NAS, Wi-Fi hard drive, apps like Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin, or from cloud services like Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, Box, pCloud, Yandex.Disk, MEGA, Aliyun Drive, and others – no syncing required!

- AIRPLAY & GOOGLE CAST OPTIONS
Stream a wide variety of videos types such as MKV, MP4, M4V, and others over AirPlay & Google Cast with full surround sound and subtitles.

- TRAKT 2-WAY SYNC
Connect with Trakt to sync watched history, submit ratings and post comments.

- OPTIMIZED SUBTITLES POWERED BY OPENSUBTITLES
Bring your own subtitles, or download them on the fly (for free) in virtually any language.

===== 

“Looks great, plays anything you throw at it...surprisingly powerful”
- Lifehacker

“The best media player for iPhone and iPad...superior to VLC.”
- Cult of Mac

“I can't give the UI high enough praise. It's great.”
- 9to5Mac

“I see no reason whatsoever to remove Infuse from my Home screen anytime soon.”
- iDownloadBlog 

“A beautiful UI.”
- Trakt co-founder

“A mini Kodi!”
- Infuse user

=====

MORE THAN JUST A PRETTY FACE

THE BASICS
- Silky-smooth video player (plays full 4K w/ HDR & Dolby Vision)
- Stream from a Mac, PC, NAS or Wi-Fi enabled hard drive
- Connect with Plex, Emby, Jellyfin, Kodi (XBMC), WMC and other media servers
- Beautiful layout with quick access to video info
- Artwork and metadata added automatically
- Split View & PIP
- Spatial audio

SUPPORTED FORMATS
- Video: 33GP, AVI, AV1, ASF, BDMV, DIVX, DVDMEDIA, DVR-MS, FLV, H.264 (AVC), H.265 (HEVC), ISO/IMG, M4V, MKV, MOV, MP4, MPEG, MTS/M2TS, MXF, OGM, OGV, RMVB, TS, VC1, VIDEO_TS, VOB, VP9, WEBM, WMV, WTV
- Audio: AAC, AC3/E-AC3, DOLBY TRUEHD, DTS, DTS-HD MA, FLAC, MP3, OGG, PCM, WMA
- Subtitles: DVB, DVDSUB, MICRODVD, MPL2, PGS, SMI, SSA/ASS, SRT, SUB, SUP, TIMED TEXT, TXT, VOBSUB, VTT, XSUB

PLAYER FEATURES
- Multiple audio tracks
- Chapters
- Gesture controls
- 8 video zoom options
- Continuous playback
- TV out via HDMI or VGA adapter
- Deinterlacing

EXTRAS
- Folders
- One-click subtitle downloads from OpenSubtitles
- Scrobble plays to Trakt
- Download videos from networked devices
- Drag and drop uploads via web browser
- Get extra onboard storage with SanDisk iXpand and other USB drives

GET MORE WITH INFUSE PRO!
- Play even more video formats
- Stream video trailers for movies and TV shows
- Enjoy high-resolution Dolby® and DTS® audio
- Access videos stored in cloud services like Dropbox, Google Drive, Box, OneDrive, pCloud, Yandex.Disk, MEGA, Aliyun Drive, and more
- Stream a wide variety of video types over AirPlay and Google Cast
- Sync libraries, settings, watched history, and playback progress between devices

====

Note: DRM-protected movies & TV shows purchased from the iTunes store are not supported.

Metadata and artwork provided by TMDB, which is a community maintained movie and TV show database.

====

Infuse Pro is available as a optional subscription, and includes a free trial period that begins once your purchase has been confirmed with your iTunes Account. When the trial period concludes, your subscription will start and renew automatically. Your iTunes Account will be charged for the upcoming period unless you disable auto-renew or cancel your subscription in your Account Settings at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Visit firecore.com/terms-privacy for full terms and privacy policy.

it.name: Adobe Premiere AI Video Editor
it.d:
Adobe Premiere mobile brings you effortless video editing with total control. Meet the fast, free, and focused AI video editor that's powerful enough for any idea, yet simple enough for anyone to use. Enjoy a video editor without ads or watermarks for quick and seamless content creation. Get unmatched speed on a precise multi-track timeline, and studio-quality audio with crystal clear voice recordings. 

Create stand out video edits to share on TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and Facebook, and level up your content with AI video editing tools. Kickstart your project with images, sound effects, stickers, and videos from Adobe’s massive library of free creative assets, or create your own with our AI video generator. Get inspired with exclusive templates for YouTube Shorts, record voiceovers, and speed up your editing with auto captions.

Capture the moment and create trends with the Adobe Premiere all-in-one video editor.

ADOBE PREMIERE VIDEO EDITOR FEATURES:

LIGHTNING-FAST VIDEO EDITING TIMELINE
• Frame-Accurate Edits: Trim, split, crop, or merge clips in seconds.
• Auto Captions: Generate captions instantly with AI speech-to-text.
• Smooth Speed Effects: speed up, slow down, reverse or freeze key moments.
• Unique Color Presets: Apply Lightroom presets and fine tune to fit your aesthetic.
• Instant AI Background Removal: Cut out subjects in a tap. Create overlays and title effects.

EDIT VIDEOS WITH PRECISION CONTROL
• Video Editor with Unlimited Tracks: Overlay clips and organize your timeline with no limits to your creativity.
• Post to Any Platform: Resize videos to fit any aspect ratio and share anywhere easily.
• Advanced Clip Controls: Flip, fit, fill, or extract audio from video clips.
• Keyframes: Animate elements with total control.
• Video Effects & Transitions: edit videos with trending effects like glitch, blur, wipe and more.

GENERATIVE AI VIDEO EDITING TOOLS
• Text to Image AI Video Generator: Generate videos and images using Firefly AI and top third-party AI models from Google, ChatGPT, and more.
• AI Background Expansion: Extend, enhance, or replace backgrounds instantly.
• AI Enhance Audio: Create studio quality voiceovers with AI.
• Generate Sound Effects: Use your voice to create unique sounds.

EXPLORE  VIDEO TEMPLATES
• Get going with quality images, sounds, and videos from the Adobe library.
• Exclusive YouTube Shorts Templates: Get inspired with our library of free video templates to create the perfect post.
• Video Filters: add cinematic film filters or adjust video brightness, contrast, and more to match your aesthetic.
• Edit Videos with Music: Select from free and royalty free tracks.
• Fonts for Any Style: Match your creative vision with free Adobe Fonts.

SPEED AND PERFORMANCE
• Get a video editor built natively on iOS for fast and smooth video editing.
• Import assets from your device or favorite cloud storage provider.
• Focus on video editing without pop-up ads or watermarks.
• Export videos in 4k for free.
• Respects Creator Content Ownership: Adobe never trains on user content.

FREE TO DOWNLOAD AND USE
• Everything you need to edit videos is available for free. Only pay when you need Firefly generative AI credits.

TERMS & CONDITIONS:
Your use of this application is governed by the Adobe General Terms of Use http://www.adobe.com/go/terms_linkfree_en and the Adobe Privacy Policy http://www.adobe.com/go/privacy_policy_linkfree_en.

Do not sell or share my personal information: www.adobe.com/go/ca-rights-linkfree

it.name: VN: Photo & Video Editor
it.d:
VN: Professional Video and Photo Editing—Free with No Watermark. Edit like a pro with an intuitive multi-track timeline, beat-synced templates, and powerful creative tools. Whether you're a beginner or a professional, VN helps you create high-quality videos and photos with ease.

[Smart Tools]
• Auto Captions. Automatically generate subtitles from audio—supports multiple languages, subtitle templates, and animated text styles—and intelligently detect and remove filler words and silent segments for tighter, faster talking-head edits.
• Text-to-Speech. Generate voiceovers for your videos without recording.
• Video/Photo Cutout. Remove backgrounds from videos and photos in one tap.
• Smooth Slow Motion. Frame interpolation for fluid slow-mo—even when slowing down standard frame rate footage.

[Video Editing]
• Trim & Merge. Cut clips with frame-accurate precision (0.05s) and merge them into a seamless timeline—with up to 30x zoom.
• Overlay. Add overlay videos, photos, stickers, and text on a multi-layer timeline.
• Masks. Apply masks to layers for precise, creative compositions.
• Reverse, Zoom & Freeze Frame. Play clips backward, add zoom motion, or freeze key moments.
• Add Text & Stickers. Customize text and stickers with keyframe animation.
• Music & Voice-over. Add music, sound effects, and record voice-overs directly in the app.
• Speed Control. Speed up or slow down clips with presets or advanced curve-based speed ramps.
• Keyframe Editing. Add custom keyframe animations with 19 built-in effects and adjustable curves.
• Beat Editing. Add markers to sync your clips with music beats.
• Non-destructive Editing. Save drafts anytime with full undo/redo support.

[Filters, Effects & Transitions]
• Cinematic Filters & LUTs. Apply built-in filters or import LUTs for a professional look.
• Transitions & Effects. Smooth transitions and diverse visual effects for polished edits.

[Quick Create]
• BeatsClip. Generate beat-synced templates from your video or music—use them in the template or with AutoCut.
• AutoCut. Turn your footage into a finished edit automatically—select a BeatsClip template and sync clips to the beat.
• Story. Organize clips along a storyline first, then generate your video.
• Teleprompter. Read your script while recording talking-head videos—stay on track and never lose your flow.

[Templates]
• Custom Templates. Create your own templates and reuse them across projects to keep a consistent style and edit faster.
• Platform Templates. A rich library for every scenario—talking videos, Instagram Reels, Instagram Stories, Posts, YouTube videos, TikTok covers, YouTube thumbnails, festivals, business, and more.

[Photo Editing]
• Add text and stickers to photos, make fun story.
• Add filters and adjust brightness, contrast, etc.

[Photo Collage]
• Photo Collage Maker. Stitch multiple photos with rich layouts—cutout support for easy, personalized collages.
• Customize Collages. Add backgrounds, filters, Overlay, text, and stickers to create polished collages.

[Import & Assets]
• Easy Import. Add media via AirDrop, Wi-Fi, WhatsApp, Telegram, or Zip.
• Asset Library. Access stickers, fonts, filters, LUTs, and more.

[Share]
• High-Quality Export. Export up to 4K resolution at 60fps.
• HDR Editing. Support Dolby Vision HDR (iPhone 12+).
• Cross-Platform. Transfer projects via AirDrop or iCloud.
• Secure Mode. Protect drafts with passwords and expiration dates.
• Share to Social Apps. Share to YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, and more.

it.name: LUT Studio: Color Grading App
it.d:
LUT Studio - Cinematic Video LUTs & Film Look Editor
Transform your footage with cinematic color grading using LUT Studio - the ultimate video color correction and editing app for creators, filmmakers, and mobile videographers. With just a few taps, you can apply beautiful, professional-grade video filters and give your videos a stunning film look. Whether you're shooting vlogs, short films, or social media clips, LUT Studio brings the power of DaVinci Resolve - style color correction to your phone.

Cinematic color grading made it easy.
Import your clip, browse through our 90+ built-in LUTs, and instantly apply rich, moody, or vibrant tones. Our filters are optimized to match the color of a wide variety of footage styles. Whether you're aiming for a bold look or subtle enhancement, cinematic camera effects are now mobile.

LOG profile support
Take complete control over your dynamic range with support for major flat color profiles, including:
• Apple Log
• DJI Osmo Pocket 3 D-Log
• DJI Mini 4 Pro
• And more coming soon

These profiles give you the power to push your video color grading further than ever before. Whether you're using a phone, drone, or mirrorless camera, LUT Studio helps you maximize every pixel.

True film emulation
Go beyond standard filters for videos. Add a cinematic touch with real film-inspired effects:
• Halation - replicate glowing highlights for a dreamy, analog vibe
• Bloom - soften light sources for a natural film glow
• Grain - add rich texture and vintage aesthetics to your footage
Our film editor tools make your footage feel like it came straight from a high-end post-production suite.

Key Features:
• Real-time LUT preview on video clips
• Built-in and custom .cube LUT support (from DaVinci Resolve and more)
• Halation, bloom, and film grain effects
• Support for 4K export
• Designed and optimized for iPhone
• Works with color grading and log footage

Designed for creators, by creators
Whether you're capturing daily vlogs, travel footage, or professional content, LUT Studio empowers you to craft a consistent, high-quality cinematic video look. The app bridges the gap between mobile convenience and pro-level grading tools.

Perfect for:
• YouTubers & filmmakers
• Social media creators
• Drone pilots
• Anyone who wants to improve video aesthetics with simple yet powerful camera filters
With a clean UI and blazing-fast performance, LUT Studio is the color editor app that turns your mobile device into a pocket-sized film editor.

Why LUT Studio stands out:
• Powerful color grading tools without the learning curve of desktop software
• Better video filters than basic apps - real cinematic results
• Optimized for speed and simplicity
• Compatible with footage from a wide range of sources

Whether you're new to grading or a pro looking for a fast mobile solution, this cinematic camera app is your perfect companion. Apply custom filters for videos, match tones with precision, and export your masterpiece with confidence.
Download LUT Studio today and unlock the power of mobile video color grading - from log profiles to the final grade. Create your look. Tell your story. Elevate your visuals.

Contact Us Got questions about Lut Studio? We're here to help! Reach out to us at: 
Email: https://www.phone-frames.com
Follow and message us on our Instagram: instagram.com/lutstudioapp/ 

Feel free to drop us a line anytime for support, feedback, or just to share your amazing color-graded videos with us!
Terms of use: https://lutstudio.app/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://lutstudio.app/privacy-policy

it.name: Uplens: Photo & Video Editor
it.d:
Uplens is the ultimate mobile photo and video editor, powered by AI and designed to help you take perfect selfies and create stunning visuals in just a few taps. With our advanced retouching tools and a full range of professional-grade editing features, Uplens gives you everything you need to make your photos and videos look their best.

Use the Magic AI Retouch function to get flawless skin and natural color correction. Our vintage presets give your visuals a unique, nostalgic vibe, and with our easy-to-use editing tools, you can customize each preset to create your own signature style.

In addition to our powerful retouching tools, video editing features, and vintage presets, Uplens also offers a full suite of professional-grade editing tools, including contrast, saturation, noise, and more. Whether you're a professional photographer or just want to take your Instagram profile to the next level, Uplens is the perfect tool for all your photo and video editing needs.

it.name: VEED Lite: Quick Video Edits
it.d:
VEED Lite — AI Quick Edits, Captions & Talking Videos

Fast, AI-powered video editing right on your phone. VEED Lite turns raw clips into polished short-form content in minutes — automatic edits, captions, and AI talking-head videos, with no learning curve. Built for creators, businesses, and anyone posting to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Twitter/X, and LinkedIn.

VEED Lite or VEED — which one do you need?
VEED Lite (this app) is the quick, lightweight option: AI auto-editing, captions, and AI talking videos for clips up to 10 minutes, all done right here on your phone.
VEED (our full app) is the complete AI video creation platform, with stronger customization options, but also a full video editor, support for longer videos, text-to-speech, voice cloning, transitions, background removal, and 50+ additional features - also offering seamless editing across web and mobile, with your projects always kept in sync.

Want a fully-fledged video creation platform, or powerful, cross-device editing? Get VEED. 
Staying for fast, AI-first essentials? You're in the right place.

What VEED Lite does
AI Talking Videos — Powered by Fabric
We built Fabric, the best AI video generation model in the game. Create talking videos with AI actors that actually look and sound real.

- Create your own AI actors — describe who you want, and we'll generate them. Full control over appearance, voice, and style.
- Best-in-class talking video quality — Fabric delivers lip-sync, expressions, and motion that competitors can't touch.
- Script to video in minutes — type your script, pick (or create) an actor, and you're done.

This is the fastest way to make talking-head content without filming yourself.

Automatic Editing with AI
Upload or record a video. VEED Lite edits it for you.

- Styles you can swipe through — we apply edits automatically, you pick your favorite.
- Toggle off what you don't like — we'll remember for next time.
- Saves hours per video.

Features That Actually Matter

Auto captions
- Multiple styles, designed to maximize views
- Translate into different languages
- Remove silences and filler words automatically

AI zooms
- We zoom in at key moments, automatically
- This makes your videos much more dynamic

AI background music
- Generate royalty-free music
- No licensing headaches

AI B-roll
- Generate B-roll to support your story
- Multiple styles (we use Flux, Nano-banana, and more)

Background noise removal
- Always sound like you're in a studio

Quick editing essentials
- Trim clips and add music, text, stickers, and GIFs
- Powerful on-device edits - your videos stay right here on your phone

Share everywhere
- One tap to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and more
- Auto-resize for each platform

Who VEED Lite is for
Quick edits on the go — whether you're a creator, small business owner, marketer, or posting for the first time. 
Want a fully-fledged AI video creation platform, a complete editing toolkit, or to pick up your edits across devices and desktop? Head to the full VEED app.

PAYMENT:
If you subscribe via Apple, payment is charged to your App Store Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions and auto-renewal in Account Settings on your iPhone.

ABOUT VEED.IO
VEED.IO is the fastest way to create pro-level videos on the web. Now we're bringing that same power to your iPhone. We want to make the best mobile video editing app around, so we're listening to your feedback to take this app to the next level.

Feedback? Email us at mobile-support@veed.io

The VEED team

TERMS: http://www.veed.io/terms-of-use
PRIVACY POLICY: http://www.veed.io/privacy

it.name: Detail: AI Video Editor
it.d:
Detail combines the simplicity of a camera app with the power of a professional AI video editor. Whether you're creating a 60-second reaction video, a polished YouTube vlog, a 30-minute interview or podcast, or going live to thousands of viewers, you can do it all in one place with Detail.


INSTANT VIDEO WITH AI AUTO-EDIT

Record or import a video and let AI Auto-Edit do the rest. Detail's AI finds the best moments, removes silences, and creates ready-to-share shorts and reels automatically. Instant video — record, done.


AI DIRECTOR — YOUR PERSONAL TELEPROMPTER

Stay on script with AI Director, your conversational teleprompter guide. It listens as you speak and keeps you on track, so every take is your best take. Perfect for content creators, educators, and presenters.


MULTICAM RECORDING

Turn your iPhone and iPad into a multi-camera video studio. Record from multiple angles simultaneously and switch between them in real time. Professional multicam production without the professional price tag.


REACTION VIDEOS MADE EASY

Record split-screen reaction videos to any content in seconds. Import a video, hit record, and share your reaction with the world. The fastest way to create reaction content for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels.


PODCAST & VIDEO PODCAST STUDIO

Record, edit, and publish professional video podcasts. Detail handles layouts, audio levels, and transitions so you can focus on the conversation. Support for remote guests and multi-camera setups.


LIVESTREAMING TO ANY PLATFORM

Go live to YouTube, Twitch, Facebook, or any RTMP destination directly from Detail. Add overlays, switch cameras, and engage your audience — all from your iPhone or iPad.


GREEN SCREEN & CHROMA KEY

Remove or replace your background instantly with green screen support. No physical green screen needed — Detail's AI handles background removal automatically.


AI AUTO-CAPTIONS & SUBTITLES

Add accurate auto captions in 50+ languages. Customize fonts, colors, and styles. Captions are fully editable and can be exported as separate subtitle files. Transcribe your content with a single tap.


PROFESSIONAL EDITING TOOLS

• Trim, cut, and split clips with precision

• Add text, stickers, and overlays

• Apply filters, effects, and color grading

• Adjust speed — slow motion, time-lapse, and more

• 4K video export for maximum quality

• Music and sound effects library


BUILT FOR CONTENT CREATORS

Detail is the all-in-one video editor for UGC creators, vloggers, podcasters, and social media content creators. Create professional content for TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, and every platform — without juggling complicated apps or expensive gear.


CLOUD SYNC & COLLABORATION

Access your projects across all your Apple devices. Collaborate with your team in real time. Your video studio, everywhere you go.


Download Detail today and join millions of creators making better videos with AI.


Terms of Use: https://detail.co/terms

Privacy Policy: https://detail.co/privacy

it.name: Luminar: Photo Editor&Enhancer
it.d:
Luminar — Your all-in-one, on-the-go photo editor and creative companion for iPhone, iPad and Vision Pro. Explore powerful AI-driven tools and an interactive interface that responds to your touch, delivering a uniquely engaging photo editing experience.

Streamlined design with unparalleled control

Luminar's user-friendly design allows you to edit your photos with intuitive gestures, featuring smoothly gliding sliders and spinning dials that respond realistically to your touch with motion and sound. With Luminar, there are no complicated functions or processes. Less fuss, more creativity.

Smart AI enhancements

Powered by cutting-edge technology, Luminar is the revolutionary smart AI photo enhancer for your every need:

- SkyAI: Seamlessly replace dull skies with brilliant ones for impressive backdrops
- EnhanceAI: Effortlessly enhance photo quality with a single slide, adjusting color, tone and clarity for professional results in seconds
- StructureAI: Unlock hidden details and clarity in your images, enhancing contrast and texture for striking visual impact
- Light Depth: Add natural depth and dimension with AI-powered, depth-aware lighting
- FaceAI: Automatically enhance face features, brighten the face and subtly refine proportions
- SkinAI: Automatically retouch the skin and remove imperfections for a clean and smooth result
- BodyAI: Shape a subject’s midsection in a realistic way by adding or removing volume
- BokehAI: Blur backgrounds, adjust focus, customize bokeh shapes

All-in-one powerhouse

- Curves: Edit photos with precise color and tone adjustments, achieving the perfect balance and mood
- Details: Enhance every detail with just a tap, bringing your images to life with clarity and sharpness
- Crop: Easily trim, align, flip and rotate for the perfect composition, ensuring your images stand out
- Landscape: Transform your landscapes with ease and enhance golden hour lighting, brighten foliage, or remove haze for breathtaking results
- Monochrome: Convert your color photos to stunning black and white masterpieces, adding depth and mood to your images
- Erase: Effortlessly remove distracting elements from your photos to place focus on your subjects
- Photo Filters: Enjoy a diverse collection of photo effects that add a unique style to your shots
- RAW File Support: Edit your RAW photos directly on your mobile, preserving maximum image quality

Seamless integration with Apple devices

Designed for the Apple ecosystem, Luminar makes it easy to edit photos taken on your iPhone or iPad, enhancing your editing workflow. On the iPad, you can add personal touches using the Apple Pencil for sharper details and convenient edits. Plus, discover a new immersive editing experience with Vision Pro, optimized for iPadOS and VisionOS.

Luminar — Envision more

Whether you're a beginner or a pro, the Luminar AI photo editor offers a range of features to suit your needs, including detail enhancement, photo retouching, color adjustment, and more. Try Luminar now and experience next-level photo editing at your fingertips.

Compatibility Note:

The Luminar picture editor is optimized for devices running iOS/iPadOS 17 and newer. Please note that on iPad 6-gen, certain advanced features such as Erase, Sky AI and Relight AI are not available.

To access all features, you need to purchase one of the plans below:
1 Week subscription
12 Months subscription (+7 days free trial. Once the trial is over, you will be charged a yearly subscription)
Lifetime license

Subscriptions auto-renew at the cost of the chosen package, unless canceled 24-hours in advance prior to the end of the current period. The subscription fee is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://skylum.com/legal
Terms of use: https://skylum.com/legal-eula

Your all-in-one toolkit to stand out on social. Whether you’re a brand, creator, or just here to have fun, Unfold gives you the tools you need to create elevated content, grow your audience, and monetize your social presence. Whatever you do, whatever you’re into—use Unfold to share your story. 


MAKE TREND-SETTING CONTENT

Express your creativity with award-winning photo & video templates, and design tools in the Unfold Studio. 

- Scroll-stopping filters and effects for photo & video content
- Hundreds of templates for Instagram Stories, Instagram Posts, Instagram Reels, TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest and Facebook
- Exclusive fonts and styles
- Royalty-free music and audio
- Professional-grade but easy-to-use editing tools
- AI content editing tools (e.g. background remover)
- Animated doodle brush
- Custom brand assets (Unfold Pro only)

MONETIZE YOUR CREATIVITY THROUGH YOUR LINK IN BIO

A Bio Site is a one-page, mobile-first website for your link in bio. Make yours in minutes and create more opportunities to grow your income. 

- Claim your free Bio Site URL
- Sell digital products like guides, tutorials and gated content
- Crowdfund your next project
- Collect tips through your link in bio
- Connect to PayPal or Stripe for secure payments
- Feature products from your online store
- Capture your audience’s emails and phone numbers
- Showcase your portfolio and services
- Link to your other social channels
- Add your music or podcast from Spotify, Apple Music and more
- Stand out with on-brand templates and fonts


CHOOSE YOUR UNFOLD PLAN

Download the free version with fun features for everyday storytellers, or subscribe for advanced creative tools. 

Unfold's Free Version: Easy-to-use tools to share your story with the world.

- Sample collection of templates (with watermark)
- Curation of royalty-free tracks
- Cool fonts and photo effects
- Photo & video editing tools
- Free Bio Site URL and builder

Unfold+: Unlock hundreds of templates and premium editing tools.

- 400+ social templates and layouts (no watermark)
- Premium filters and effects like Film, VHS and Glitch
- Exclusive fonts, styles and tools
- 100+ royalty-free tracks
- Premium video editing tools

Unfold Pro: Take your social media presence to the next level with pro-level features.

In addition to everything in Unfold+
- Access to Brand Kit to import your brand colors, fonts and logos

POPULAR IN UNFOLD

Creators are loving these features right now: 

- Vintage film templates for Instagram Stories and Posts
- Cinematic fonts, titles and headings for TikTok and Insta Reels
- Seamless Instagram carousel templates
- Graphic video effects
- Yearly and monthly recap video templates
- Minimalist social media templates
- Fisheye effect
- Collage maker
- Retro photo and video effects like grain and VHS
- Inspiring quote templates
- Aesthetic link in bio website
- Animated social media templates
- Before and after social templates


AWARD-WINNING CREATIVE TOOLS

Apple’s Best of the Year
Google’s Best of the Year
Fast Company’s Innovation by Design
Apple’s App of the Day


UNFOLD YOUR CREATIVITY TODAY

Download the app to see why hundreds of thousands of creators all over the world use Unfold. Try the free version and upgrade to Unfold+ or Unfold Pro for advanced tools.

it.name: VSCO: Photo & Video Editor
it.d:
Welcome to VSCO — your complete photography platform solution for unmatched photo filters, AI photo editing, video editing, portfolio sites, client workflows, and community. VSCO is where photographers turn pro.

Get access to a premium AI photo editor that provides precision and quality. From editing with our photo presets that match your style to delivering stunning client photo galleries, the VSCO photo and video editing app is a seamless way to run your photography business in one place. Download the VSCO app today.

VSCO APP FEATURES:

200+ PHOTO PRESETS AND FILTERS
- Use professional-grade photo filters and editing tools such as Crop and Fade to effortlessly showcase your style.
- Try photo filters that reflect vintage film looks inspired by Kodak, Fuji, Agfa, and others with Film X presets.
- Save and recreate your favorite photo filters and edits with Recipes and join VSCO Membership to access VSCO’s complete library of 200+ photo presets. 

EDIT 100 PHOTOS AT ONCE
- Create the perfect edit and paste it on up to 100 photos. 
- Easily apply photo presets, film effects, and adjustments like exposure, contrast, and white balance to keep your aesthetic consistent. 
- See every change happen in real time, then export when you're done.

ADVANCED PHOTO EDITOR WITH AI LAB
- Experience intelligent AI photo editing designed to enhance without overpowering. 
- Use advanced photo editing tools: HSL, Dodge & Burn, Split Tone, and Grain.  
- Remove distractions, upscale, repair, and refine photos with AI prompts. Included with VSCO Pro membership with unlimited edits.

VIDEO EDITING WITHOUT COMPROMISE

it.name: Twitch: Live Streaming
it.d:
Twitch is where thousands of communities come together for our favorite streamers, for the games we love, for the lulz, for each other, for whatever. Download Twitch and join millions enjoying live games, music, sports, esports, podcasts, cooking shows, IRL streams, and whatever else crosses our community’s wonderfully absurd minds. We’ll see you in chat.

Here’s a convenient list of other awesome things about Twitch:

Everyone is “about” community. We actually are one: Whatever you nerd out about, you can find your people on Twitch. 
Give support, get support: Find new streamers and subscribe to your favorites. Plus,  unlock exclusive perks for your support. 
Start your own channel: The Twitch app is one of the easiest ways to start streaming. Just create an account, go live directly from the app, and bring people together around whatever you’re passionate about. 
You never know what you’ll find: Popular games are always live, but so are music festivals, rocket launches, street tours of Tokyo, and goat yoga. Yes, really. 
Dark mode: Y’all love this one. Black and purple have never looked this good together.

Twitch's Terms of Service are available at https://www.twitch.tv/p/legal/terms-of-service/
For feedback and assistance, please visit our Support Center: https://help.twitch.tv
 
Please note: This app features Nielsen’s proprietary measurement software which contributes to market research, like Nielsen’s TV Ratings. Please see http://priv-policy.imrworldwide.com/priv/mobile/us/en/optout.html for more information

it.name: B612 AI Photo&Video Editor
it.d:
B612 is the best all-in-one camera & photo/video editing app. We offer various free features and tools to make every moment more special.
Meet trendy effects, filters, and stickers that are updated every day!

=== Main features ===

*Create your own filters*
- Create a one-of-a-kind filter and share it with friends
- No problem even if it's your first time creating a filter. Filters are easily completed with just a few touches.
- Meet the creative and diverse filters of B612 creators.


*Smarter CAMERA*
Apply real-time filters and beauty to capture every moment as your pic of the day.

- Don't miss out on daily updated AR effects and seasonal exclusive trendy filters
- Smart Beauty: Get a perfect recommendation for your face shape and create your custom beauty style
- AR Makeup: Create a natural look from daily to trendy makeup. You can adjust beauty and makeup to suit you.
- Shoot clearly anytime, anywhere with high-resolution mode and night mode.
- Capture the fun moment with the Gif Bounce feature. Create it as a gif and share it with your friends to double the fun!
- From video shooting to post-editing with over 500 kinds of music. Turn your daily life into a music video.
- You can use a custom sound source for music by extracting a sound source from your video.


*ALL-IN-ONE PRO editing feature*
Enjoy basic, professional-grade tools for free

- Various Filters & Effects: From retro to emotional modern style! Create the atmosphere you want.
- Advanced Color Edit: Experience precise color edit with tools such as professional curves, split tone, and HSL that brings out details.
- More natural portrait edit: Complete your pic of the day with beauty effects, body edit, and hair color styling.
- Edit Videos: Anyone can edit videos easily with trendy effects and various music.
- Borders and Crop: Simply adjust the size and ratio and upload it to social media.
- Decoration Stickers & Texts: Decorate your photos with various stickers and texts! You can also make custom stickers and use them.


[B612 VIP]
Your App Store account will be charged when subscribing to B612 VIP. The subscription will be renewed and charged 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Automatic renewal can be disabled in the App Store at any time. Currently, B612 VIP subscription is $6.99 USD per month. The amount is based on U.S. dollars and may be differ in other countries, and is subject to change without notice. B612 can be used for free without purchasing B612 VIP.

it.name: Splice - Video Editor & Maker
it.d:
Simple yet powerful, Splice makes it easy to create fully customized, professional-looking videos on your iPhone or iPad. Imagine the performance of a desktop editor, optimized for your mobile device. Just tap to trim clips, add slow motion effects, and overlay multiple clips to create beautiful videos you’ll love to share. It’s never been easier to edit like a pro on the go. 


POWERFUL EDITING TOOLS MADE SIMPLE  
+ Trim, cut, and crop your photos and video clips.
+ Refine your clips by adjusting exposure, contrast, saturation, and more.
+ Adjust playback speed for fast or slow motion, now also with speed ramping.
+ Overlay photos or videos and apply masks to create incredible effects.
+ Remove background with Chroma Key.
+ Animate your clips with the Ken Burns effect.
+ Apply filters and adjust background colors, orientation, and more.
+ Add amazing effects: glitch, chroma, vintage, and lots more.
+ Choose your transition style and control the speed between transitions.
+ Add title slides, text overlays, and a custom outro.
+ Bring your photos to life and create slideshows with pan and zoom effects.


CUSTOMIZE THE PERFECT SOUNDTRACK
+ Choose songs from 6,000+ royalty-free tracks from Artlist and Shutterstock libraries.
+ Trim and mix multiple audio tracks with precision.
+ Use a song from your own iTunes collection (subject to iTunes terms). 
+ Add narration or custom sound effects with the built-in voice recorder.


EASILY SHARE + SAVE YOUR VIDEO
+ Share right to YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Mail, Messages, and more. 
+ Save videos to your camera roll.


SUBSCRIPTION INFO:

Subscribe to take advantage of the features described above.
• Subscription length: weekly, monthly, yearly
• Your payment will be charged to your iTunes Account as soon as you confirm your purchase.
• You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase.
• Your subscription will renew automatically, unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• The cost of renewal will be charged to your account in the 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
• When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.
