it.name: UNSCRIPTED Photography Poses
it.d:
Everything you need to grow your photography business, in one spot.

Unscripted is the all-in-one app built to help photographers feel more confident behind the camera and more in control of the business around it.

Find inspiration from 40,000+ poses and prompts. Manage clients, contracts, invoices, questionnaires, automated emails and shoot details. Then deliver beautiful native client galleries from the same connected platform, without piecing together a different tool for every part of the job.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO RUN YOUR PHOTOGRAPHY BUSINESS
Keep the work around every shoot organised, from booking to delivery.

• Manage clients and session details
• Send photography contracts for e-signature
• Create and track invoices
• Send questionnaires, guides and automated emails
• Keep important documents and communication together
• Access your business from mobile and web

NATIVE CLIENT GALLERIES
Deliver photos from the same platform you use to manage the booking, contract and invoice.

Create and share native client galleries through Unscripted. On the web platform, eligible business plans also include additional gallery features such as design customisation to suit your branding, white labelling, download limits and more.

Gallery features are not included with posing-only access.

40,000+ POSES AND PROMPTS
Never run out of ideas halfway through a session.

Explore more than 40,000 posing ideas and prompts for families, couples, weddings, newborns, portraits and more. Save your favourites before a shoot and keep inspiration close when you need it on location.

Use every pose as a starting point, then adapt it to the people in front of you.

PLAN EVERY SHOOT WITH MORE CONFIDENCE
Prepare before you arrive and stay organised while you work with practical tools including:

• Sun tracking and golden-hour times
• Saved pose collections
• Camera settings guidance
• Session checklists and timelines
• Client information available on the go

BUILT FOR PHOTOGRAPHERS
Unscripted was created for photographers who want to spend less time juggling admin and more time doing the work they love.

Whether you are booking your first client or growing a full-time photography business, Unscripted brings your business tools, creative inspiration and client experience together in one place.

Download Unscripted and start building the photography business you have been dreaming about.

Feature availability varies by plan.

Read the privacy policy here: https://www.unscriptedposingapp.com/privacy-policy

it.name: InShot - Video Editor
it.d:
InShot: Video Editor & Photo Editor for Every Moment.

Create stunning videos and photos with easy-to-use editing tools and powerful AI features. Whether you're making daily vlogs, birthday or anniversary videos, creating content for social media, or growing your small business, InShot makes it easy to bring your ideas to life and share them with the world.

[AI Tools]
- Auto Captions. Generate subtitles and captions with AI speech-to-text tool.
- Bilingual Subtitles. Create bilingual subtitles to make your videos accessible to a wider audience.
- AI Speech. Turn text into natural-sounding speech with AI Text to Speech and AI Voice Generator.
- AI Cut. Automatically remove silence, filler words, and breath sounds to make video editing faster and easier.
- Video & Photo Enhance. Improve the quality of your photos and videos for sharper, clearer results.
- AI Effects. Experience the magic of AI with instant presets that elevate your images and videos in just one tap.
- AI Portrait. Enhance portraits with AI Retouch, AI Face Edit, and AI Light. Fine-tune facial features and add flash, backlight, or hair light effects.
- Auto Background Removal. Remove backgrounds from photos and videos with one tap.
- Voice Enhance. Enhance voice clarity and reduce background noise.
- Auto Adjust. Instantly enhance your images and videos with one-tap.

[Video Editing]
- Trim & Merge. Trim, split, and merge video clips with ease.
- Reverse. Reverse videos and create unique playback effects.
- Speed Control. Speed up or slow down videos from 0.1x to 100x, with speed curves and speed ramping.
- Text & Stickers. Add text, emoji, and InShot-exclusive stickers with a wide range of fonts, styles, and text templates. Import your own fonts locally.
- Music & Voice. Add music, sound effects, voice-overs, and voice effects in various styles.
- Keyframe Animation. Add custom keyframe animations to clips and adjust settings over time.
- Slow Motion. Create smooth slow-motion videos with speed curves.
- Chroma Key. Remove specific colors from videos and create green screen effects.
- Picture-in-Picture. Layer multiple videos to create multi-layered videos.
- Stabilizer. Stabilize shaky footage for smoother, steadier videos.
- Smart tracking. Make stickers/text move seamlessly in sync with your tracking object motion, adding dynamic flair to your videos.

[AI Photo Editor]

Do you like to travel and do you have Instagram? Excellent! This app will help you to create awesome posts and stories about your travels for your Instagram profile!

It's really simple. Choose transport, enter your route, press the START button, and enjoy a fun animation of your trip. Share your trips with your friends in the language of video maps.

Show off the interesting trips you've taken to your friends and post them on social media. 

-Create your own unique trip routes.
-Choose any transport and hit the road. 
-Save the results as a video.
-Send videos to your friends or post them on social media.

300 unique means of transport await you, including real and imaginary ones. The number of vehicles will regularly increase with each update. Leave comments about vehicles you'd like to take for a spin, but aren't in the app.

Don’t forget to visit our Instagram profile @TravelBoast

it.name: Darkroom: Photo & Video Editor
it.d:
Transform your iPhone and iPad into a sophisticated editing suite with Darkroom, the highly acclaimed photo and video editor designed to empower both amateur photographers and professional creators. With desktop-quality tools at your fingertips, Darkroom competes with industry giants such as Adobe Lightroom and Photoshop, delivering unparalleled editing experiences right on your mobile device.

Award-Winning App Recognitions:
Winner of the Apple Design Award in 2020
Apple’s Editor’s Choice since 2018
Best New App Winner in 2015

Why Choose Darkroom?
Advanced AI-Powered Editing: Leverage cutting-edge AI tools for precise, depth-based edits and intelligent object detection. Enhance specific elements like skies, skin tones, and landscapes with unmatched accuracy.
Versatile Editing Capabilities: From high-resolution video playback and professional 8K color grading to batch photo editing, Darkroom addresses all your creative needs with efficiency. Its comprehensive toolset includes support for RAW and ProRAW files, making it perfect for high-quality photo projects.

Professional Tools for Every Creator:
All-Inclusive Format Support: Whether managing RAW files or crafting the perfect JPEG, Darkroom provides powerful editing tools that ensure top-tier output for all photo formats.
Tailored for iPhone Photographers: With iPhone-specific enhancements, Darkroom stands out as the premier editing tool for mobile photographers, offering intuitive interfaces and seamless integration with iOS features.

Praise from Experts:
"I can't say enough good things about Darkroom. It's fast, beautiful, powerful, and easy to understand and explore. And the team behind it keep improving the app
on a regular basis." - John Gruber, Daringfireball
"Darkroom is one of the best apps around, offering extensive support for RAW and ProRAW photos and capabilities to batch edit photos with ease." – The Verge
"Its iPhone-specific features make Darkroom the leading editing app for iPhone photographers." – The Sweet Setup

Seamless Organization and Sharing:
Organize your photos and videos with Darkroom's advanced management tools. Create stunning collages, manage hashtags effortlessly, and share your creations with ease. Streamline your workflow and keep your collections meticulously organized, whether for personal enjoyment or professional display.

Join Our Community and Enhance Your Creative Skills:
Become a Darkroom member to access exclusive features and regular updates that keep your tools cutting-edge. Our community is a hub for sharing tips, inspiration, and creative techniques.

Get Started with Darkroom Today:
Download Darkroom and elevate your photo and video editing to professional levels. With ongoing enhancements and a focus on user-friendly design, Darkroom is dedicated to enriching your creative journey.

Subscription and Membership Details:
Manage your Darkroom+ membership in the iTunes & App Store settings. Remember, subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Terms and Conditions: https://darkroom.co/legal/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://darkroom.co/legal/privacy-policy.html

it.name: OldRoll - Vintage Film Camera
it.d:
OldRoll is a film analog camera app mimicking the most realistic experience of using an actual disposable or a film camera. 

We have curated for you a wide array of classic vintage cameras loved by photographers and shutterbugs throughout the decades: from Instant camera, Fisheye to Super 8mm video cam - each reproduced to its finest details including the color, hue, grain, texture - and sometimes a few light leaks here and there for you to explore.

Download OldRoll and it’s just one shot away from 90s!

#Excellent Analog Cameras

• Classic M: Soft, timeless tones inspired by classic rangefinder film cameras.
• INS P: Instant-photo tones and timeless frames for shared moments.
• TOY F is a disposable camera from David and Emma specially created for you. Its warm color is suitable for shooting gourmet food. Take our pocket camera to get instant free prints!
• ROL 3.5: Rich color with a lo-fi vintage film look.
• 120 V brings you the charm of retro film.
• TOY K: Warm tones and classic grain inspired by disposable film cameras.
• Quatre camera is coming soon, it will bring you the best film story photo collage, helps you create photos grids with ease.
• We will also provide half-frame camera, fish eye camera, Kira camera with sparkle glitter effect and shining stars and double-exposure cameras, as well as random photo frames soon or later, to let you feel the charm of retro cameras
 
#Outstanding features

• It’s not a photo editor or a video editor, you don't need to edit or retouch the photo.
• Photos with square film frame and retro glitch effect are convenient to share to Instagram
• Post office function allows you to send photos straightly to recipient’s home screen. Come and share every moment with your friends.
• Share your photos with friends on your favorite social platforms.
• Flash helps you create d3d blockbusters in low-light situations
• Custom fun date stamp watermark, you can also freely modify the timestamp on the photo.
• Flip the lens to take a retro photo and experience the art of selfie!
• Most trendy effects: vhs, grain, cinema, film3d, prequel and sequel feeling, light leaks, 1888 or 1998 style and many more.
• Retro texture & rare vision different from digital cameras.
• The photo shooting timer free your hands to pose.
• Excellent photo mirror effect allow you to rotate and flip the photos.
• Photo collage camera with indie kid effect and glitter here for you.

We will also bring you 8mm, 16mm, 35mm video shooting, camcorder, glitch and 3d photos camera soon or later, let’s look forward to the video filters and effects for vcr live and photo!
Come on! Become a super video star! This will be your most chic camera in your iphone! 

*Subscription Info:

Subscribe for unlimited access to all features and content offered for purchase within the app.
Subscription options: $2.99 per month, $9.99 per year

Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.

Try OldRoll Web Edition：https://www.oldroll.io

Terms of use: https://www.oldroll.io/app/terms

it.name: YouTube
it.d:
Get the official YouTube app on iPhones and iPads. See what the world is watching -- from the hottest music videos to what’s popular in gaming, fashion, beauty, news, learning and more. Subscribe to channels you love, create content of your own, share with friends, and watch on any device.

Watch and subscribe
● Browse personal recommendations on Home
● See the latest from your favorite channels in Subscriptions
● Look up videos you’ve watched, liked, and saved for later in Library

Explore different topics, what’s popular, and on the rise (available in select countries)
● Stay up to date on what’s popular in music, gaming, beauty, news, learning and more
● See what’s trending on YouTube and around the world on Explore
● Learn about the coolest Creators, Gamers, and Artists on the Rise (available in select countries)

Connect with the YouTube community
● Keep up with your favorites creators with Posts, Stories, Premieres, and Live streams
● Join the conversation with comments and interact with creators and other community members

Create content from your mobile device
● Create or upload your own videos directly in the app
● Engage with your audience in real time with live streaming right from the app

Find the experience that fits you and your family (available in select countries)
● Every family has their own approach to online video. Learn about your options: the YouTube Kids app or a new parent supervised experience on YouTube at youtube.com/myfamily

Support creators you love with channel memberships (available in select countries)
● Join channels that offer paid monthly memberships and support their work
● Get access to exclusive perks from the channel & become part of their members community
● Stand out in comments and live chats with a loyalty badge next to your username

Upgrade to YouTube Premium (available in select countries)
● Watch videos uninterrupted by ads, while using other apps, or when the screen is locked
● Save videos for when you really need them – like when you’re on a plane or commuting
● Get access to YouTube Music Premium as part of your benefits

Note: If you subscribe via Apple, payment will be charged to App Store Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the selected plan. Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase.

YouTube paid service terms: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms_paidservice.
Privacy policy: https://www.google.com/policies/privacy

it.name: Animock: 3D Mockup Animator
it.d:
Animock is a professional 3D device mockup and animation studio for creating App Store screenshots, app preview videos, marketing visuals, social media content, and product presentations.

Turn screenshots and screen recordings into stunning 3D mockups with realistic lighting, powerful animation tools, and full scene customization.

Whether you're showcasing a mobile app, website, or digital product, Animock gives you complete control over how your content looks, moves, and is presented.

CREATE REALISTIC 3D DEVICE MOCKUPS

• Support for a wide range of devices including smartphones, tablets, laptops, watches, displays, TVs, and foldable devices
• Supports Apple devices such as iPhone, iPad, MacBook, iMac, Apple Watch, Vision Pro, and Pro Display XDR, plus selected Samsung devices
• Includes the iPhone Duo with separate controls for its inner and outer displays
• Control device position and rotation in 3D space using gestures, sliders, or precise input
• Place screenshots or videos directly onto device displays
• Control device-specific elements such as Dynamic Island, punch-hole, stands, shadows, and fold angle
• Add customizable 3D base shapes under devices

ADVANCED 3D ANIMATION SYSTEM

• Animate device movement, rotation, camera motion, zoom, and more in 3D space
• Create animations using a powerful keyframe timeline
• Choose from built-in animation presets to quickly bring your mockups to life
• Apply multiple easing curves for smooth, professional motion
• Create keyframe animations with delays and advanced effects such as zoom and full rotation
• Animate supported device features such as the iPhone Duo fold angle
• Create, save, import, and share custom animation presets
• Sync animation presets across devices using iCloud
• Reuse and import animations across projects

FULL SCENE CUSTOMIZATION

• Add images or videos to device displays
• Control media position, scale, fit, and rotation
• Choose canvas orientation and aspect ratio
• Set backgrounds as transparent, solid color, gradient, image, or environment
• Adjust background image blur for greater depth and focus
• Customize labels and other scene elements

LIGHTING & ENVIRONMENTS

• Built-in studio environments for realistic lighting, reflections, and depth
• Import custom HDRI environments
• Use environments as scene backgrounds
• Adjust environment lighting strength
• Add adjustable blur when using environments as backgrounds
• Control environment background brightness
• Adjust screen reflection strength for realistic materials and lighting

PROFESSIONAL EXPORT OPTIONS

• Export videos in MP4 or MOV formats
• Export with ProRes for high-quality professional workflows
• Export videos at up to 4K resolution across iPhone, iPad, and Mac
• Export images in PNG, JPEG, HEIC, and JPEG XL formats
• Export images at up to 8K resolution
• Export videos with transparent backgrounds using supported formats
• Follow video export status with Live Activities
• On supported iPads with M3 or newer, video exports can continue processing in the background

CREATED FOR DESIGNERS, DEVELOPERS & CREATORS

Animock is built for app developers, UI/UX designers, marketers, and content creators who want to produce high-quality visuals without the complexity of traditional 3D software.

Create App Store screenshots and preview videos, social media content, product launches, client presentations, promotional campaigns, and more.

Bring your ideas to life with powerful 3D animation, realistic environments, full scene control, and professional-grade exports — all in one studio.

it.name: Phocus: DSLR Portrait Camera
it.d:
Featured by Apple in “Powered by Apple Intelligence” and “Great Apps Updated for iOS 27” around the world, and in “Best New Apps and Updates” in the US and Canada.

Phocus is a portrait camera and depth editor for iPhone, iPad, and iPhone Duo. See each lens's bokeh live before you shoot, or bring any photo from your library, even one taken without Portrait mode, and reshape its focus and depth with tools that understand distance, not just outlines.

SHOOT
- Eight lens characters, from clean and modern to swirly vintage and black and white, each with its own bokeh rendered live in the viewfinder
- The blur you see is the blur you get, in the photo and the editor
- Live AI depth for real-time blur even where the camera can't measure depth on its own
- Live aperture and focus control
- Manual ISO, shutter speed, white balance, exposure, and focus
- Histogram, zebra, focus peaking, level, and timer
- RAW and ProRAW capture
- Import your own .cube LUTs, or choose from Daily, Film Looks, Vintage, Signature, and Mono
- Lens and color look suggestions with Apple Intelligence, generated on device
- Siri, Shortcuts, Lock Screen, and Control Center to open the camera you need

EDIT
- Change aperture, focus, blur falloff, and bokeh shape after the shot
- Edit any photo in your library: AI depth adds realistic blur even to photos taken without Portrait mode
- Edit the depth map directly: every color is a distance, so you can pick a depth and brush it over any area
- Select a subject with a tap on iOS 27, then refine it with Brush, Erase, and Hardness
- Masks in Portrait, Depth, and Select modes
- Curves, adjustments, tone, and film grain
- 3D Relight and 3D Scene Preview for depth-aware lighting
- Copy a photo's look onto other photos, with undo and redo for every change
- Save as Portrait keeps the depth with your photo
- Export depth maps and portrait mattes
- Portrait video blur
- Built-in tutorials and Mask Help

MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN
Phocus adapts to iPhone, iPad, and iPhone Duo. Open your Duo for more room to shoot and edit, or partially fold it with the preview and controls on either side of the fold.

"Looking for an app that not only adds the Portrait mode effect to your photos but does a bit more? Then Phocus is the one you're looking for." — iMore

"The app is a fine example of technical and artistic craftsmanship." — iGeeksBlog

PHOCUS PRO
Unlock every lens, look, and tool with Phocus Pro. Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly or annually at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan.

AUTO BODY RESHAPE

ADD MUSCLES

ADD TATTOO

it.name: Alight Motion
it.d:
Be part of the movement! Alight Motion is the first professional motion design app for your smartphone for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, bringing you professional-quality animation, motion graphics, visual effects, video editing, video compositing, and more!

• Multiple layers of graphics, video, and audio
• Vector and bitmap support (edit vector graphics right on your phone!)
• 160+ basic effect building blocks that can be combined to create sophisticated visual effects
• Keyframe animation available for all settings
• Link parent and child layers and rig character joints
• Cameras that pan, zoom, and support focus blur and fog
• Grouping and Masking
• Color Adjustment
• Animation easing for more fluid motion: Pick from presets or build your own timing curves
• Bookmarks for ease of editing
• Velocity-based motion blur
• Export MP4 video, GIF animation, PNG sequences, and stills
• Share project packages with others
• Solid color and gradient fill effects
• Border, shadow, and stroke effects
• Custom font support
• Copy and paste entire layers or just their style
• Save your favorite elements for easy re-use in future projects

Alight Motion is free to use with basic features and a watermark on videos you create. There are several paid membership options in the app to remove the watermark and access a regularly updated library of premium effects and features. These subscription membership options are charged when you select to purchase them, and renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours prior to the beginning of the next subscription period. After purchasing, subscriptions can be managed in your Apple ID settings. You can find more information about subscriptions at https://alightcreative.com/support

it.name: Dazz Cam - Vintage Camera
it.d:
Dazz Camera, Pro Photographer in your Pocket.
We believe in keeping it simple, no need for post-editing. With just one tap, you can capture the most authentic vintage photos or videos, letting you enjoy the moment without distractions.

Dazz camera is inspired by classic film cameras from the 80s. We’ve sampled real film stock to recreate the colors and textures of vintage photography. Dazz camera supports shooting in various retro film formats like 135 film, 120 film, toy cameras, slide film, half-frame cameras, instant camera, 3D film photography, disposable camera, and more. 

Besides film photography, Dazz camera also offers modern digital camera color profiles, including compact camera, CCD camera, and we’re constantly adding more.

You can also capture videos with a retro vibe, using formats like 8mm film camera, 16mm film camera, VHS tape camera, DCR camera, movie camera, and slide projector.

We’re always rolling out new cameras, so keep an eye out!

When you’re capturing photos and videos, we’ve got some cool extra features and accessories for you:

- Save the negative and reprocess it to achieve different exposure and color temperature. (Available on select cameras)
- Double exposure effect by layering two photos.
- Timer for delayed shots.
- Flash.
- Import your existing photos for editing. (Available on select cameras)
- Adjust color temperature and tint.
- Switch between preset focal lengths or adjust freely.
- Tweak exposure compensation.
- Adjust ISO and shutter speed.
- Stabilization settings.
- Composition grids.
- Fisheye lens.
- Starburst lens.
- Color flash filters.
- Prism lens.
- ND filter.

When you share your photos on social media, don’t forget to tag them with #dazzcam. Our team might just feature your awesome photos in our collection!

Got any questions? Email us at dazz.camera@gmail.com.


Dazz Pro Subscription

- Join Dazz Pro to access all cameras and accessories.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. 
- Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
- Your account will be charged for renewal, in accordance with your plan, within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. 
- You can manage or turn off auto-renew in your Apple ID account settings any time after purchase.

http://dazz.ltd/dazz/terms_and_conditions.html

Privacy policy:
http://dazz.ltd/dazz/privacy_policy.html

TikTok is the global discovery platform for videos, streaming on LIVE, shopping, and more. Our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. Over a billion people come to TikTok to share what they love, learn new things, and find ideas that make everyday life more interesting.

Your experience on TikTok is built around what you're into, not who you know. Just watch, like, and scroll to discover videos, creators, and communities you are delighted to discover. From quick recipes to game highlights, fashion tips to music and trending sounds, your For You feed reflects your current interests and changes based on what surprises and inspires you.

Creating is simple. Capture and post everyday moments and turn them into something special with easy editing tools, effects, sounds, and music. Use our free library of sounds and music in your videos, plus filters and creative tools that help your content stand out. On TikTok, anyone can create, and ideas that inspire pick up momentum.

TikTok is also where discovery becomes part of your everyday life. Find creators to follow, new ideas to try, and products you will love from small businesses and brands around the world. TikTok offers more than 50 preset safety and privacy features, from private accounts and content filters to screen time tools and Family Pairing, so you can choose an experience that works for you. TikTok provides extra support for teens and families on the app, letting you set time and content preferences that feel right for your family. 

■ Personalized discovery
A For You feed that learns what you enjoy. Discover videos, creators, LIVE streams, shopping, and communities based on what you watch, like, and share.
■ Entertainment, learning, and everything in between
Comedy, gaming, DIY, beauty, sports, music, lifestyle, education, and more. Find content that makes you laugh, think, and try something new.
■ Simple, powerful creation tools
Record in clips, pause and resume, trim and merge, add text and stickers, and fine tune your video without leaving the app.
■ Sounds, music, and effects
Use our free library of sounds and music in your videos, plus filters, effects, and creative tools that help you express yourself and make your videos stand out.
■ A global community of creators
Follow your favorite creators and discover new voices every day. Share your own story or support the people who inspire you.
■ Discover and shop with TikTok Shop
Explore trending products, exclusive deals, and seamless shopping experiences inspired by creators and brands you love, all in one place. Shop directly from videos, LIVE, and the Shop tab, track your orders, and enjoy a safe, secure shopping experience.
■ Go LIVE and connect in real time
Start a LIVE to chat with your community, share moments as they happen, and unlock special features and benefits where available.
■ Tools to shape your experience
Use more than 50 safety and privacy features, from private accounts and content filters to screen time tools, Family Pairing, and other controls, to choose how TikTok works for you and your family.

Ready to see what you discover next? Download TikTok to start watching, creating, and exploring your world in a new way.

it.name: Mockup - UI/UX Design
it.d:
Mockup helps you sketch, wireframe, and prototype apps and websites across iPad, iPhone, and Mac. Built specifically for UI/UX design and Apple Pencil, Mockup combines a flexible canvas with reusable UI elements and interactive prototypes in one seamless workflow.

Featured by Apple and recognized as App of the Day, Mockup is trusted by 500,000+ designers, developers, and product teams worldwide to sketch and wireframe interfaces faster.

Design interfaces for mobile, tablet, desktop, watch, TV, and the web.

- Sketch naturally with Apple Pencil using versatile drawing tools and a complete color palette.
- Work with 45+ device frames in portrait and landscape.
- Draw perfect shapes with Shape Detection and Snap to Grid for cleaner layouts.
- Write and edit text directly on the canvas using Scribble.
- Customize grids, frames, and backgrounds to match your workflow.

Build Better Wireframes

- Use ready-to-use UI elements or create, save, and reuse your own custom element sets.
- Add text, images, shapes, and over 4,000 SF Symbols.
- Save reusable text styles for a consistent design system.
- Drag and drop text or images directly from other apps.

Prototype User Flows

- Connect screens to create interactive flows.
- Preview prototypes in full-screen mode.
- Validate navigation and user experience before development.

Export, Share & Continue Anywhere

- Export high-quality PDF and PNG files.
- Share Mockup files with other users.
- Collaborate in real time using SharePlay.
- Sync sketches and projects across iPad, iPhone, and Mac with iCloud.
- Access recent sketches and preview your work from Home Screen widgets.

Optimized for Apple Pencil & iPad

- Use Apple Pencil Hover to preview and switch drawing tools with greater precision and control.
- Use Apple Pencil Pro squeeze to access canvas controls, adjust tools, select objects, or undo and redo actions.
- Enjoy a desktop-class experience with external keyboard and trackpad support.
- Work across multiple windows for greater productivity.

Start creating for free with unlimited sketches and projects, or unlock the complete Mockup experience with Mockup Studio.

Mockup Studio includes:
- All device frames
- Interactive prototypes
- Unlimited custom element sets
- Exclusive UI elements
- Shape Detection
- 4,000+ customizable SF Symbols
- Watermark-free PDF export
- PNG export
- Nested projects
- Priority support

it.name: Sketchar: AR Drawing App

Sketchar is for you if you want to improve your drawing skills, express yourself through art, impress friends and family with stunning artwork, collaborate with peers, relieve stress, or become a Pro.

We have merged AR and AI together to speed up your learning experience and make it more entertaining. 

Here are the unique features that can only be found on the Sketchar app: 

1.COURSES
550+ drawing lessons based on characters you love.

You can start with a beginner set or delve deeper into a specific topic to improve your artistic skills, for example, in creating portraits or anime. 

2. PERSONALIZED PLAN 
Based on AI to speed up your creative growth

3. DRAWING TOOL
Powerful toolset to create stunning art in minutes.

4.CONTESTS 
Join the community to collaborate with peers.

5. AUGMENTED REALITY for drawing 
We invented that in 2012. Through your smartphone camera, you can see an AR sketch on the surface in front of you. Just take a pencil and follow the virtual lines on the paper step-by-step. This function is also employed by professional artists to scale sketches onto surfaces like walls. Use carefully and follow the video guide.

and many other features. 

Btw, practicing art helps relieve stress.

Download Sketchar now and learn to draw like never before.

In-app purchases:

Sketchar offers four paid auto-renewable subscription options that give you unlimited access to the app's premium content and features. 

1-Week Subscription - $7.99 / Week

1 -Month Subscription – $14.99 / Month 

1-Year Subscription with 3-Day Trial – $69.99 / Year 

1-Year Special Offer Subscription – $34.99 / Year 

Prices may vary across countries. Prices are equal to the value that Application Store Matrix determines as the equivalent of the subscription price in USD. 

We are always interested in your opinion, so please email us at hi@sketchar.io.

it.name: VDIT: AI Captions & Subtitles
it.d:
Speak, and VDIT writes your captions.
Then finish the whole video in one app.

Create Reels, Shorts, vlogs and more, even if you're new to editing. Start with free basic tools. Use templates or AI Auto Cut to shape your video, then fine-tune the captions and music. From Face Blur to split-screen layouts, edit on iPhone and iPad with VDIT.

Edit faster with AI
- Auto Cut selects and edits highlights to match your chosen video length and pace.
- Generate and style captions from speech in videos or voice recordings, processed on your device.
- Enhance video and image clarity with AI.
- Remove backgrounds to isolate your subject.
- Object Tracking makes text, stickers and picture-in-picture (PIP) layers follow moving subjects.
- Reduce video and audio noise for clearer visuals and sound.
- On devices that support Apple Intelligence, use Image Playground images in your edits.

Start with templates
- Search for a template in your style, then add your clips.
- Arrange photos and videos together with split-screen layouts.

From basic edits to precise control
- Trim, split, merge, crop, rotate, reorder and reverse clips, or freeze a frame.
- Fine-tune motion with speed controls, speed curves, transitions, keyframes and stabilization.
- Layer videos and images with PIP, masks, chroma key and blending.
- Set the mood with a library of 160+ filters and effects, imported color presets (LUTs), auto correction, white balance and detailed color adjustments.

Text, stickers and blur
- Choose from 140+ caption/title styles, plus fonts, handwritten looks and text animations.
- Style selected characters with color, bold, italic, underline or strikethrough.
- Animate stickers and PIP, draw on videos with Live Drawing, and create graphics with shapes and layers.
- Blur faces automatically with on-device face detection, blur moving subjects, apply blur effects, or blur outside a selected area.

Music and audio
- Use 300+ background music tracks, plus sound effects in commercial projects.
- Import music and audio, record voiceovers or extract audio from videos.
- Create narration with text-to-speech (TTS). Boost audio volume up to 500%.
- Beat Points detects and marks music beats on the timeline so you can align clips and overlays.
- Export audio as M4A, MP3 or WAV at your preferred quality.

Save and share your way
- Choose aspect ratio presets for Reels, Stories, TikTok, Shorts and YouTube.
- Export video, GIFs, images and audio.
- Use carousel export to save selected clips as individual videos for Instagram carousels.
- Save videos at up to 4K and 60fps (4K with Pro).
- Set resolution, frame rate, MP4/MOV, H.264/H.265, bitrate and HDR. Lower bitrate to reduce file size.
- Export and import project files to keep editing on iPhone and iPad.

More ways to edit
- On iOS 27, use Siri and Shortcuts to open editing tools and continue existing projects.
- VoiceOver and Voice Control are supported.
Feature availability may vary by OS, device and language.

VDIT Pro
VDIT Pro (in-app purchase) includes AI Auto Cut, Auto Captions, chroma key, TTS, Live Drawing and other advanced tools, plus premium content. Get QHD/4K, high-quality GIF/image, audio and individual-clip exports, plus watermark removal.

- See available plans, prices and free trial eligibility on the in-app purchase screen.
- Subscriptions are billed to your Apple Account. If a free trial is offered, billing starts when it ends.
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends.

it.name: Adobe Fresco: Draw & Paint App
it.d:
Adobe Fresco is a free, professional drawing and painting app made for everyone. Built for iPad and iPhone with Apple Pencil Pro compatibility, Fresco offers powerful features and thousands of brushes to help you create your next masterpiece.

CREATE & SHARE YOUR ARTWORK
Take your artwork to the next level with Fresco’s suite of animation tools, visual effects, and expansive brush library. Perfect your artwork with unlimited layers, and easily export and share your work with multiple export presets, including process time-lapses. You can even mark your content as generative AI-free with Fresco’s Content Credentials feature.

QUICK ANIMATION TOOLS
Animate your artwork with frame-by-frame animation and motion paths. Dynamic, easy-to-use features and a library of preset options let you add movement with just a tap. Easily export and share your creations as GIF and MP4 files.

THOUSANDS OF BRUSHES
Make your masterpiece with our library of exclusive brush packs, completely free. Discover blendable raster brushes, realistic paints and pencils, and sharp, non-pixelating vector brushes. You can also easily import your favorite Photoshop brushes.

EASY TO USE
Fresco provides professional digital art tools at an accessible level. Easily create perfect shapes with Snap to Shape. Draw stunning symmetrical artwork with rotational and reflective symmetry guides. Apply effects from our library of Elements to enhance your artwork. Speed up and optimize your coloring with Paint Inside mode.

Fresco is the premier, professional digital art tool for artists of all levels. Download today and start creating for free.

OTHER FEATURES & TOOLS
• Color palettes – Fresco automatically creates a color palette when you import any artwork.
• Recolor your artwork — Photoshop-like adjustment layers allow you to easily test and apply changes to brightness, hue/saturation, and color balance.
• Text — Add stylish text to your artwork using Adobe’s expansive collection of free fonts.
• Multicolor swatches — Pick up the elements of any piece of artwork to paint with multiple colors at once using any pixel brush or Live Brush.
• Magic wand, liquify and free transform — Easily select your artwork with the magic wand tool and use liquify and other free transform tools to alter any object.
• Learn content — Strengthen your skills with step-by-step tutorials and built-in video tutorials.
• Drawing aids — Trace along the edges of a ruler, circle, square or polygon with a brush or fill inside or outside of a shape with the Fill tool.
• Guides & grids — Align your artwork easily and create perspective grids from an imported photo.
• Seamless integration with Photoshop and Illustrator — Open documents in either app without importing or exporting. Send your layered vector illustrations directly to Illustrator for desktop or iPad for finishing touches.

it.name: TikTok - Videos, Shop & LIVE
it.d:
TikTok is the global discovery platform for videos, streaming on LIVE, shopping, and more. Our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. Over a billion people come to TikTok to share what they love, learn new things, and find ideas that make everyday life more interesting.

Your experience on TikTok is built around what you're into, not who you know. Just watch, like, and scroll to discover videos, creators, and communities you are delighted to discover. From quick recipes to game highlights, fashion tips to music and trending sounds, your For You feed reflects your current interests and changes based on what surprises and inspires you.

Creating is simple. Capture and post everyday moments and turn them into something special with easy editing tools, effects, sounds, and music. Use our free library of sounds and music in your videos, plus filters and creative tools that help your content stand out. On TikTok, anyone can create, and ideas that inspire pick up momentum.

TikTok is also where discovery becomes part of your everyday life. Find creators to follow, new ideas to try, and products you will love from small businesses and brands around the world. TikTok offers more than 50 preset safety and privacy features, from private accounts and content filters to screen time tools and Family Pairing, so you can choose an experience that works for you. TikTok provides extra support for teens and families on the app, letting you set time and content preferences that feel right for your family. 

■ Personalized discovery
A For You feed that learns what you enjoy. Discover videos, creators, LIVE streams, shopping, and communities based on what you watch, like, and share.
■ Entertainment, learning, and everything in between
Comedy, gaming, DIY, beauty, sports, music, lifestyle, education, and more. Find content that makes you laugh, think, and try something new.
■ Simple, powerful creation tools
Record in clips, pause and resume, trim and merge, add text and stickers, and fine tune your video without leaving the app.
■ Sounds, music, and effects
Use our free library of sounds and music in your videos, plus filters, effects, and creative tools that help you express yourself and make your videos stand out.
■ A global community of creators
Follow your favorite creators and discover new voices every day. Share your own story or support the people who inspire you.
■ Discover and shop with TikTok Shop
Explore trending products, exclusive deals, and seamless shopping experiences inspired by creators and brands you love, all in one place. Shop directly from videos, LIVE, and the Shop tab, track your orders, and enjoy a safe, secure shopping experience.
■ Go LIVE and connect in real time
Start a LIVE to chat with your community, share moments as they happen, and unlock special features and benefits where available.
■ Tools to shape your experience
Use more than 50 safety and privacy features, from private accounts and content filters to screen time tools, Family Pairing, and other controls, to choose how TikTok works for you and your family.

Ready to see what you discover next? Download TikTok to start watching, creating, and exploring your world in a new way.

Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the selected plan. Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase.

it.name: Morpholio Trace - Sketch CAD
it.d:
SKETCH, DESIGN, CREATE 
Trace is the ALL-IN-ONE design & architecture app. Awarded “Best App,” Trace is a truly unique drawing tool that allows you to easily develop ideas in layers, communicate via drawing markup, and work fluidly through ALL phases of the design process. Ideal for architects, interior designers, landscape architects, industrial designers, urban planners, lighting designers, engineers, or members of any creative culture, Trace lets you create intelligent sketches & drawings to meet all of your design needs. Draw on top of images, PDFs, maps, photos, drawing sets, 3D models, background templates, and more TO SCALE using exceptional designer tools, brushes and pens. Bring new life to your design process and transform your workflow with the ease, flexibility and the magic of digital hand sketching.

______________


THINGS YOU CAN DO:

DESIGN
• Develop ideas, options & concepts
• Sketch buildings & objects
• Layout home, office & landscape renovations 

MARKUP
• Drawing sets & PDFs
• Construction site photos
• Presentations, renderings or images

DRAW
• Floor plans, sections & elevations to scale
• Site plans & landscaping 
• Illustrations & presentation images

WORK
• Make & export drawing sets
• Scale & measure drawings or images
• Organize by project

______________

FREE FEATURES INCLUDE: 
-Up to 5 Projects
-Basic Pens & Brushes
-Layers
-Layer Manager
-Scale Pen
-Paper Unbound
-Export Images, PDFs or Sets 
-Sketch Recording
-Instant Scale
-Scale Ruler
-Color Palette Maker

PLUS SUBSCRIPTION FEATURES
Also Includes
-All Basic Features
-Full Pens & Brushes
-Up to 20 Projects
-Magic Lasso
-Super Ruler
-Scale Triangle
-Scale Protractor
-Stencils
-PDF Markup and Manager

PRO SUBSCRIPTION FEATURES 
Also Includes
-All Basic & Plus Features
-Unlimited Projects 
-Folders
-Perspective Tools
-Maps to Scale
-Smart Fill
-AR Perspective Finder
-AR SketchWalk
-Sketch Over 3D Models
-PSD Export

______________

 SUBSCRIPTION INFO:
One subscription gives you access to both your iPhone and iPad. 

Work like a PRO. Morpholio Trace subscription plans are available in the following options:
•TracePlus
•TracePro

All payments are controlled and managed by Apple. If you are offered and activate a free trial, your Apple ID account will be charged only at the end of your free trial period for the subscription unless canceled at least one day before the end of the free trial period. Your Subscription will automatically renew and your Apple ID account will be charged unless your Subscription is cancelled at least 24-hours before the renewal date. No commitment. You can cancel your free trial as well as manage or cancel your Subscriptions at any time by going to your Apple ID account in the Apple Settings app.

Privacy policy: http://www.morpholioapps.com/privacy/
Terms of use: http://www.morpholioapps.com/terms/

______________


JOIN US: 

We would be thrilled to have Morpholio Trace be a part of your creative process. We hope you enjoy Trace and if there are any specific ways it could be improved for your use, please send us your feedback at https://www.morpholioapps.com/support/

Capture unique, honest, inspiring photos like the Pros in a fun, playful camera.

SUPER RAW™
No AI or over-processed photos. Just natural grain, sharper images, & film-like exposures. Save Raw digital negative files (DNG) for processing in other tools like Darkroom, Lightroom, or Photoshop. Or capture using Apple's professional-level ProRaw.

SKIP THE EDITS
From snap to share. !Camera is the first camera app to enable professional color grading with 3D LUTs (”lookup tables”) used in high-end workflows by professional photographers to achieve realistic film simulations and unique cinematic looks. Use !Camera’s presets, add LUTs from your favorite creators, or make & import your own! New Styles and pro collaborations released every season. 

MAKE IT YOURS
Customize every part of your camera to fit your vibe. Share colorways with others.

HDR
Extend your photo’s dynamic range with HDR to save additional highlight detail and color depth.

LOVE THE FEEL
Click. Tick. Snap. First fully-3D camera interface with dynamic lighting, sounds, & custom haptics that evokes the feel of holding a real camera.

PRO CONTROL
Use Auto mode for easy captures or switch to Manual for full control over exposure, shutter speed, ISO, white balance, and focus with pro-level tools like focus peaking, histogram, and zebra stripes. 

ONE-TAP FAST
From lock screen to first snap in under 1 second. Add shortcuts to your lock screen, home screen, widgets, camera control, control settings, wherever.

100% PRIVATE
We collect nothing. We store nothing. We share nothing.

it.name: Delta - Game Emulator
it.d:
Delta is an all-in-one emulator for iOS and iPadOS. Delta builds upon the strengths of its predecessor, GBA4iOS, while expanding to include support for more game systems such as NES, SNES, N64, Nintendo DS, and Sega Genesis.

FEATURES

Supported Game Systems
• Nintendo Entertainment System
• Super Nintendo Entertainment System
• Nintendo 64
• Game Boy (Color)
• Game Boy Advance
• Nintendo DS
• Sega Genesis

Online Multiplayer
• Play online-compatible Nintendo DS games with friends around the world!
• Connect via community Nintendo WFC servers
• Choose one of the default servers, or provide a custom DNS

Controller Support
• Nintendo Switch Pro controllers, Joy-Cons
• Nintendo Switch Online controllers (NES, SNES, N64)
• PS4, PS5
• Xbox One S, Xbox Series X
• MFi game controllers
• Bluetooth & wired keyboards

RetroAchievements
• Sign in with your RetroAchievements account to earn achievements in any supported game
• Supports Hardcore mode, which disables loading save states and using cheats
• Shows your achievement progress when launching a game

Save States
• Save and load save states for any game from the pause menu.
• Lock save states to prevent them from being accidentally overwritten.
• Automatically makes backup save states to ensure you never lose your progress.
• Support for “Quick Saves,” save states that can be quickly saved/loaded with a single button press (requires external controller).

Cheats
• Supports various types of cheat codes for each supported system:
• NES: Game Genie
• SNES: Game Genie, Pro Action Replay
• N64: GameShark
• GBC: Game Genie, GameShark
• GBA: Action Replay, Code Breaker, GameShark
• DS: Action Replay
• Genesis: Action Replay, Game Genie

Delta Sync
• Sync your games, game saves, save states, cheats, controller skins, and controller mappings between devices.
• View version histories of everything you sync and optionally restore them to earlier versions.
• Supports both Google Drive and Dropbox.

Custom Controller Skins
• Beautiful built-in controller skins for all systems.
• Import controller skins made by others, or even make your own to share with the world!
• Supports animated buttons for even more immersion when playing games

Hold Button
• Choose buttons for Delta to hold down on your behalf, freeing up your thumbs to press other buttons instead.
• Perfect for games that typically require one button be held down constantly (e.g. run button in Mario games, or the A button in Mario Kart).

Fast Forward
• Speed through slower parts of games by running the game much faster than normal.
• Easily enable or disable from the pause menu, or optionally with a mapped button on an external controller.
• Customize speed per-game by long-pressing Fast Forward option in pause menu.

3D/Haptic Touch
• Use 3D or Haptic Touch to “peek” at games, save states, and cheat codes.
• App icon shortcuts allow quick access to your most recently played games, or optionally customize the shortcuts to always include certain games.

Game Artwork
• Automatically displays appropriate box art for imported games.
• Change a game’s artwork to anything you want, or select from the built-in game artwork database.

Misc.
• Gyroscope support (WarioWare: Twisted! only)
• Microphone support (DS only)
• Support for delta:// URL scheme to jump directly into a specific game.

Delta Terms of Use: https://altstore.io/terms

**Delta is in no way affiliated with Nintendo. The name "Nintendo" and all associated game console names are registered trademarks of Nintendo Co., Ltd.**

AI Video Editor:
Take advantage of our full AI video editor by streamlining video creation and transforming the styles of your videos into extraordinary content.

• Green Screen/Chroma Key compositing.

Creative platform:
• Remake trending edits with a tap from our community feed

• Share your creativity and own templates with the community

• Glitches, Rays, Flare, Prism, Defocus, Colorfy, Pixelate, Chromatic Aberration and more!

• Mix videos & images together to create double exposures and artistic looks.
• Layer-based editing! Add videos, effects, text and images then reorder them however you like.

• Apply seamless, cinematic transitions to your clips such as Zoom, Fade, Dissolve.

Precise Video Editing & Rich Possibilities:
• Clip editing: trim, split, duplicate, flip, mirror, transform.
• Color correction: adjust brightness, contrast, saturation and more.
• Change aspect ratio and fit clips automatically.
• Customize the color of your background.
• Blur backgrounds.


Sound Editing:
• Over 100 sound effects!
• Dub audio and voice overs.
• Control audio volume and apply equalizer presets.
• Sync videos to the rhythm of the music.

And More!
• In-app stock footage, including green videos and overlays!

• Projects are auto-saved. Work on them whenever, wherever.

Download Videoleap now and discover the power of effortless video creation right from your iPhone!

it.name: Adobe Photoshop: Photo Editor
it.d:
Photoshop on mobile is an image editor app with a wide selection of free photo editing tools. Whether you are just getting started or already know Photoshop, shape every detail to create something that's uniquely yours. 

What can Photoshop on mobile do? 
- Add new objects with AI
- Blur or remove backgrounds 
- Replace backgrounds and remove unwanted objects 
- Quickly resize and crop photos in seconds 
- Retouch, refine, and perfect your images with targeted adjustments 
- Combine multiple images to create high-quality collages
- Perfect your passion projects and create unique graphic designs.

Edit images with AI Assistant 
- Describe what you want to do, and the AI Assistant will bring your ideas to life, while still giving you the flexibility to adjust and refine every detail. 
- AI Assistant’s smart suggestions bring personalized edit ideas tailored to the content of your image, letting you explore new possibilities that push your creativity further.
- Learn step by step with guided explanations. AI Assistant teaches you new tools, suggests techniques, and helps build real skills with every photo edit. 

How to remove or replace backgrounds with Photoshop?
- Select the backgrounds with the Tap Select tool. 
- Remove backgrounds or replace them with another image, create AI-generated backgrounds with Generative Fill, or select from our large library of Adobe Stock images, textures, filters, and patterns. 
- Adjust the background, brightness, effects, or vibrancy to bring your creations to life. 

How to remove unwanted objects or distractions from photos with Photoshop? 
- Remove objects from your images with Generative Fill. 
- Brush out blemishes, spots, or small imperfections in seconds using the Spot Healing Brush.

How to personalize a photo, image or design with Photoshop?
- Create stunning visual images that are uniquely yours by blending photos, graphics, text, utilizing effects, and more. 
- Combine unique elements from your own photos with a selection of free Adobe Stock images, to create elevated images. 
- Retouch photos as you like, by selecting an object or person with the Tap Select tool. 
- Remove objects in your image or control how they come together with layers. 
- Use text prompts to ideate, create new assets, and jumpstart your creativity using Generate Image. 
- Adjust the color of anything, like your shirt, pants or shoes, using adjustment layers.

What premium features does Photoshop on mobile have? 
- Easily remove entire objects just by brushing over it, and have the background filled in automatically with the Remove Tool. 
- Seamlessly fill selected portions of an image with content sampled from other parts of the image with Content Aware Fill. 
- Quickly and precisely select people and objects like plants, cars, and more with enhanced precision using Object Select. 
- 100 generative credits to add, expand, design or remove objects and people from your images.  
- Ideate, create new assets, and expand your creativity using the latest features like Generate Image. 
- Change unique layer interactions to control transparency, color effects, filters, and add style to your images with Advanced Blend Modes. 
- Quickly and easily select an object or area of your image based on similar colors and tones with the Magic Wand Tool, and retouch photos further with precise adjustments. 
- Export in additional file formats (PSD, TIFF, JPG, PNG) and export options for print quality and compression. 

Facial retouch feature processes data on the device only. No data is stored, processed or retained by Adobe or third parties.

Do not sell or share my personal information: www.adobe.com/go/ca-rights-linkfree

it.name: Photoshop Express Photo Editor
it.d:
PHOTO EDITING MADE FUN AND EASY FOR EVERYONE

Tap into your creativity on the go with Photoshop Express—the fun, fast, and easy picture and video editor. Discover seamless one-touch photo transformations and simple video editing—used by millions of creative individuals. 

Photoshop Express delivers a wide and diverse selection of features and aesthetics at your fingertips. Create stand out photo collage images, and fix and enhance your share-worthy moments for stunning social content. Unlock unlimited possibilities with Photoshop Express Premium!

PHOTOSHOP EXPRESS FEATURES

PHOTO ENHANCER
- Select from an array of photo editing tools and presets
- Apply red eye corrector, dehazing, and aesthetic filters
- Crop photo dimensions and fix crooked or distorted camera angles
- Erase background noise and smooth over imperfections with a few simple swipes
- Retouch photos with just a tap, and fix portraits and selfies in seconds
- Create an amazing photo collage with ready-to-use grid layouts

VIDEO EDITOR
- Trim clips, adjust speed, recolor, resize, and rotate for high resolution video exports right from your phone
- Add multiple videos from your camera roll to combine into one video
- Access thousands of music tracks to get the perfect mood for your edit

PERSONALIZED IMAGE DESIGN
- Add text to your photos from a wide array of fonts and layouts
- Use our image editor to add personalized touches to your photos
- Create a photo design with camera filters, stamps, custom watermarks, and more

UPLOAD & SHARE PHOTOS EASILY
- Upload images from multiple source formats (including RAW and TIFF)
- Use our photo editing app as a social and Instagram editor for photos
- Share and export to all your favorite social media channels including Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, Facebook, Line, and Telegram, to inspire others

PREMIUM
Upgrade to Photoshop Express Premium to access extra, exclusive features and more precise editing controls.
Photoshop Express is the photo and video editor app for users of all experience levels. Create and fix fun, shareable memes, personalized pic collages, and stickers.

it.name: Picsew - Screenshot Stitching
it.d:
An App Store Editors’ Choice app, also recommended by MacStories and TidBITS.

More than screenshot stitching. Picsew brings scrollshots and photo stitching together in one focused, flexible workspace.

Turn chats, articles, receipts, webpages, notes, and comment threads into clean scrollshots. Then use the same app to arrange travel photos, recipes, outfits, tutorials, product comparisons, before-and-after stories, and social posts into polished vertical or horizontal images.

Whether you are saving something for later or creating something worth sharing, Picsew helps you move from a folder full of images to one finished piece—without tedious cropping, manual alignment, or switching between several apps.

SCROLLSHOTS WITHOUT THE BUSYWORK
• Scroll through content in any app and Picsew turns it into one complete scrollshot.
• Save an entire webpage in one step when you need the full article, guide, receipt, or order page.
• Select existing screenshots and let Picsew detect the overlapping areas and stitch them automatically.
• Fine-tune every join yourself when a complex layout needs a more precise result.
• Keep long conversations, research, instructions, and reference material together instead of scattered across your photo library.

TURN PHOTOS INTO A STORY
• Arrange photos vertically for a long-form post, step-by-step tutorial, travel diary, recipe, or product showcase.
• Join photos horizontally for comparisons, panoramas, timelines, and before-and-after presentations.
• Combine screenshots and regular photos in the same project when your story needs both context and visuals.
• Work with up to 300 images at once and keep the finished result in high resolution.

MAKE EVERY IMAGE READY TO SHARE
• Hide names, faces, account details, addresses, and other private information with blur or mosaic.
• Add text, arrows, shapes, annotations, watermarks, and borders to explain what matters.
• Place screenshots inside polished device mockups for presentations, portfolios, app updates, and social media.
• Adjust the result before export so you can share a finished image instead of sending it through another editor.

EXPORT IT YOUR WAY
• Save a high-resolution image when quality matters.
• Export as PDF for documents, instructions, archives, and easy sharing.
• Split an extra-long image into neatly sized slices for social platforms and messaging apps.

Picsew fits into the way you already work. Open it from the Share Sheet, jump in from a widget, and navigate with VoiceOver. From a quick scrollshot to a carefully arranged photo story, the tools you need stay together in one app.

it.name: TikTok - Videos, Shop & LIVE
it.d:
TikTok is the global discovery platform for videos, streaming on LIVE, shopping, and more. Our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. Over a billion people come to TikTok to share what they love, learn new things, and find ideas that make everyday life more interesting.

Your experience on TikTok is built around what you're into, not who you know. Just watch, like, and scroll to discover videos, creators, and communities you are delighted to discover. From quick recipes to game highlights, fashion tips to music and trending sounds, your For You feed reflects your current interests and changes based on what surprises and inspires you.

Creating is simple. Capture and post everyday moments and turn them into something special with easy editing tools, effects, sounds, and music. Use our free library of sounds and music in your videos, plus filters and creative tools that help your content stand out. On TikTok, anyone can create, and ideas that inspire pick up momentum.

TikTok is also where discovery becomes part of your everyday life. Find creators to follow, new ideas to try, and products you will love from small businesses and brands around the world. TikTok offers more than 50 preset safety and privacy features, from private accounts and content filters to screen time tools and Family Pairing, so you can choose an experience that works for you. TikTok provides extra support for teens and families on the app, letting you set time and content preferences that feel right for your family. 

■ Personalized discovery
A For You feed that learns what you enjoy. Discover videos, creators, LIVE streams, shopping, and communities based on what you watch, like, and share.
■ Entertainment, learning, and everything in between
Comedy, gaming, DIY, beauty, sports, music, lifestyle, education, and more. Find content that makes you laugh, think, and try something new.
■ Simple, powerful creation tools
Record in clips, pause and resume, trim and merge, add text and stickers, and fine tune your video without leaving the app.
■ Sounds, music, and effects
Use our free library of sounds and music in your videos, plus filters, effects, and creative tools that help you express yourself and make your videos stand out.
■ A global community of creators
Follow your favorite creators and discover new voices every day. Share your own story or support the people who inspire you.
■ Discover and shop with TikTok Shop
Explore trending products, exclusive deals, and seamless shopping experiences inspired by creators and brands you love, all in one place. Shop directly from videos, LIVE, and the Shop tab, track your orders, and enjoy a safe, secure shopping experience.
■ Go LIVE and connect in real time
Start a LIVE to chat with your community, share moments as they happen, and unlock special features and benefits where available.
■ Tools to shape your experience
Use more than 50 safety and privacy features, from private accounts and content filters to screen time tools, Family Pairing, and other controls, to choose how TikTok works for you and your family.

Ready to see what you discover next? Download TikTok to start watching, creating, and exploring your world in a new way.

Note: If you subscribe via Apple, payment will be charged to App Store Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the selected plan. Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase.

Learn more about our safety tools, resources, and policies at the TikTok Safety Center: https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en

it.name: IPTV Smarters Player Expert
it.d:
IPTV Expert: The Ultimate IPTV Player for Seamless Streaming
Enjoy your IPTV across every screen. IPTV Expert supports your playlists and providers, while your Expert account keeps sources, favorites, recently watched content, and playback progress in sync across Apple TV, iPhone, iPad, Mac, and other supported platforms.

ONE ACCOUNT. ONE PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION.
Sign in once and your Premium access follows you across every supported Expert platform.
An Expert account is required for synchronization. Syncing favorites, recently watched content and playback progress is part of Premium. EPG, replay and playback availability depend on your source and device.

Why Choose IPTV Expert?
• Easy Playlist Import: Effortlessly import M3U/M3U8 playlists via URL, Xtream Codes API, or Stalker Portal.
• Superior Sorting: Automatically categorizes your playlists into Live TV, Series, and Movies for easy navigation.
• AirPlay and Chromecast support
• Electronic Program Guide (EPG): Stay updated with detailed EPG and never miss your favorite shows again!
• Multiscreen: Watch up to 4 live channels at once, choose which one you hear, put one in full screen or rearrange the grid. The number of simultaneous channels depends on the connections allowed by your provider.
• Parental Controls (Premium): Protect channels, movies, series or entire categories of each playlist with a 4-digit PIN. The PIN is requested before playback; once entered, protected content stays unlocked for 5 minutes. With an Expert account, your PIN and protections sync across all your devices, and a forgotten PIN can be reset by email.
• Offline Viewing: Download videos and watch them anytime, anywhere without an internet connection.
• Replay Feature: Missed something? Use the replay feature to catch up on missed moments.
• Subtitles Support: Understand every dialogue with subtitles support.
• Multiple Sources: Add several IPTV providers for a diverse viewing experience.
• Favorites Feature: Quickly access your top picks.
• Stunning UI: Navigate through a beautiful interface with a captivating dark mode.
• Series Browsing: Easily find and binge-watch your favorite series.
• Customizable Viewing: Filter by language, search for videos, and watch in portrait or landscape mode without glitches.

IPTV Expert Key Features:
• Comprehensive IPTV Support: Works seamlessly with all IPTV services and providers.
• OTT Streaming: Enjoy OTT streaming like never before.
• M3U8 and M3U Support: Full support for M3U8 and M3U playlists.
• SmartTV Compatibility: Perfect for smarttv and other smart devices.
• Xtream Codes API: Easy integration with Xtream Codes API.
• Stalker Portal: Full compatibility with Stalker Portal for added flexibility.
• Live Streaming: Uninterrupted live TV streaming.
• Smart Interface: A smart interface designed for ease of use.
• High-Quality Streaming: Enjoy high-quality streaming with minimal buffering.

Important Note:
IPTV Expert does not provide media content. Users need to add a playlist from their IPTV provider.

Missing a feature? We’d love to hear from you! Send us your suggestions.

it.name: Labbet: Photo & Video Editing
it.d:
10M+ EXPORTED PHOTOS & VIDEOS.
Labbet is a creative lab for film‑inspired, beautifully nostalgic images. Rated 4.8 from thousands of reviews and trusted by a community that has exported over 10 million photos, it's a photo and video editing app for creators with an analog soul who value texture, mood, grain, and honest expression over glossy perfection.

WHAT LABBET DOES
Labbet combines simple, precise tools with film‑inspired looks, grain, dust, and borders so you can create timeless visuals fast — in photo and video. Effects like authentic textures, glow, motion blur, and soft vignettes give your work a tactile, film‑like presence that stands apart from standard mobile edits.

FILM‑INSPIRED TOOLS
Shape light, color, and depth with clean, focused editing controls that keep you in your creative flow — whether you're working on a still or a moving image.

ANALOG FILM FILTERS AND VINTAGE EFFECTS
Film‑style filters and vintage color tones for retro, nostalgic, and analog‑inspired photos and video – from soft, faded palettes to rich, contrasty film looks.

AUTHENTIC GRAIN, DUST & TEXTURES
Realistic film grain, dust, scratches, paper textures, and light leaks add depth and tactility so your work feels like physical prints and projected film, not flat digital files.

FILM‑REAL BORDERS AND FRAMES
Analog borders inspired by film edges, contact sheets, and vintage prints that frame your stories and give each image a finished, archival feel.

VIDEO EDITING WITH AN ANALOG SOUL
Bring the full Labbet treatment to motion. Apply your favorite looks, layer grain and textures, shape color with the same precision as on stills, and export clips that feel hand‑made rather than algorithm‑smoothed.

ARTISTIC TEXT TOOL
Minimal, refined typography and unique text overlays that blend into your image, ideal for visual storytelling, covers, posters, and brand‑driven layouts.

CORE PHOTO AND VIDEO TOOLS AND PRESETS
Fine‑tune exposure, contrast, color, and detail, or start with one‑click film presets. Save your favorite combinations of filters, textures, and effects so your analog style stays consistent across photo and video.

WHO LABBET IS FOR
Labbet is designed for creatives with a point of view - drawn to filmic tones, analog textures, and images that feel lived in. A space where your aesthetic instincts are respected and refined.

We believe images and video should feel like something, not just look like something. The most memorable work carries the marks of real film: a hint of noise, a strange color shift, a light leak that somehow tells the truth. Labbet exists to make that kind of creative risk simple, fast, and deeply enjoyable.

HOW WE ARE DIFFERENT
Where many editors chase flawless, glossy surfaces, Labbet is built around beautifully vintage, analog‑first editing. Our tools are opinionated yet easy to use: serious control without desktop‑software overwhelm. We focus on how highlights roll off, how grain sits in a shadow, how a moving image breathes – so you stay in your creative flow.

LABBET+
With Labbet+ you unlock all film‑inspired filters, textures, borders, tools, and effects across photo and video. Labbet+ is available as a Yearly plan (subscription) or Lifetime (one‑time purchase).
Prices vary depending on the country. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto‑renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto‑renewal can be turned off in Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Transform your words and images into stunning AI generated art! All you need to do is enter a prompt, pick an art style - and watch DaVinci bring your ideas to life in seconds!

DaVinci is a state-of-the-art AI Photo Generator app. Using the latest artificial intelligence technology, it can create unique artworks, photos and images based solely on your descriptions.

Here are some cool things you can ask DaVinci Art AI to paint for you:
• Digital artworks
• Tattoo designs
• Signature Generator 
• Logo designs
• Realistic AI-generated photos
• AI-generated avatars of you
... and much more!

Key Features 
► AI Art Generator
Our AI art generator, allows you to craft unique and captivating art drawings in seconds. Simply type in your text or upload a photo to start generating AI-generated art.

► Pick from a variety of art styles
DaVinci Art AI Photo Generator offers a variety of art styles to choose from. Experiment with different styles, from pencil sketches to mind-blowing photorealism, and discover the one that best transforms your vision into stunning AI art.

 ► Create unique artwork for your home or room.
Looking for the perfect artwork for your room or home? Describe your idea to AI Art Generator, and it will craft a one-of-a-kind artwork tailored just for you. If you love the result, you can download it in high resolution and have it printed to proudly display in your home.

► AI Tattoo Generator
With DaVinci Art AI, you can generate unique tattoo designs within seconds. Simply type in your idea, and let our powerful AI art generator work its magic. The AI tattoo generator feature produces amazing and one-of-a-kind tattoo designs. 

► Signature Generator 
Looking for the perfect signature creator? DaVinci Art AI allows you to create, generate, and personalize your signature effortlessly. Whether for business documents, emails, or personal branding, our signature maker lets you craft a stylish and professional signature in seconds.

► Logo Generator – AI-Powered Logo Design
Need a logo generator to bring your brand identity to life? DaVinci Art AI’s logo maker transforms your ideas into stunning logos with just a few clicks. 

► AI Photo Generator
The AI Photo Generator feature can produce realistic, high-resolution photos and images from your prompts. You'll be amazed at how lifelike and realistic the AI-generated photos appear.

► AI Avatar Generator
Create avatar versions of yourself with the latest artificial intelligence technology. Simply upload your photos, select your desired styles, and watch DaVinci work its magic. 

► Share your Creations
If you've created something you love using DaVinci’s powerful AI-art generator, you can directly share your masterpieces from the app to other platforms.

Creating AI-generated art has become effortless and readily accessible from mobile devices.

No brushes, pencils, or art supplies are needed to craft stunning art now; only your imagination. Sit back and let DaVinci Art AI become the artist behind your vision!

it.name: Lampa — Digital & Film Camera
it.d:
Lampa is a camera app for those who seek honest images and an analog look. It helps you get the most natural images without HDR or AI-driven effects and make soft, nostalgic photos and videos. The result feels balanced and film-like, ready straight from the camera without post-editing.

NATURALLY PROCESSED PHOTO AND VIDEO
— Minimal processing due to our own In-House Image Capture Engine. Lampa captures RAW data and processes it immediately with profiles. You get a result that can’t be achieved by editing photos taken with a standard camera.
— True-to-life light depth, natural skin tones, and soft details.

FILM AND DIGICAM COLOR PROFILES
— Carefully tuned profiles inspired by 35mm film and compact digital cameras. Each profile is built around a specific tonal idea, from soft nostalgic tones to crisp digicam highlights and subtle halation.
— Photo and video have a finished look, no editing required.

VIDEO RECORDING
— Video is naturally processed* and color graded with color profiles and dynamic grain.
— Custom settings include up to 4K 60FPS and stabilization options.
* Fully natural video processing is available on devices that support Log recording — iPhone 15/16/17 Pro

IMAGE EDITING
Adjust profiles and exposure after shooting. With RAW data, you can push or pull a lot of detail.

RAW EXPORT
Export RAW files for additional flexibility in external editors.

INTUITIVE CAMERA INTERFACE
Intuitive gestures and one-hand control. Quick access from the Lock Screen and Control Center.

100% PRIVATE
We respect your privacy and do not collect or store your photos or any personal information.

LAMPA MEMBERSHIP
Membership is available as a subscription or lifetime purchase and unlocks:
– Unlimited captures
– Image redevelopment
– RAW export
– Access to all color profiles
– Ongoing updates

The free version includes 5 captures per day with limited functionality.

For feedback: lampa.camera@gmail.com
