Transform your images with Photoleap, the most powerful photo editing app on the market! Whether you’re an artist, or you just simply love to edit & create, you'll be blown away by all the creative possibilities packed into this sophisticated photo editing app. 

Check out Photoleap's new features!

* AI image generator to create the photos you dream of
* First-in-class AI tools will help you create astounding digital art, just by typing the idea you’re imagining
* Speed up your photo editing with a powerful AI baseline creation that you can work off of & add more photo effects to
* Add motion to your photos! Create live photos with 3D effects.
* New photo animator tools to edit pictures & make your photos come alive with effects and 3D edits. 

Use your AI art creations as the cover art for an album, a selfie background, or just to share with your friends. Go wherever your imagination takes you, & continue to edit your creations with Photoleap’s advanced photo editing tools. 

From layers and blending modes, to photo filters and effects, brushes, fonts, tonal adjustments, film, black and white and duo presets, with Photoleap photo editor, you’ll turn the ideas in your head into brilliant art right on your phone. Unleash your creativity and start transforming photos into works of art.

Creative Combinations
• Superior photo mixing. Superimpose images, create double exposures and surreal iPhone art
• Sophisticated Layers! Combining photos made simple, plus the ability to re-edit each layer at any time
• Photo Blending: Adjust blending modes, transparency, and transform (perspective change) images
• Change the background of your photo with your fingertips

Artistic Masterpieces
• Use the collage maker to collage photos together to tell a story
• Add text to photos, draw, or doodle on your image
• Utilize cool tools to create graphic designs, street art, abstract and contemporary masterpieces
• Use our one of a kind photo filters to set mood
• Set the mood in any season with our sky photo editor 
• Create professional-looking social media posts, flyers or posters for your business
• Have some fun and easily create memes that will keep you laughing
• New packs designed just for you, added all the time: light leaks, filters for pictures, elements, stickers for photos, styles, backdrops, fonts, effects, and brushes.

Image Correction & More
• Masking built-in to nearly every tool, with smart new quick select brushes to save time
• Control & adjust it all: tonality, color, grain, vignette, fade, structure, intensity and much more
• Colorize images and apply beautiful gradients with duo filters
• Quick blemish/object remover to get rid of defects
• Easily resize and crop images while keeping aspect ratios intact
• Blur photos for effect or privacy

Pro Editing
• RAW support
• 16 bit image depth support for high quality tonal adjustments
• You can set the size of your canvas
• Not done editing? Photo sessions are auto-saved, simply continue later

it.name: Picsart AI Photo Editor, Video
it.d:
Ignite your creative potential with Picsart — the all-in-one AI photo editor, AI video editor, and design studio that’s free and easy to use. From business designs to AI art, go from inspiration to creation fast. Create with an AI photo generator and AI video generator, edit with an AI image editor, remove backgrounds with Background Remover (BG remover), erase objects with Object Remover (Object Eraser), apply AI effects, filters, and retouch tools, and turn ideas into designs with templates, collages, story maker, and more. Create with new image-to-video tools, AI video avatars, AI try-on, AI avatars, Gen AI Studio, AI Playground, and Picsart Persona.

MEET PICSART AURA
Chat your vision into visuals. Built on Picsart’s platform and trusted by 150M+ creators, Aura is your creative partner. From prompt to design in seconds, Aura creates, edits, and refines in one conversation. It suggests prompts, generates AI photos and AI videos, remembers chats, and lets you share sessions.
Aura combines AI models to create and edit AI images and videos. Use Nano Banana™ for image generation and video models like Veo™ (Veo 3), Kling, Runway, and Luma. Availability may vary. Trademarks belong to their owners.

KICK-START PROJECTS WITH TEMPLATES
• Use customizable templates made by professional editors.
• Create logos with AI logo maker, social posts, stories, business cards, posters, and more.

TRANSFORM DESIGNS WITH BACKGROUND REMOVER
• Remove background for clean cutouts and product shots.
• Smart Background blends seamless backdrops — a fast background changer for ads and promos.
• Remove background, refine edges, and create aesthetic styles for photo editor projects.

REMOVE OBJECTS WITH EASE
• Object Remover / Object Eraser deletes unwanted objects. 
• Remove clutter and imperfections for a clean photo.

GET CREATIVE WITH AI
• AI Image Generator / AI photo generator: turn text into AI art, images, and GIFs.
• AI video generator: create videos from text, images, or ideas in seconds.
• AI Enhance instantly boosts image quality for better photo retouch. 
• Apply stylized AI filters and AI effects to create stunning photo effects in your photo editor workflow.
• AI Replace transforms images with face swaps, hair color changes, and selfie edits.
• AI Retouch perfects portraits with advanced skin, face, and detail enhancements for flawless retouch results.
• AI Expand extends images beyond the frame.
• AI Try-On lets you experiment with outfits and styles instantly.
• AI Writer creates captions, text, and marketing copy for your content needs.
• Upload selfies to generate customized AI avatar in different styles.
• Explore new ideas in AI Playground and create faster with Gen AI Studio.

EDIT VIDEOS LIKE A PRO
• Use the easy video editor to create and edit clips with music.
• Generate and edit videos with AI video tools, effects, text, and trendy filters.
• Turn images into motion with image-to-video tools.
• Create short-form edits that shine on any platform.
• Add your best moments to a video collage.

ADD YOUR FLAVOR WITH THE STICKER MAKER
• Discover 60M+ stickers.
• Add stickers to pictures or business promos.
• Create custom stickers.

TELL YOUR STORY IN TEXT
• Add text with the Picsart Text Editor.
• Discover hundreds of classic & trendy fonts.
• Customize text styles. 

CREATE COLLAGE MAGIC (COLLAGE MAKER)
• Create fun photo collages with your favorite photos.
• Try photo grid collage or freestyle collage for mood boards and frames.

DISCOVER ENDLESS INSPIRATION
From solopreneurs to graphic design enthusiasts, AI art pioneers, and photo editors — share your ideas and get inspiration for your next project with Picsart Spaces.

UPGRADE YOUR DESIGN EXPERIENCE
Picsart Plus: premium content, templates, and extra retouch features.
Picsart Pro: more AI tools, extra team seats for small businesses, and more storage space.

it.name: Tiny Decisions: Spin Wheel
it.d:
Make small decisions the fun way.

Not sure what to eat, where to go, who starts first, or which option to choose? Add your choices to Tiny Decisions, spin the wheel, generate a random number, or flip a coin. The answer appears in seconds, turning everyday indecision into something quick and playful.

Great for:

- Choosing dinner, drinks, or weekend plans
- Picking who goes first or who pays
- Party games, Truth or Dare, and group challenges
- Giveaways, random draws, teams, and classroom picks
- Making quick choices when every option feels possible

Key features:

- Custom Wheels: Create your own wheel and edit options anytime
- Weighted Options: Adjust the chance of each option being selected
- Hide Weights: Keep the wheel looking clean and equal
- No Repeats: Perfect for draws, lists, teams, and turn-taking
- Finger Picker: Let everyone touch the screen and randomly pick a player
- Random Number Generator: Generate numbers within your own range
- Coin Flip: Get heads or tails with one tap
- Templates & Themes: Start fast and personalize the look
- Widgets & Apple Watch: Make decisions faster from your Home Screen or wrist
- iCloud Sync: Keep your wheels synced across Apple devices
- Share Wheels: Send your wheels to friends, family, or your group

Whether you are making a tiny personal choice or adding a little suspense to a group moment, Tiny Decisions helps you decide faster and makes the process more fun.

Subscription Details

Unlock premium features with a subscription via Apple. Payment is charged to your App Store Account upon purchase. Subscriptions auto-renew unless turned off 24 hours before the current period ends. Renewal charges apply within 24 hours of the period’s end based on your plan. Manage subscriptions in Account Settings.

it.name: Splash - Impostor Game
it.d:
Hey, we’re Hannes & Jeremy.

We’ve been there: Every game night starts with googling rules, grabbing pens and paper, or trying random apps. But there’s just no really good party app. So we decided to build one.

Our goal? Bring the best and most viral party games together in one place. For example: Who’s the Impostor? - you’ve probably seen it on TikTok or Insta.

Easy to learn. Quick to play. Perfect for 3 to 20 people.

Great for house parties, birthdays, or your next night with friends. Gather your crew - and have fun.

The app is free to enjoy with your friends! For some extra features, Splash Plus gives you full access with a weekly subscription. You can check out our Terms, EULA, and Privacy Policy here: https://cranberry.app/terms. 

Please note: This app is not intended for use as a drinking game and contains no alcohol-related content. It is suitable for all audiences seeking fun, social gameplay.

Cheers and enjoy the app!

Get the official YouTube app on iPhones and iPads. See what the world is watching -- from the hottest music videos to what’s popular in gaming, fashion, beauty, news, learning and more. Subscribe to channels you love, create content of your own, share with friends, and watch on any device.

Watch and subscribe

● Stay up to date on what’s popular in music, gaming, beauty, news, learning and more
● See what’s trending on YouTube and around the world on Explore
● Learn about the coolest Creators, Gamers, and Artists on the Rise (available in select countries)

Connect with the YouTube community
● Keep up with your favorites creators with Posts, Stories, Premieres, and Live streams

● Join channels that offer paid monthly memberships and support their work
● Get access to exclusive perks from the channel & become part of their members community
● Stand out in comments and live chats with a loyalty badge next to your username

● Watch videos uninterrupted by ads, while using other apps, or when the screen is locked

● Get access to YouTube Music Premium as part of your benefits

it.name: Temply: AI Video & Reels Maker
it.d:
Create Stunning Social Media Content with Temply

Temply is the ultimate video editing app for creating short-form content, perfectly designed for social media platforms. Whether you're a content creator, business owner, marketing professional, or personal user, Temply offers a comprehensive toolkit to bring your vision to life.

Why you'll love using Temply:

A smarter way to make videos with AI Creator:
• Pick your photos and clips, add a prompt, or choose from pre-made business prompt ideas, then fine tune it with template filters for style, audience, or purpose. In seconds, you'll have a beautifully crafted, effective video with music, designed to boost your brand’s performance.

Templates that Inspire:
• 600+ Templates: Choose from a diverse range of templates tailored for Reels, TikTok, Stories, and more.
• AI-Powered "Created For You": Instantly generate engaging, trendy videos using your personal media.
• Beat-Synced Templates: Effortlessly create videos synchronized to music beats.

Tools to Enhance Your Content:
• Royalty-Free Music: Access 600+ soundtracks for social media and commercial use.
• Fonts & Text Tools: Customize with 100+ fonts, shadows, strokes, and color picking.
• Stickers & Filters: Use 800+ trendy stickers and 50+ filters to elevate your content.
• Transitions & Effects: Add dynamic transitions and effects for professional-quality results.

User-Friendly Interface:
• Quick Learning Curve: Ideal for newcomers in the world of social media content creation.
• 4K Export: Ensure high-quality video output for all your projects.
• Direct Sharing: Share your creations directly to social media platforms.

Features for Your Brand:
• Personalization: Import your brand’s logo, fonts, and colors to maintain brand consistency.
• Commercial Templates: Utilize templates designed specifically for business promotions.

All-In-One Editing Capabilities:
• Trim & Mix: Easily edit music and video clips.
• Slow Motion & Speed Up: Adjust the speed of your media.
• AI Background Remover: Quickly remove backgrounds from your videos.
• Live Photos to Videos: Transform live photos into stunning videos.
• Stock Footage Library: Access unlimited stock footage for your projects.
• Multi-Language Auto Captions: Automatically generate captions in multiple languages.

Subscribe now to enjoy all the features described above.
• You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase or later on and at least 24 hours before the renewal date otherwise your subscriptions will renew automatically.
• The cost of renewal will be charged to your account in the 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
• When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.

Have a question? Need any assistance?  Do not hesitate to contact us at ios@templyvideo.com

it.name: Remove Objects: AI Retouch
it.d:
Say bye-bye to passersby or unwanted objects in photos with AI-powered AI Retouch.

One tap to remove objects naturally, people, text, blemishes, or anything else as if they had never existed. An unwanted object, no matter how tiny, may completely spoil your photo. But with this super easy & time-saving photo eraser, all photos will be as clean as you expect effortlessly. 

Try the best AI pocket app to fix all imperfections in no time!

What defines imperfection? It’s up to you.
- Text, caption, stickers…
- Background people or even the ex you once took a photo with
- Skin defects like blemishes, acne, pimple, wrinkle, dark circle
- Powerlines, wires, or other wirelike objects
- Traffic light, trash can, street sign
- Anything you feel is ruining your photos

Get Creative with AI:
- HD Photo Enhancer: Enhance selfies, group shots, and even text for stunning clarity
- AI Remove: Magic Auto mode to detect & remove unwanted objects automatically 
- AI Filters: Discover new looks for you, your friends, and pets like never before 
- Background Eraser: Auto change background to any color or scene in seconds
- AI Avatar: Upload your selfies to create eye-catching profile avatars in various styles

* Auto Object Remover
Tired of dealing with photobombers or messy backgrounds? Allow us to be your trusted photo cleaner at hand. Simply brush over the unwanted objects or try the hands-free Auto mode for automatic detection & removal. Watch as all those undesired elements vanish in seconds.

* AI Background Eraser
Elevate your photos to new heights with pixel-level accuracy cutout. Try it to automatically change the background to any color or scene you like in seconds. With a vast selection of templates, you can transform your photos into captivating masterpieces.

* Ace Retouch Editor
Just take photos as you like and we’ll do the rest. Whether it's a selfie or a group shot, AI Retouch will be your ace assistant to help you erase all kinds of skin defects. Make photo magic happen and let your true radiance shine through.

Now, let AI Retouch take your photo editing & object removal experience to the next level. No matter what spoils your photo, we’re always here to help you fix imperfections and achieve the most natural results. Proudly showcase your artwork to the world now.

Any suggestions? We're all ears!

We’ve been committed to making it a better photo retouch app. So if you have any problems or suggestions, please don’t hesitate to contact us at collageteam.feedback@gmail.com

Subscription:
- Annual Pro with a 3-Day Trial, cancel anytime
- One Time Purchase to unlock all features permanently

Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period on the $9.99 / year basis.

it.name: Dehancer Film Emulation
it.d:
Dehancer is a film emulation app for photo and video editing built on 10 years of color science to bring real analog film looks to your iPhone and iPad.

Choose from 86 film presets based on iconic stocks: Kodak, Fuji, Cinestill and more. Each preset is crafted from real film stocks. Refine any look in the Lab with realistic Grain, Bloom, and Halation.

Powerful color grading tools give you precise control over every image. Work in Projects to save and revisit your edits anytime. Batch editing lets you apply your grade across multiple photos or videos in one step. RAW support (currently in beta) gives you access to the full range of image data for more accurate, detailed results.

Essential video editing tools are built right in. Trim, cut, and arrange your clips before applying your grade, so you can go from raw footage to a finished, cinematic look without leaving the app.

Whether you shoot on an iPhone or import footage from a camera, Dehancer brings cinematic color grading to photographers, filmmakers, and creators at every level.

Trusted by 1 million+ creators for authentic film emulation, cinematic color grading, and results that look genuinely analog.



YOUR PRIVACY IS IMPORTANT TO US
Please read the Terms of Use as well as the Privacy Policy carefully. All data is handled under the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy of Dehancer.

*Trending AI Videos: Create the hottest AI videos inspired by today’s viral trends — from fun Sora-style clips to Hollywood-level visual effects and other ultra-realistic AI video styles. With just one tap, you can generate stunning, trend-ready AI videos effortlessly.

*AI Dance: Turn any photo — people or pets — into a dancing character with one tap. Our constantly updated algorithms and trending dance styles keep your videos fresh and ahead of social media trends.

***AI Style — Transform Your Photos into Trending Aesthetics***
*Action Figure Maker: Create hyper-realistic action figures powered by Nano Banana technology — from Barbie-style dolls to the viral 3D figurine look.
*Polaroid Portraits: Upload photos of yourself, family, pets, idols, or virtual characters to instantly generate beautifully styled Polaroid shots.
*Anime & Cartoon Filters: Turn any selfie into a digital character with anime, Ghibli, sketch, comic, and cartoon-avatar styles — all in one tap.
*Seasonal Photo Trends: Explore viral photo styles like winter-themed AI Snow, Christmas portraits, and other trending templates updated throughout the year.


***AI Tools — Enhance, Repair & Customize with One Tap***
*Magic Brush: Edit, replace, or add elements in specific areas of your photo.
*Enhance: Restore old or damaged photos to HD quality.
*Remove Object: Erase unwanted people and objects from photos.
*AI Dress-Up: Virtually try on any outfit in your photos.
*Descratch: Fix scratches, sharpen details, and colorize old photos.
*Transition Video: Create smooth transitions between two photos.
*Beauty Tools: Beautify your face and reshape your body with one tap.


***Why AI Marvels? — Smart, Fast, and Always Up-to-Date***
AI Marvels by HitPaw is an all-in-one creative studio designed to be the only tool you’ll ever need for professional-quality photo and video creation, retouching, and restoration. From iconic heroes and heroines to breathtaking landscapes, every wallpaper is crafted to look incredible on your iPhone screen. Find detailed artwork from fan-favorite genres - shonen, shojo, isekai, cyberpunk, mecha, and more. Every wallpaper is hand-picked to ensure perfect composition, vibrant colors, and premium quality that makes your device stand out.

it.name: PureStatus: ByeBye Blur Status
it.d:
PureStatus: HD WhatsApp Status, plus AI Studio

Tired of blurry, low-quality videos and photos in your WhatsApp status? When you post a video, WhatsApp shrinks it and the quality drops. PureStatus compresses your video precisely for WhatsApp first, so what you post stays as sharp as HD status allows.

Crystal-clear status in four steps

Open PureStatus and select a video or photo.
Compress it.
Share to your WhatsApp status.
Enjoy crystal-clear HD.

New: AI Studio
Create the post itself, right inside PureStatus.
• Festival Photoshoot: put yourself in 175 festivals and 460 poses, from Diwali, Eid and Holi to Christmas and Chinese New Year. Couple poses take a photo of each person. Add a greeting in your language, written into the picture.
• WhatsApp Stickers: make stickers from text or your own photo, a 6 or 9 sticker pack of you in one go, and animated stickers. Add them to WhatsApp with one tap.
• Photo Restore: fix old, faded and blurry photos and bring back natural colour.
• AI Styles: cartoon, anime, oil painting, watercolour, sketch and 3D looks.
• Object Eraser, Passport Photo, Upscale, Background Remover and Fit to Status.
• AI Image: describe anything and get a picture.
• Photo to Video: give a still photo natural motion. Video HD: upscale old clips. Video Reframe: fit or crop any video to the 9:16 status size, free and on your phone. Photo Slideshow: photos into a status video with six transitions.

Pick a model for each tool, from fast to top quality, and see the price in tokens before you generate. Every result lands in My Creations and posts to Status in one tap. You get 200 free tokens when you activate and 100 free tokens every month; buy packs when you need more.

Get the best results
• Don't edit or crop a video after compressing; the status will lose quality again.
• Compress the original file, not a video that was already shared. Quality that is already gone can't be restored by compression. Use Photo Restore or Video HD for that.
• Compare for yourself: post the compressed and the original version and look at both.
• Vertical videos and photos give the largest viewing area and are the most popular on phones.

Please keep in mind
• Compression stops your HD video from turning blurry on WhatsApp; it does not improve the original.
• The photo function is for HD status only. Sent in a chat, it arrives as a video.
• The video splitter is for longer status videos. Used in chats, the parts arrive as 30-second videos.

Bonus: Video Status Splitter
Longer videos are cut into 30-second parts, precisely and in the best possible quality, so you can post a full video to your status.

Your privacy
Compression runs on your phone. AI tools upload only the photo or video you choose, process it with AI providers, and you keep the result. Nothing is used to train AI models.

Unlock the true potential of your WhatsApp status. Download PureStatus and start sharing in HD.

Cross-Device Syncing & Sharing

Dark Mode & User-Centric UI

Redesigned from the ground up, Filmic Pro v7 provides filmmakers, newscasters, teachers, vloggers, and social media content creators with the most powerful and intuitive camera experience available, with a full suite of advanced yet easy to use features.
 
| — V7 New Features — |
 
• Dedicated Focus/Exposure Mode selector, comprising three intuitive focus and exposure modes.
 
• Redesigned Manual Sliders for improved focus and exposure control:
— New Exposure/Zoom Slider provides discrete control over LV; ISO; shutter speed; and zoom.
— Improved pull points for automated rack focus and zoom moves.
 
• Quick Action Modals (QAMs) put key functionality at your fingertips front and center in the main interface, eliminating the need to dive into settings.
 
• Action Slider can be revealed to provide a real-time readout and control over key capture settings including ISO, shutter speed, white balance, and gamma curve. Tap a value to interact with its associated QAM for unrivaled control.
 
• Custom Function (Fn) Button now allows you to map one of dozens of available custom functions to the main UI, so your most used feature is only ever a tap away.
 
• Enhanced pro audio capabilities with support for 16/24-bit audio.
 
— — Headline Features — —
 
• ProRes Capture (Proxy; LT; 422; 422 HQ; 4444)*
• iPad Pro M2 exclusive: ProRes 4444 XQ
• Log gamma curves*
• Realtime Film Looks for cinematic results without the need for grading*
• Live Analytic suite including Zebras, False Color, Focus Peaking*
• Support for DolbyVision HDR, 10-bit SDR, and 8-bit HEVC/H264*
• Clean HDMI Out transforms your device into a pro level web cam
• Frame.io Camera to Cloud (C2C) support*
• Advanced Audio Controls for manual input gain, 16/24-bit audio; uncompressed PCM
• CMS for industry standard clip naming conventions.
 
— Foundation Features —
 
• Manual control over every capture parameter
• Apple Watch support for remote start/stop + video preview
• Vertical and landscape support
• Sync audio frame rates of 24/25/30/48/50/60 fps*
• High speed frame rates of 60/120/240fps*
• Slow and fast motion FX
• Time lapse
• Histogram & waveform
• Downsample to lower resolutions

• Image stabilization (standard/cinematic)*
• Support for Filmic Remote. Control an iOS device running Filmic Pro with a second device running Remote.
• 8 aspect ratios including Widescreen (16:9); Ultra Panavision (2.76:1); Square (1:1).

— 1.33x and 1.55x anamorphic desqueeze

it.name: Web Video Cast | Browser to TV
it.d:
Web Video Caster® allows you to watch on your TV videos from your favorite websites including movies, TV shows, live streams of news, sports.

SUPPORTED STREAMING DEVICES

Web Video Caster® supports the most popular streaming devices, allowing your TV to stream videos directly from the web.

• Google Cast (Chromecast, Android TV, Chromecast built-in)
• DLNA devices like Xbox, Samsung TVs, LG TVs, etc. 
• Roku, Roku stick and Roku TVs
• Apple TV 4
• Fire TV and Fire TV stick
• PlayStation 4 - by using its web browser
• Most web browsers by visiting http://cast2tv.app (PS4, Smart TVs, other consoles and set top boxes)


*If you experience a compatibility issues, contact us and include the brand and model number.

SUPPORTED MEDIA

• HLS live streams in M3U8 format (Chromecast, most DLNA devices lack support for it)
• Authenticated videos including movies and TV shows
• MP4 videos
• Live news and sports
• Any HTML5 videos*


*Your streaming device must be capable of decoding the video you are playing. Web Video Caster doesn't perform any video/audio decoding or transcoding.

HOW IT WORKS

Web Video Cast™ is a browser, which allows you to stream videos of movies, TV shows, and other media from the internet to a streaming device or smart tv. Web Video Caster grabs the video URL inside the web page, sends it to the streaming device (i.e. Chromecast or DLNA device), and then plays the video directly from the content provider. This ultimately saves your mobile device’s battery. It also detects subtitles on the web page. Web Video Cast™ does not host these videos. This is not a mirroring app.


GET STARTED

Follow these simple step-by-step instructions to start streaming:

1. Find a video online that you want to watch.

2. Make sure this video can play on mobile browsers without Flash.

3. Connect to your streaming device.

4. Play the video as you normally would. Or, click the play button on the toolbar.

PREMIUM FEATURES**

• No in-app advertising
• Most visited sites
• Bookmarks
• Set homepage

**This functionality does not apply universally to all streaming devices. 

LIMITATIONS & DISCLOSURES

As with all apps, there are some limitations we are aware of and want you to know about up front.

• We are in no way associated with any web media providers and we do not have control over the content they provide.
• Web Video Caster does not support nor play Flash or FLV videos.
• The app does not support tab casting, like the Chromecast extension for the PC web browser.
• We cannot do anything to fix issues that arise on the server side (media content provider) such as failure to play or buffering, which is especially common during heavy load times and weekends.


SHARE YOUR FEEDBACK

We are committed to open communication with our users. Please contact us first with any questions or support issues before leaving a review. We will respond and address your concern promptly. Contact us through our website http://www.webvideocaster.com/contactForm

TikTok is the global discovery platform for videos, streaming on LIVE, shopping, and more. Our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. Over a billion people come to TikTok to share what they love, learn new things, and find ideas that make everyday life more interesting.

Your experience on TikTok is built around what you're into, not who you know. Just watch, like, and scroll to discover videos, creators, and communities you are delighted to discover. From quick recipes to game highlights, fashion tips to music and trending sounds, your For You feed reflects your current interests and changes based on what surprises and inspires you.

Creating is simple. Capture and post everyday moments and turn them into something special with easy editing tools, effects, sounds, and music. Use our free library of sounds and music in your videos, plus filters and creative tools that help your content stand out. On TikTok, anyone can create, and ideas that inspire pick up momentum.

TikTok is also where discovery becomes part of your everyday life. Find creators to follow, new ideas to try, and products you will love from small businesses and brands around the world. TikTok offers more than 50 preset safety and privacy features, from private accounts and content filters to screen time tools and Family Pairing, so you can choose an experience that works for you. TikTok provides extra support for teens and families on the app, letting you set time and content preferences that feel right for your family. 

■ Personalized discovery
A For You feed that learns what you enjoy. Discover videos, creators, LIVE streams, shopping, and communities based on what you watch, like, and share.
■ Entertainment, learning, and everything in between
Comedy, gaming, DIY, beauty, sports, music, lifestyle, education, and more. Find content that makes you laugh, think, and try something new.
■ Simple, powerful creation tools
Record in clips, pause and resume, trim and merge, add text and stickers, and fine tune your video without leaving the app.
■ Sounds, music, and effects
Use our free library of sounds and music in your videos, plus filters, effects, and creative tools that help you express yourself and make your videos stand out.
■ A global community of creators
Follow your favorite creators and discover new voices every day. Share your own story or support the people who inspire you.
■ Discover and shop with TikTok Shop
Explore trending products, exclusive deals, and seamless shopping experiences inspired by creators and brands you love, all in one place. Shop directly from videos, LIVE, and the Shop tab, track your orders, and enjoy a safe, secure shopping experience.
■ Go LIVE and connect in real time
Start a LIVE to chat with your community, share moments as they happen, and unlock special features and benefits where available.
■ Tools to shape your experience
Use more than 50 safety and privacy features, from private accounts and content filters to screen time tools, Family Pairing, and other controls, to choose how TikTok works for you and your family.

Ready to see what you discover next? Download TikTok to start watching, creating, and exploring your world in a new way.

it.name: Snappier IPTV
it.d:
A powerful IPTV player for iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV — built by people who use IPTV every day.

Snappier does not provide any content, playlists, channels, or streaming subscriptions. Add your own media sources to browse and play your content.

BUILT FOR SERIOUS VIEWERS
• Two powerful media players: KSPlayer and AetherEngine.
• Picture-in-Picture on iPhone/iPad
• Multi-screen view with up to 9 simultaneous streams
• Automatic display-mode matching on Apple TV 4K

PLAY YOUR OWN MEDIA
• Live TV, movies, TV series, and catchup in SD, HD, and 4K, depending on your source
• Connect using credentials supplied by your provider or import your own M3U playlists; short playlist URLs supported
• External EPG URL support.
• Fast M3U and EPG parsing in the background or foreground, optimised for large playlists
• Multiple playlists with one-tap updates for all playlists or EPGs, plus a pinned default playlist that opens on launch
• Search across every playlist at once — channels, movies, TV series, EPG entries, and actor names
• Multiple user profiles, each with their own favourites, watch history, and parental settings

TAILOR IT YOUR WAY
• Custom categories to group your favourites exactly how you want
• Super Playlists — combine items from multiple playlists into one curated view
• Rename channels, categories, and video-on-demand items, with category-specific names if needed
• Per-playlist tag mapping for M3U files
• Sort by date added, name, original order, or any custom order you choose
• Favourites and parental controls for Live TV and Movie categories
• Play an individual network stream URL

SMART METADATA
• TMDB-powered metadata with multilingual plot descriptions, posters, backdrops, cast, and ratings
• Manual TMDB match overrides — correct mismatched metadata and keep your changes across devices
• JustWatch streaming-availability data via TMDB
• OpenSubtitles integration plus internal subtitle and audio-track selection
• Skip Intro and Skip Credits powered by TheIntroDB

RECORD AND DOWNLOAD
• Scheduled recordings for supported live streams
• Download supported movies and episodes from your sources for offline viewing

PLAYBACK, YOUR WAY
• Auto-save and auto-resume for movies and TV episodes
• Internal audio-track and subtitle selection
• Video de-interlacing with KSPlayer
• Aspect ratio, buffer size, and audio delay adjustment
• Skip forward and backward
• Swipe gestures on iPhone and iPad for quick volume and brightness control
• Alternative list view for Live TV alongside the standard grid
• Viewing Statistics dashboard — see what you watch and when

SYNC ACROSS YOUR DEVICES
Secure cloud sync keeps your favourites, custom categories, renames, watch progress, scheduled recordings, and metadata fixes in step across your Apple devices. Each device controls its own sync preferences, and sync can be disabled per playlist.

NOTES
Feature availability depends on your media source and its supported formats. Free-to-air M3U playlists are supported, with some features unavailable. Apple TV HD is supported, but Apple TV 4K is strongly recommended.

Data sources: TMDB, JustWatch (via TMDB), OpenSubtitles, TheIntroDB.
Players: KSPlayer and AetherEngine.

SUPPORT
Join us on Discord — the server address is available in the app under Settings.

IMPORTANT
Snappier IPTV is a media player only. It does not supply content, playlists, channels, movies, TV shows, or streaming subscriptions. Users add their own media sources and must have permission to access, stream, record, or download that content.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://snappieriptv.app/privacy.html

it.name: Coloring Book for Me
it.d:
Plunge into a fairy world of coloring with the Coloring Book for Me app, a perfect tool to relax and release your inner artist. Find joy and color your stress away!

Coloring Book for Me brings you:
- Custom mandalas: bring to life your unique designs in the mandala creation mode
- 'Color with a photo’ feature: experience a new way of coloring - apply a photo snapped in real-time or from your Camera Roll to uncolored cells on a coloring page and create a matchless work of art in a few taps
- 20+ categories of unique coloring pages from talented illustrators - with collection updates, you’ll always have something new to color
- Your own coloring pictures in the app: import outline drawings from your camera or Camera Roll to color them right on your device
- 40+ beautiful preset Solid and Gradient color palettes: choose one that fits best and fill a picture with colors from soft and muted to bold and lively
- Custom palettes: combine any colors you like to create a matchless work of art
- Various coloring tools: color in a simple way with the tap-to-color tool or have real coloring experience using markers and pencils
- A wonderful collection of relaxing sounds
- Post-editing effects: add a vignette effect, change contours, apply textures & filters
- Apple Pencil support: enjoy an easy and intuitive process of coloring on the crisp screen of iPad Pro.


Upgrade to the Premium version and get unlimited access to 
- an expansive and constantly growing collection of wonderful coloring pages for adults and even more palettes, 
- relaxing sounds & textures. 

Don’t limit your creative talents, choose from any image you'd like and color it in the most enjoyable way - without ads and watermarks!

Subscription with a free trial period will automatically renew to a paid subscription. You can cancel your subscription or free trial in the iTunes settings at least 24-hours before the end of the free trial period. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period and you will be downgraded to the free service. 
* Please note: any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.

For complete access to all Coloring Book for Me features, you will need to allow access to the following:
* Notifications - so that you will be kept informed when New or Special pictures are added to the app.
* Photos - so that you can import your pictures for coloring and save your artwork;
* Camera - so that you can capture your own coloring pages to color them in the app.

it.name: Leto: Font for Instagram Story
it.d:
Want to increase views and engagement on Stories, Reels, and posts? Easy!

Leto is not just a subtitle creation app. It’s a full editor for creative formatting of all types of content!

Main features of the "Leto" app:

• Over 500 stylish unique fonts, including calligraphic, animated, print, and other font types.
• Photo and video editor: A complete set of tools for creating stylish stories, posts, Reels, and any other visual content.
• Ready-made templates and collages: Pre-installed templates for Stories, posts, and Reels to help you quickly create professional-looking content.
• Subtitles: Add subtitles to videos with one click. Customize the style, color, and animation to make the content more dynamic.
• Layer blending: 17 blending modes allow you to experiment with effects and create unique compositions.
• Background removal: Remove backgrounds with one tap to create collages or highlight necessary elements.
• Augmented Reality (AR): Add fonts and stickers to real environments for photos and videos, creating impressive content.
• Outline for text and stickers: Add outlines to highlight important elements and make them more expressive.
• Effects and filters: Apply effects like blur, “Poster” filter, and “Glass” effect to create stylish visual content.

What you'll find in "Leto":

• Over 200 bright fonts: Trendy blogger fonts, including animated ones that can be exported with a transparent background for use in other apps.
• Over 300 calligraphic fonts: Including handwritten styles to add personality to your content.
• Over 1500 stickers: Conveniently categorized to enhance videos and Stories.
• Over 2000 backgrounds: For creating a unique style.

New content — fonts, stickers, and backgrounds — is added every week so you’re always one step ahead.

If you choose to use premium features (optional), payment will be charged to your iTunes account. You can turn off the subscription in Apple account settings at any time after purchase.

it.name: Radiance Wallpapers

The app your home screen has been waiting for. Radiance is a wallpaper app made with real artists, and it offers more ways than ever before to spice up your phone. Pick from a growing library of handmade wallpapers, find the perfect one in seconds, and set it in one press.

WALLPAPER LIBRARY: Our library of over 1,800 high-resolution wallpapers gives you endless ways to deck out your phone. We collaborate with 50+ artists, designers, and photographers to frequently bring you new collections. Tap an artist's name to see all of their work and the story behind it. All for free, and never made with AI.

SEARCH & FILTERS: Looking for something specific? Search it! Just type a keyword and see what comes up. You can also filter the library by style, like Abstract, Photography, or Liquid Glass.

PREVIEW: See every wallpaper at your device's exact aspect ratio before you apply it, so you know exactly how it will look on your Lock Screen.

QUICK APPLY: This is unlike any other wallpaper app; with Radiance+, you can set a wallpaper without ever opening Photos. Simply hold the download button and tap Quick Apply. No more camera roll full of wallpapers you were just trying out.

CREATE A WALLPAPER: Want something of your own? Turn on the Create tab and make a unique Mesh Gradient wallpaper. Simply select your colors and drag the curves. You can also import any photo and retouch it with your own color gradient.

ZERO ADS: Radiance is free of advertisements; just the way software should be.

It's time to change your wallpaper. Install Radiance today.

————

Radiance+ is an optional subscription that helps support the development of Radiance. It unlocks Quick Apply and custom app icons, plus new exclusive perks as they are added. Everything else in Radiance stays free.

it.name: ToonSquid
it.d:
ToonSquid is the powerful 2D art and animation studio for your iPad. Its flexible layer system allows you to combine the charm of hand-drawn traditional animation with keyframes that automatically animate layer properties over time. With a library full of beautiful, blazing-fast and fully customizable pixel and vector brushes, animatable effects, a smudge tool, animated text and vector shapes, bones with inverse kinematics, video and audio layers, camera movements, symbols and many more features, ToonSquid makes it easy to bring your vision to life.

Traditional Animation
- Create hand-drawn frame-by-frame animations
- Control how long you want to show each drawing in the timeline
- Draw in resolutions of up to 4k

Keyframe Animation
- Add keyframes to automatically animate layer and effects properties over time
- Choose from an extensive list of customizable easing curve presets to create organic motion between keyframes
- Easily loop your keyframe animation

Powerful Layer System
- Define the order and length of each element in your animation using layers and drawings and a flexible timeline
- Organize your layers into groups for a clean workflow or to animate multiple layers at once
- Use the camera layer to quickly define the visible portion of your animation in the export
- Mask layers to other layers, even when their contents are animated
- Choose from 27 industry-standard layer blend modes for beautiful compositing effects

Fully-customizable Brushes
- Draw gorgeous brush strokes with ToonSquid's state-of-the-art digital brush engine
- Take full advantage of Apple Pencil's pressure and tilt sensitivity and the iPad Pro's 120Hz display for lag-free drawing
- Use vector brushes to create brush strokes that are sharp at every zoom level
- Edit the 60+ brush settings and import custom textures to create a brush library that is perfectly tailored to your art style
- Blend your strokes together using the smudge tool
- Draw in a variety of styles such as sketching, inking, wet mixing, pixel art, and more
- Export and share your custom brushes with others
- Import your existing library of Adobe® Photoshop® brushes

Vector Shapes
- Create custom shapes using the path tool by placing and editing each curve control point
- Quickly add common vector shapes from the shape library
- Import SVG files
- Fill and stroke your shapes with beautiful gradients and edit them directly on the canvas
- Animate the visible length of a path using its trim properties

Animatable Effects
- Create character rigs using bones and add inverse kinematics constraints
- Create custom meshes to deform pixel layers when they are part of a bone rig
- Animate perspective and warp effects
- Apply adjustments, blur, pixelation, drop shadow, chroma key, halftone, parallax and more effects

Efficient symbol workflow
- Split your animation into separate clips that you can then reuse multiple times using symbols
- Make edits to an animation clip and immediately see the changes in all of its symbol instances
- Use frame markers to speed up your lip-syncing workflow

Text
- Add text layers and animate their appearance
- Import your favorite fonts

Color
- Use ToonSquid's powerful color picker with plenty of different interfaces to choose the exact colors you need
- Create custom color palettes and share them outside the application
- Pick colors straight from the canvas using the pipette tool
- Fill connected regions quickly with the fill tool

Audio and Video
- Add audio clips to your timeline and perform lip-syncing animations
- Import videos, GIFs and images into your project and work with them through symbols

Transform
- Animate a layer's position, rotation and scale properties using keyframes
- Build transform hierarchies to achieve more advanced movements
- Edit your layer's motion path directly on the canvas

Numerous Export Formats
- Export your work in one of many common file formats such as MP4, MOV, GIF, PNG, JPEG, PSD, and more.

AI EDIT THAT EDITS LIKE A PROFESSIONAL VIDEO EDITOR

Built by Mirage™, Captions is an AI video generator and video editor that makes it easy to go from idea to ready-to-share content, no experience needed.

Get started by importing a video or generating engaging content from scratch using text to video. You can create an AI actor or upload a selfie to create a personal avatar, allowing you to produce polished footage of yourself without ever needing to record again. 

From there, skip the hours spent toggling and tweaking manual edits. Our AI video editor applies editorial discernment to cut scenes, overlay B-roll, and integrate sounds based on your video. Whether you polish your video with our AI edit feature or describe desired changes to our chat-based editor, Captions’ intuitive video maker makes it easy to bring your vision to life.


LET AI EDIT FOR YOU

- One-tap AI video editing: Transform raw footage into ready-to-post content instantly with curated effects and trending aesthetics.
- Edit like you text: Just describe your vision in plain language; our chat-based editor will apply effects, transitions, B-roll, and pacing per your direction.


CREATE A PERSONAL AI AVATAR

- AI Twin: Turn a single selfie into a high-quality video of yourself using our AI video generator.
- AI Actors: Generate talking videos with engaging AI avatars, giving you a digital on-brand spokesperson.
- Adjust looks: Change outfits, add objects, and switch backgrounds to feature the same AI avatar across unlimited videos.

- AI Denoise: Automatically remove background noise from talking videos.
- AI Zoom: Instantly add relevant zooms to your content.
- AI Scale: Quickly resize videos for whatever aspect ratio you need.
- AI Hashtags: Automatically generate video captions and hashtags.
- AI Teleprompter: Read directly from your script while recording in-app.
- Multiple AI models: Choose from 20+ models to generate music, sounds, and visuals.


CAPTIONS AND DUBBING

- AI Dubbing: Dub your content into 29 languages with just a tap of a button.
- AI Subtitles: Automatically generate accurate captions or subtitles in 91+ languages. You can choose specific fonts and colors too.

it.name: Compress Photos & Pictures

Reduce photo file size without losing quality. Free up storage on your iPhone or iPad, and share or upload photos without hitting size limits.

WHY USE COMPRESS PHOTOS

- Shrink photos by up to 90% with no visible loss in quality
- Free up storage space on your iPhone or iPad
- Send big photos by email and messages without size errors
- Upload photos to websites and forms with file size limits
- Keep or remove location data for privacy
- Very easy to use, and highly rated with 4.5 starsrs

REVIEWS FROM USERS

"Thank God for this app. It is easy to use. Does what it says. And gives great results." by mazmac747

"Tested with 2 images that took up 18 Mb reduced to 0.68 Mb and clear.  Works great." by Capt Jack Sparrow POTC

"Absolutely brilliant Application that speedily compresses your photos for storage, sharing and export. Thanks!" by Rebsolar

FREE UP STORAGE SPACE

Tired of the “Storage almost full” alert? Compress Photos shrinks your pictures so you can keep more of them.

Use the app to reduce the file size of photos and regain storage space on your device. When applied to all your pictures, Compress Photos can help you store up to 10 times more photos on your iPhone or iPad.

SHARP QUALITY, SMALL FILES

The smart compression engine reduces file size while keeping photos sharp. Real results:

- 2.3 MB to 207 KB (91% smaller)
- 4.1 MB to 492 KB (88% smaller)
- 4.8 MB to 384 KB (92% smaller)

SHARE WITHOUT SIZE LIMITS

Email attachment too big? Upload rejected because the file is over the limit? Compress your photos in seconds and send them anywhere.

ADVANCED TOOLS

- Choose your export format: JPEG, PNG, HEIC and more
- Keep or strip metadata and location for privacy
- See the estimated file size before you compress
- Works with PNG, JPEG, HEIF and HEIC photos

EASILY LOCATE COMPRESSED PHOTOS

Compressed photos are saved to both your main library and a dedicated album conveniently called “Compressed Photos” on your device, allowing you to easily locate processed pictures. This new album is automatically created when you run the app and save compressed photos to your device.

SUPPORTED FILE TYPES

Compress Photos works with all PNG, JPEG, HEIF, and HEIC image files.

PRO VERSION

Upgrade to the Pro version of Compress Photos to remove ads, access advanced compression settings, and compress more than 3 photos at once.

it.name: Lightleap by Lightricks
it.d:
Finally, you can take the photo you actually meant to take! Lightleap (formerly Quickshot) is a photo editor that proves you no longer need to be a professional photographer to take amazing photos.

Let’s face it - your photos don't always come out the way you expected. You pull out your phone to capture something awesome, but the photo you take just doesn't do the scene justice. The background is too blurry, the lighting is just all wrong, or maybe the scenery needs a retouch – something only an experienced editor can do, right?

The Lightleap app is here to change that! With this editor app, you can capture the beauty and magic you see with your own eyes – or enhance it. You become the editor with filters, effects, and retouch tools at your fingertips.

There’s no need to spend hours pulling your hair out as you learn how to use professional editor software. The Lightleap image editor app takes moments to retouch your photos into eye-catching images with professional vibes, using stunning pre-set filters and effects.

With unique, easy-to-use features like background Sky, Heal, Effects, Filters and Looks, every photo you take from now on will be picture perfect. If you’ve dreamed of taking Instagram-worthy images to inspire the world, this is your chance.

Brought to you by Lightricks, the award-winning app developer, Lightleap photo editor app is part of the Enlight Creativity Suite, including Pixaloop, Videoleap and Photofox. We help you harness your creativity in every photo.

App user favourite features from Lightleap include:

Sky
Replace the background in your photos with a brand-new sky!
- With one tap, you can change the background with a new sky.
- Select from 60+ high-quality sky backgrounds.
- Choose from sunny, dusk, sunset, storm, and even fantasy skies!

Heal
Remove unwanted people, background smudges, and easily retouch your image with the heal function, like a true editor.
- Select and erase items in the forefront and background of your image.
- Smooth over bumps and quickly correct photo mistakes.
- Undo retouches with a single tap to restore your image!

Filters
No photo is complete without one of Lightleap's gorgeous filters - one of our top features.
- Find filters by theme, whether you’re looking for warm, black and white, urban, fade and many other filters.
- Easily adjust the intensity of your filters over your image.
- Achieve the effects you desire in moments!

Looks
Change the vibe of your photo like a true editor in one tap.
- Choose a predefined look as filters for your image.
- Create a signature style for your Instagram feed with our designer editor looks.
- Give your images a golden hour glow, or set the mood with dusk, black and white, shadows and fantasy looks.

Effects
Add tons of special effects to retouch dull areas and bring your background to life.
- Overlay shadow effects, sparkles, lens flares and more to enhance your photo.
- Change the weather effects and add seasonal themes.
- Access our extremely popular mood elements and adjust the magic level of your photo effects!

Adjust
The full collection of essential editor tools is at your fingertips.
- Every minor retouch adjustment can be made, including light and contrast to temperature, tint and hue editors.
- Crop your photo, retouch, and edit all within the app.
- Sharpen, adjust the depth, structure, and grain as a professional photography editor!

With Lightleap, you become a photo editor in moments. Fix and retouch your photos with filters and effects to truly capture the magic of the moment you experienced. Download the app to discover how you can become a pro photo editor!

it.name: Obscura — Pro Camera
it.d:
Obscura V is a camera app packed full of features to help you take incredible photos. Obscura pairs a stunning design with intuitive controls that make taking photos a delight.
—

Over its 10+ years on the App Store, Obscura has been featured numerous times around the world, including as Editors’ Choice and App of the Day.
—

Design

Obscura squeezes a bunch of powerful features into simple controls anyone can master. The interface balances aesthetics, ergonomics, and intuitiveness. You won’t want to use anything else. Controls can be reached with one thumb, and gestures and haptics combine to create a tactile experience that lets you stay focused on your subject.
—

Capture Modes & Formats

Obscura captures photos, videos, Live Photos, and portraits. Photos can be captured in RAW, ProRAW, HEIC, and JPEG (on supported devices, see http://obscura.camera/compatibility).

Capture images in multiple different aspect ratios, or apply filters live in camera for a wide variety of styles.
—

Camera Settings

Obscura gives you control over exposure, focus, white balance, ISO, shutter speed, and flash, with intuitive controls that make you feel in control of your device’s camera.
—

Live Filters

Obscura includes a bunch of great filters to give your photos instant style but you can also create your own and use them live in-camera. It’s very cool and very powerful.
—

View Options

Obscura lets you display a grid, a spirit level, a histogram, focus peaking, a focus loupe, and exposure clipping highlights to help you understand every detail of what you’re shooting.
—

Photo Library

Obscura has its own interface for browsing, rating, editing, and sharing images, but it’s fully integrated with your system photo library, so images captured with Obscura are available everywhere.
—

Obscura Ultra

Obscura is free to use, with an annual subscription for premium features. See http://obscura.camera/ultra for full details.
—

I hope you love using Obscura as much as I’ve loved designing and building it. If you do, please consider subscribing to Ultra, leaving a review, or just sharing with a friend.

All the best,
Ben

it.name: Analogue – Film Camera
it.d:
Analogue is a camera app built around Log capture, giving you cinematic colour, soft roll-offs, and natural contrast straight from the camera. No filters, tone mapping or over-sharpening, just real-time filmic results as you shoot.

Perfect for photographers who want cinematic photos, a softer look, and images that don’t need editing.

Features
· Two Capture Modes: Cine (Log) for softer, less processed photos, and Pro (Bayer RAW) for sharper, more detailed ones. The same Analogue look in both.
· Photo and Video Capture in LOG: cinematic dynamic range and subtle colour.
· RAW Capture & Processing: save RAW (DNG), RAW + Processed, or Processed, and reprocess your DNGs any time.
· Film Scan: inspired by classic lab scanners, Film Scan shapes the depth, brightness and character of each photo.
· Aperture Control: control depth of field and exposure on iPhone 18 Pro. Requires iOS 27.
· Real-Time Presets: see your look before you shoot, create custom styles, and organise your favourites.
· LUT Import & Adjustment: import your own LUTs and fine-tune your look live.
· Six Handcrafted Base LUTs: Neutral, CineChrome, Lowen, FP100F, Classic Negative, and Ultra.
· Analogue Studio: reprocess photos and videos with different looks. Fine-tune RAW exposure, white balance, tint, and more, or adjust crop and rotation.
· Gallery & Batch Processing: browse full-crop previews, filter your library, and copy and paste settings across multiple photos and videos.
· Photo Ratings: swipe up on a photo to rate it, then filter your gallery by rating. Requires iOS 27.
· Camcorder Zoom: drag the shutter button to the right to zoom in while recording.
· Custom Focal Lengths & Crops
· Custom Settings: choose exactly which settings are saved and restored, with granular control over each option.
· Manual & Auto Controls: exposure locking, compensation, shutter priority, minimum shutter speed, manual focus, and a 180° shutter angle bias for video.
· SDR, P3 & HLG Video: graded recording on every iPhone, with film presets and LUTs applied to all three.
· Cine Preview: a higher-quality live preview for Pro capture.
· Super Resolution: capture at 12MP, 24MP, or 33MP for sharing or large prints.
· Film Grain: luminance-aware texture for natural depth.
· White Balance & Kelvin Control
· Histogram & Highlight Clipping
· Save Graded + Original Photos
· Startup Mode & Min. Shutter Speed: set how the camera opens and how it exposes.
· Fast, Minimal Interface: distraction-free shooting for photographers.

Analogue runs on iPhones with iOS 18 or later. Cine capture and Apple Log video require a supported Pro model from iPhone 15 Pro onwards. Aperture Control on iPhone 18 Pro and Photo Ratings require iOS 27.

All features are available with a subscription (monthly or yearly) or a one-time purchase.

Create stunning videos and photos with easy-to-use editing tools and powerful AI features. Whether you're making daily vlogs, birthday or anniversary videos, creating content for social media, or growing your small business, InShot makes it easy to bring your ideas to life and share them with the world.

[AI Tools]

- AI Speech. Turn text into natural-sounding speech with AI Text to Speech and AI Voice Generator.
- AI Cut. Automatically remove silence, filler words, and breath sounds to make video editing faster and easier.
- Video & Photo Enhance. Improve the quality of your photos and videos for sharper, clearer results.
- AI Effects. Experience the magic of AI with instant presets that elevate your images and videos in just one tap.
- AI Portrait. Enhance portraits with AI Retouch, AI Face Edit, and AI Light. Fine-tune facial features and add flash, backlight, or hair light effects.
- Auto Background Removal. Remove backgrounds from photos and videos with one tap.
- Voice Enhance. Enhance voice clarity and reduce background noise.
- Auto Adjust. Instantly enhance your images and videos with one-tap.

[Video Editing]
- Trim & Merge. Trim, split, and merge video clips with ease.
- Reverse. Reverse videos and create unique playback effects.
- Speed Control. Speed up or slow down videos from 0.1x to 100x, with speed curves and speed ramping.
- Text & Stickers. Add text, emoji, and InShot-exclusive stickers with a wide range of fonts, styles, and text templates. Import your own fonts locally.
- Music & Voice. Add music, sound effects, voice-overs, and voice effects in various styles.
- Keyframe Animation. Add custom keyframe animations to clips and adjust settings over time.
- Slow Motion. Create smooth slow-motion videos with speed curves.
- Chroma Key. Remove specific colors from videos and create green screen effects.
- Picture-in-Picture. Layer multiple videos to create multi-layered videos.
- Stabilizer. Stabilize shaky footage for smoother, steadier videos.
- Smart tracking. Make stickers/text move seamlessly in sync with your tracking object motion, adding dynamic flair to your videos.

[AI Photo Editor]
- Blur the background easily.
- 1000+ stickers, stylish text, and creative doodles.
- AI Enhance. Turn blurry photos into HD with AI Photo Enhancer.
- AI Cutout. Remove BG with pixel-level precision.
- AI Remove. Instantly erase unwanted objects or passersby for a clean, perfect shot.

[Collage Maker]
- Easy-to-use photo grid collage maker. Up to 20 photos and 500+ customizable layouts.

- Visual Effects. Add creative effects like Glitch, Clone, Fade, Noise, Beats, and more.

it.name: Focos
it.d:
Focos is a big step into the future of computational photography and light-field camera, bringing DSLR-like photography to your iPhone and iPad Pro, with beautiful bokeh effects usually achievable only with professional large aperture cameras. With the technology of computational photography, you can make unlimited changes to your photos, focus after the fact, change the aperture repeatedly, and add multiple lights in 3D space, exceeding the limits of any editing tools you’ve known before. The creative potential unleashed by Focos is endless.

The Verge,
"Focos has long been one of the most ambitious photo-editing apps on iOS, turning any photo into a 'portrait mode'-style image with fully adjustable depth of field, no matter what kind of camera you took it with."

MAIN FEATURES
- Take photos with shallow depth of field, without manually painting or making selections.
- The AI engine can calculate depth of field automatically for all photos.
- True 3D imaging.
- Simulate large apertures to create real bokeh effects normally only possible with DSLR cameras and expensive lenses.
- Import all existing photos and customize the bokeh effect.
- Re-focus portrait photos that have already been taken, with a simple tap.
- Choose from various simulated aperture diaphragms to generate different bokeh spot effects.
- Professional options to simulate lens characteristics, such as creamy, bilinear, swirly, and reflex effects, and more.
- Visualize the depth of areas within your portrait photos in a 3D view, and intuitively add depth filters.
- Add multiple lights in a 3D space, and adjust the color, brightness and so on for each light.
- Check the portrait picture in the real world with augmented reality technique.
- It is possible to patch the depth map precisely on iPad with Apple Pencil.
- Intuitive and easy to use, with built-in video tutorials.
- An essential tool for all iPhones and iPads.

Do you have questions or suggestions? Contact us via support @ focos . me.

it.name: Moment Pro Camera II
it.d:
Your Camera, Your Looks, Your Way.

Moment Pro Camera II turns your phone into your favorite camera for photography and filmmaking. Shoot like a pro with full manual controls, creative looks, and an upgraded interface – all in one intuitive app.

What’s New in Pro Camera II?

Our first pro camera app has been the #1 rated camera app for years. Now, it’s time for the next chapter. We’ve re-engineered Pro Camera II from the ground up to give you better performance, advanced controls, and new customizable interfaces and shooting modes.

Key Features:

• Pro-Level Exposure Control – Our smart exposure system allows you to take control with Shutter Priority, ISO Priority, Manual, and Auto exposure modes, including the ability to limit Auto ISO to a specific range.
• Upgraded White Balance – Beyond auto white balance, you can manually configure temperature and tint, choose a preset, or calibrate via a gray card.
• Advanced Photo Options – Control the level of processing and HDR applied to your photos. Shoot in RAW, ProRAW, TIFF, HEIF, or JPG.
• Cinematic Video Tools – Apple Log, Open Gate, ProRes, 10-bit recording, and more. Adjust the resolution, color space, frame rate, codec, bitrate, and chroma subsampling for total creative freedom.
• Precision Monitoring – Get pro-level feedback with Waveform, RGB Histograms, and audio meters — normally reserved for cinema cameras.
• Aspect Ratio – Frame your shot within your favorite aspect ratio (4:3, 16:9, 3:2, 5:4, 1:1)
• Designed for All Creators – A beautiful, intuitive interface that adapts to how you shoot. Swipe, tap, and adjust anything immediately with one hand (including a dedicated left-handed layout), or go distraction-free with Zen Mode. Works natively in landscape orientation.
• Looks, Your Way – Apply creative Looks or import your own LUTs to video and photos. Preview them live, bake them into your footage, or adjust intensity on the fly.
• Focus Tools That Just Work – Separate reticles for exposure and focus with a tap, or dial in the shot with Manual Focus and Focus Peaking.
• Quick Actions, Faster Shooting – One swipe to reach your most used tools: flash, stabilization, zebras, focus peaking, grids, and more.
• Intuitive Lens Control – Remove the guesswork of which lens you are using and eliminate surprises with our Optic Controls. Say goodbye to shaky zoom with our fluid zoom control.
• Hardware-Ready – Optimized for every iPhone, with seamless integration for external mics and Moment’s entire lens + case ecosystem.

Upcoming Feature Releases
• Look Store: purchase creator color grades and film emulations
• Slow Shutter and Timelapse modes
• Advanced Profile sharing and collaboration tools
• Extended hardware integration partnerships

We love hearing from our community. For feature requests, ideas, or support, email us at hello@shopmoment.com or message us @momentprocamera on social media.

Fully Compatible with iPhone and Moment's complete ecosystem of lenses, cases, and accessories.

it.name: Halide Mark III - Pro Camera
it.d:
Halide unleashes your iPhone’s camera. Disable iPhone processing for natural photos, apply powerful film situations, access manual controls, and more. Halide has over 24,000 5-star ratings and is an App Store Editors’ Choice and Apple Design Award winner.

Halide’s Looks are built into the camera itself, changing how your photo is captured and processed - not just a color filter applied after the fact. These are the best photos you can get out of an iPhone. Start with Process Zero for natural, film-like results, without any AI or computational photography. Explore our rich set of creative Looks developed with Hollywood colorist Cullen Kelly, and powered by sophisticated film simulation. 

For nine years, Halide has set the standard for professional iPhone camera control. Nail your manual focus with Focus Peaking and the Focus Loupe. Compose your shots with intention using sophisticated framing guides, from a basic grid and rule of thirds, to the golden ratio and rabatment of the rectangle. Get perfect macro shots with Halide's dedicated Macro Mode.

Hate editing? Halide gives you amazing results straight out of the camera. But when you need to fine-tune, Photo Lab makes it fast and intuitive.  Try dramatically different Looks, adjust framing and exposure, experiment with film simulation, or rescue details in highlights and shadows with Tone Fusion.

You can even import and load RAWs from other apps, such as Apple’s own camera app, or standalone cameras by Canon, Nikon, Sony, Leica, Fujifilm, and Hasselblad. Specific formats are listed below.

*Halide is a paid app. Try it free for 7 days with an annual membership, or buy it outright with a one-time purchase — no subscription required.*

Features:
- Shoot without Apple’s computational photography for stronger contrast and more natural results.
- Photographic Looks developed in collaboration with esteemed Hollywood colorist Cullen Kelly.
- Rescue details in shadows and highlights with a Tone Fusion slider inspired by darkroom dodging and burning.
- Try any Look on existing ProRAW files - including photos shot in Apple’s camera app.
- Become a better photographer by signing up for our 10-day tutorial directly from the app.
- Full manual exposure controls including shutter speed, ISO and white balance.
- Technical Readout to view all details of your iPhone camera hardware.
- Also runs on iPad, for an amazing Photo Lab experience.

RAW File Support:
- DNG (iPhone, Leica)
- CR2 (Canon)
- CR3 (Canon)
- NEF (Nikon)
- RAF (Fujifilm)
- ARW (Sony)
- FFF (Hasselblad)

Terms of Use can be found here: https://halide.cam/terms

Privacy: https://www.lux.camera/privacy/

Photographers of every skill level can craft masterpieces, using automatic mode for spontaneous snapshots or diving into the manual settings to tweak every detail.

AUTOMATIC AND MANUAL CONTROL

name: Kino
desc:
Make great video easy! Kino lets you just press record and create cinematic video with color presets created by expert filmmakers—no edit required. Plus, with “AutoMotion,” the app automatically creates that smooth "film look" you see at the movies. Shoot great video with no film school required.

Are you an…

it.name: Kino - Pro Video Camera
it.d:
Make great video easy! Kino lets you just press record and create cinematic video with color presets created by expert filmmakers—no edit required. Plus, with “AutoMotion,” the app automatically creates that smooth "film look" you see at the movies. Shoot great video with no film school required.

Are you an experienced filmmaker? Kino includes all the features you need to shoot like a Pro, such as a full manual mode, focus peaking, color waveform, audio meters, and more. If you’re experienced in color, you can import LUTs quickly and use the same powerful Instant Grade feature to output video with baked in LUTs.

Regardless of your skill level, Kino adapts to your needs. Pick your experience level when setting up the app to dial things in your way or go with recommended, simple settings. The beautiful, simple interface shows only essential things, while keeping powerful features under thumb’s reach. 

INSTANT GRADE

Kino comes packed with pro color presets by experts like Stu Maschwitz, Sandwich Video, Evan Schneider, Tyler Stalman and Kevin Ong. With one tap, you can shoot video with cinematic, film-like color by selecting a Grade preset. With Instant Grade, you don’t have to apply it later or do any editing steps: Kino just saves the processed video for you, ready to share. 

LEARN ALONG

Getting started with video? The Kino team has a free series of lessons prepared you can dive into right away to learn filmmaking with the app. Start out with our simple recommended settings and enroll in a lesson plan to get lessons emailed to you that are easy to follow and let you unlock every feature of the app to use for making better videos. 

PRO TOOLS

Kino’s simple interface does not mean it lacks in powerful pro tools. Start out with automatic exposure with EV adjustment and AE and WB lock, or drop into full manual mode with shutter speed, angle and ISO adjustment. Compose a shot with the grid with built in level, check exposure with the RGB waveform, and pull focus with focus peaking. Kino can store your recordings in Files instead of Photos for better and easy shot management, and even features a screen lock to prevent inadvertent taps messing up your shot. Set custom recording settings (like 4K 60FPS Apple Log ProRes422HQ on iPhone 15 Pro) or get started with presets for flexibiltiy.

BEAUTIFUL INTERFACE

Thoughtful touches are abound in Kino: from a screen-wide telltale ring to show you are recording, to beautiful custom typography throughout with our own bespoke fonts, Kino balances beauty and simplicity with flexibility and control for users of any skill level. 

AUTOMOTION

Get cinematic motion like in feature films. Introducing: AutoMotion. Kino biases exposure towards a 180° shutter speed by default. If you land in this sweet spot, and available light supports it, the ‘Auto’ label turns green — showing you are in the sweet spot for great cinematic motion. Bright day out? Pop an ND filter on your iPhone and don’t worry about adjusting manual settings: Kino will take care of prioritizing shutter angle so you can just shoot and get great results. 

LUT FRIENDLY 

One of the powerful aspects of Kino is being able to download new looks from your favorite creators or your own making. Author .cube LUT files in Pixelmator Pro, Davinci Resolve, or other apps (up to 33x33) and open them in Kino with a tap.

TRULY PRIVATE

None of our apps gather or collect data, or analyze your videos and photos. We believe the most important thing a camera can be is private. 

CREATOR SPECIAL

Are you a creator or filmmaker and want to get started with or love using Kino? Get in touch with us to get our ‘Creator Kit’: see the Kino website for more details. When sharing your work, tag it #shotwithkino so we can feature it online. 

Thanks for making it this far! Kino is made by friends — Ben Sandofsky and Sebastiaan de With, with the help of Katie-Rose Summerfield and Doug Broussard. We made this app with love and care and we hope you love it.

it.name: Painter Eye: AR Drawing App
it.d:
Turn any photo into art on real paper with Painter Eye — your AR art projector and portable tracing studio for iPhone and iPad.

HOW IT WORKS
Painter Eye works like an art projector, light box, and AR tracing tool in one. Open your reference, point your camera at paper or canvas, and see the image overlaid with accurate proportions. Prop your phone on a glass, tripod, or stack of books — then adjust size, rotation, and transparency with intuitive sliders at the bottom of the screen. Trace with pencil, pen, or brush on real surfaces, not only on the display.

FOUR CREATIVE MODES
• Camera — live-camera tracing: move and resize your reference while you draw
• AR — track an anchor image on a real object so your sketch stays aligned when you move the phone
• Board — sketch on a digital canvas with built-in brushes and tools
• Paint — color and finish your artwork

SKETCHING & TEMPLATES
Import photos from your library or explore stencils and categories inside the app. Apply filters, turn pictures into outlines, build compositions step by step, and transform portraits into expressive sketches. Painter Eye: Canvas Creator adds colors, drawing styles, and monochrome looks for both on-screen and on-paper workflows.

AI & MORE
Create line-ready references faster, browse templates, and go from idea to finished sketch in minutes — whether you love anime, portraits, or everyday subjects.

WHO IT'S FOR
Beginners learning proportions, hobbyists, students, and artists who want accurate tracing on real paper with their own photos — without expensive projector equipment.

Experience the joy of artistic expression where augmented reality and creativity meet.

it.d:
Loved by creative professionals and aspiring artists alike, Procreate is the leading creative application made for iPad.

Procreate has everything you need to create expressive sketches, rich paintings, gorgeous illustrations, and beautiful animations. Offering 100s of handmade brushes, a suite of industry-leading artistic tools, an advanced layer system, and the powerful Valkyrie graphics engine.

It’s a complete art studio you can take anywhere.

Highlights:

- High resolution canvases — up to 16k by 8k on compatible iPad Pros
- Beautifully intuitive interface made for iPad and Apple Pencil
- Revolutionary QuickShape feature for perfect shapes
- Smooth and responsive smudge sampling
- 3D Painting with Lighting Studio, exportable as models, images, or animations
- Powered by Valkyrie, the lightning-fast 64-bit painting engine
- Speed up your workflow with keyboard shortcuts
- Create art in stunning 64-bit color
- Continuous auto-save — never lose work again

Breakthrough brushes:

- Packed with hundreds of beautifully crafted brushes
- Organize your brushes into sets and libraries
- Add Metallic and Roughness for painting in 3D
- Brush Studio — with over 100 customizable settings
- Import and export custom Procreate brushes
- Import Adobe® Photoshop® brushes, and run them faster than Photoshop®

Full-featured layering system:

- Layer your art for precise control over details and composition
- Create Layer Masks and Clipping Masks for non-destructive editing
- Stay organized by combining layers into Groups
- Select multiple layers to move or Transform objects simultaneously
- Access over 25 layer blend modes for industry-grade compositing

Color without compromise:

- Fill your line work with ColorDrop and SwatchDrop
- Disc, Classic, Harmony, Value, and Palette color panels
- Import color profiles for color matching
- Assign Color Dynamics to any brush

Precision design tools:

- Add vector text to your illustrations
- Easily import all your favorite fonts
- Crop and resize your canvas for perfect composition
- Perspective, Isometric, 2D, and Symmetry visual guides
- Drawing Assist perfects your strokes in real time
- StreamLine and stabilization smooths strokes for beautiful calligraphy and expert inking
- Use Scribble to name layers, change settings, and create text

Accessibility features:

- Advanced stroke stabilization
- Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, and Feedback Sounds
- Assignable single-touch gestures
- Color naming

Animation and Page Assist

- Easy frame-by-frame animation with customizable onion skinning
- Create storyboards, GIFs, animatics, and simple animations
- Sketch page-by-page concepts or begin a comic with Page Assist
- Import, edit, and share PDFs

Dramatic finishing effects:

- Brush in image adjustments and effects with Apple Pencil
- Glitch, Chromatic Aberration, Bloom, Noise, and Halftone add new dimensions to your work
- Gaussian, Motion, and Perspective Blur filters create depth and movement
- Powerful image adjustments including Color Balance, Curves, HSB, and Gradient Map
- Bring your art to life with the fun, intuitive, and creative Warp, Symmetry, and Liquify Dynamics

Time-lapse replay

- Relive your creative journey with Procreate’s Time-lapse Replay
- Export your Time-lapse recording in 4K for high-quality video production
- Share a shorter 30-second Time-lapse on your socials

Import assets and share your creations:

- Import or export your art as Adobe® Photoshop® PSD files
- Import Adobe® ASE and ACO Color Palettes
- Import image files such as JPG, PNG, and TIFF
- Export your working files in layered .procreate or PSD file formats
- Share your art as TIFF, transparent PNG, multi-page PDF, web-ready JPEG, OBJ, USDZ, and animated GIFs, PNGs, and MP4s
