it.name: TikTok - Videos, Shop & LIVE
it.d:
TikTok is the global discovery platform for videos, streaming on LIVE, shopping, and more. Our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. Over a billion people come to TikTok to share what they love, learn new things, and find ideas that make everyday life more interesting.

Your experience on TikTok is built around what you're into, not who you know. Just watch, like, and scroll to discover videos, creators, and communities you are delighted to discover. From quick recipes to game highlights, fashion tips to music and trending sounds, your For You feed reflects your current interests and changes based on what surprises and inspires you.

Creating is simple. Capture and post everyday moments and turn them into something special with easy editing tools, effects, sounds, and music. Use our free library of sounds and music in your videos, plus filters and creative tools that help your content stand out. On TikTok, anyone can create, and ideas that inspire pick up momentum.

TikTok is also where discovery becomes part of your everyday life. Find creators to follow, new ideas to try, and products you will love from small businesses and brands around the world. TikTok offers more than 50 preset safety and privacy features, from private accounts and content filters to screen time tools and Family Pairing, so you can choose an experience that works for you. TikTok provides extra support for teens and families on the app, letting you set time and content preferences that feel right for your family. 

■ Personalized discovery
A For You feed that learns what you enjoy. Discover videos, creators, LIVE streams, shopping, and communities based on what you watch, like, and share.
■ Entertainment, learning, and everything in between
Comedy, gaming, DIY, beauty, sports, music, lifestyle, education, and more. Find content that makes you laugh, think, and try something new.
■ Simple, powerful creation tools
Record in clips, pause and resume, trim and merge, add text and stickers, and fine tune your video without leaving the app.
■ Sounds, music, and effects
Use our free library of sounds and music in your videos, plus filters, effects, and creative tools that help you express yourself and make your videos stand out.
■ A global community of creators
Follow your favorite creators and discover new voices every day. Share your own story or support the people who inspire you.
■ Discover and shop with TikTok Shop
Explore trending products, exclusive deals, and seamless shopping experiences inspired by creators and brands you love, all in one place. Shop directly from videos, LIVE, and the Shop tab, track your orders, and enjoy a safe, secure shopping experience.
■ Go LIVE and connect in real time
Start a LIVE to chat with your community, share moments as they happen, and unlock special features and benefits where available.
■ Tools to shape your experience
Use more than 50 safety and privacy features, from private accounts and content filters to screen time tools, Family Pairing, and other controls, to choose how TikTok works for you and your family.

Ready to see what you discover next? Download TikTok to start watching, creating, and exploring your world in a new way.

Wallpapers Central is the iSpazio service entirely dedicated to personalizing your devices. This means: traditional wallpapers, animated wallpapers (LIVE Wallpapers), Depth Effect wallpapers, Spatial Scene 3D wallpapers, and lots of ringtones!

Once you start following someone, the app becomes more personal, unlocking a SECTION JUST FOR YOU where you’ll see wallpapers that best match your style.

From the Home you can also access the UPLOAD feature, allowing you to submit your own wallpapers to share with users worldwide. Every upload goes through a review process to ensure only the highest-quality wallpapers make it into the FEED.

We’ve also made setting RINGTONES easier than ever. Just open the dedicated section, listen to the previews, and tap Download. With a single step you’ll be taken straight into Settings, ready to use them instantly!

•	Customizable user profiles with name and avatar

•	Change the app icon anytime
•	A super-efficient Dark Mode using true black (#000000)
•	Push Notifications for new wallpapers or ringtones
•	A Rewards section with daily prizes

The app is free for everyone, supported by ads that can be removed with a subscription. On top of that, we’ve created a system of Coins, Gems, and Keys that makes every download free for all. Simply collect Coins (always free) and use them for Depth wallpapers, ringtones, or even to unlock extra features! The dedicated Rewards section lets you earn prizes by completing missions—a fun, game-like experience built right into the app.

it.name: PhotoSync – transfer photos
it.d:
** Cross-platform solution with native apps for mobile devices, Windows & Mac. Also works on Linux
** Reliable and secure software – operating 14 years in the market and continuously updated
** No limitations – transfer and backup an unlimited number of photos & videos. Full-resolution transfer with HEIC and RAW support; all metadata (EXIF, GPS) is preserved
** Flexible: Automatically organise files into folders by recording date, media type, album name and metadata on target device. Customisable file names
** Be totally independent of the cloud and iTunes
** Managed App Configuration over MDM or using a settings file (config.photosync-app.com)


—— MAIN FEATURES ——

Transfer to / from computer 
• Directly transfer / backup photos & videos from iPhone / iPad to Windows PC or Mac. Photos & videos are transferred directly over the local Wi-Fi network. No Internet or cloud are required.
• Send photos & videos from Windows PC or Mac over Wi-Fi to iPhone / iPad. Received photos & videos are imported directly into the Camera Roll or an album you defined.

Transfer between phones and tablets
• Directly transfer photos & videos between devices over Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or Personal Hotspot. No computer, Internet or cloud are required.

Transfer to / from NAS, cloud and photo services
• Backup photos & videos to NAS devices, home cloud and wireless portable hard drives over FTP, SMB, WebDAV and SFTP. PhotoSync works flawlessly with: Synology, QNAP, Buffalo NAS, ownCloud, NextCloud, WD MyCloud, TrueNAS, OpenMediaVault…
• Backup photos & videos to / from USB drives, iCloud Drive and local storage via the Files app (iOS13).
• Upload photos & videos to popular cloud and photo services like Dropbox, Google Drive, Google Photos, Flickr, OneDrive, PhotoPrism, SmugMug, Box, pCloud, Zenfolio…
•  Transfer photos & videos directly between devices, services and NAS (e.g. OneDrive to SMB).

Visit photosync-app.com for a complete feature list.


LIMITATIONS
The free version of PhotoSync lets you fully test its transfer functionality. Photos & videos are, however, transferred in low quality. RAW and HEIC photos are converted to JPEG. You can remove these limitations by upgrading to PhotoSync Pro, a one-time purchase, inside the app. 


—— PREMIUM FEATURES ——

Exclusive features for Premium users: 

Autotransfer
Automatically transfer new photos & videos in the background to computer, NAS or supported cloud services, whenever you arrive at pre-selected locations or charge your device.

PhotoSync Camera
Take a photo with the built-in PhotoSync Camera and instantly transfer it to supported targets. Supports Photo Booth over AirPlay & HDMI.

Advanced Siri Support & Workflows
Build powerful workflows using the Siri Actions “Transfer from Clipboard” & “Transfer new photos/videos” – possibilities are endless!

Client-Side Encryption – Protect Your Photos & Videos
Encrypt photos & videos before transfer to ensure safe storage on NAS and file-based cloud services.

Camera Support (Wi-Fi & USB)
Download from Canon, Nikon, Sony, Fujifilm, Olympus & Lumix cameras and cameras connected over WiFi or USB. (Wireless) tethering & photo booth support over Airplay & HDMI.

Additional Premium Services & Features
Support for Amazon S3, Backblaze & Wasabi cloud services, SanDisk iXpand Loop, and Toshiba FlashAir Wi-Fi SD cards.

Visit premium.photosync-app.com for a complete feature list.

Premium features require an additional purchase (one-time purchase or subscription with free trial).


LEGAL
Duration and price of each subscription is displayed in the PhotoSync app at time of purchase. Payment is charged to the iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless automatic renewal is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Subscription and auto-renewal can be managed or turned off in the iTunes account settings.

it.name: Riverside: Record, Edit, Share
it.d:
NEW: MEET RIVERSIDE AGENTS
The first AI production team built only for video, now in your pocket. You finish recording, and your team's already on it. Your Producer preps the session, your Editor creates a rough cut, your Clipper pulls the best moments, and your Marketer gets them live. They're experts at video. You call the shots.

Riverside turns your phone into a portable studio for conversations and talking head videos. Record crisp video and audio anywhere, go live to your audience, and let your agents take it from raw recording to ready to post. Whether you're creating a podcast, a YouTube channel, a personal brand, or content for your business, this is where it gets made.

RECORD ANYWHERE, IN STUDIO QUALITY
Record solo, bring on a remote guest, or go audio-only. Riverside captures every track locally, so your quality stays sharp even when your connection doesn't. A built-in stabilizer keeps your shot steady, and your footage uploads in the background as you record, so your agents can get started the moment you stop.

CLIPS FOR SOCIAL, MADE FOR YOU
Knowing what to post is hard. Making it is harder. Your Clipper agent does both. It finds your most engaging moments before you've even watched the recording back, then cuts them, frames them, and adds the captions. You get the best clips from every recording, ready to publish with a tap.

EDIT WITH A PROMPT
Describe your edit, and your Editor agent makes it. No timeline. No pinching and dragging clips around on a small screen. Tell it which parts to cut and keep, ask it to clean up audio and remove filler words, or add captions and branding. It'll even suggest edits of its own. It's the fastest route from raw recording to ready to post, and when you want more control, your project is waiting for you in the Riverside desktop editor.

TURN ONE RECORDING INTO A CONTENT ENGINE
Your agents take a single recording and make the rest for you: social clips, a thumbnail, captions, a blog post, full show notes. Just ask.

LIVE STREAM TO EVERYWHERE AT ONCE
Go live and multistream to YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Twitch, TikTok, and custom RTMP destinations at the same time. One session, every audience.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Record on your phone and finish on your computer, or start at your desk and keep going on the move. Your videos are synced to the cloud, and your agents keep working in between, so you can review edits, watch your clips, and decide what to post from any device.

A SECOND CAMERA IN YOUR POCKET
Recording on desktop? Add your phone as a second angle and capture an extra video track for your edit.

BUILT FOR CREATORS OF EVERY KIND
Podcasters, YouTubers, personal brands, and marketing teams. Anyone who wants studio-quality content without the studio.

WHY RIVERSIDE
• Riverside Agents, the first AI production team built only for video
• True local recording for quality independent of your connection
• One recording = instantly generated clips, thumbnails, posts, and more
• AI editing and audio cleanup
• Full production suite across mobile and desktop

Download Riverside and take your studio anywhere.

Terms & Conditions: https://riverside.com/terms-conditions
Privacy: https://riverside.com/privacy-policy

Everyone is “about” community. We actually are one: Whatever you nerd out about, you can find your people on Twitch. 
Give support, get support: Find new streamers and subscribe to your favorites. Plus,  unlock exclusive perks for your support. 
Start your own channel: The Twitch app is one of the easiest ways to start streaming. Just create an account, go live directly from the app, and bring people together around whatever you’re passionate about.

CAMERA COLLECTION
Explore different cameras, each with its own look, colors, personality, and feeling.

ORIGINAL CAMERA
Use your iPhone camera with beautiful film inspired filters and color styles. Perfect when you want a clean photo with your favorite aesthetic.

FILM AND ANALOG CAMERAS
Create nostalgic photos inspired by classic film photography.
Try different film rolls, vintage colors, analog looks, retro filters, grain effects, and timeless photography styles.

OLD PHONE CAMERAS
Bring back the nostalgic feeling of early mobile photography.
Capture photos inspired by old phone cameras, with unique colors, imperfections, and a retro digital aesthetic.

DISPOSABLE CAMERAS

ARTISTIC CAMERAS
Experiment with creative cameras, dreamy effects, unique filters, artistic looks, and original photography styles.

REAL TIME CAMERA FILTERS
Stop editing every photo afterwards.
With Rumi Cam, every effect is applied directly in the camera preview, so you can see your final photo before you capture it.
No guessing. No endless editing. Just choose your look and shoot.

FILM ROLLS AND COLOR STYLES
Change the feeling of your camera instantly with different film rolls and photo effects.

Explore:
* Vintage film filters
* Analog colors
* Retro photo effects
* Cinematic looks
* Creative presets
* Unique color styles

CAMERA ACCESSORIES

* Fisheye lens
* Prism lens

Transform your camera and discover new perspectives.

MANUAL CAMERA CONTROLS
Take more control over your photos with:
* Exposure adjustment
* White balance control
* Aspect ratio selection

A CAMERA THAT FEELS LIKE A REAL CAMERA
Modern smartphone photos can sometimes feel too processed and perfect.
Rumi Cam is designed to create photos with more character. Images that feel natural, nostalgic, and personal.
The goal is not only perfect pixels.
The goal is photos with a vibe.

PHOTO AND VIDEO
Capture both photos and videos using your favorite cameras, filters, effects, lenses, and creative styles.

MORE COMING SOON

Rumi Cam will continue growing with:

* New cameras
* New film rolls
* New filters
* New lens accessories
* New creative tools

Find the perfect camera for every moment.
Download Rumi Cam and start shooting.

it.name: OpenCam: Open Gate Camera
it.d:
OpenCam is a professional video camera for creators and filmmakers on iPhone. Capture flexible 4:3 footage, take manual control and read your script while recording.

Capture more. Reframe later.
Record in 4:3 HD+ or 4K+ to leave room for vertical and horizontal edits in your favorite editor. Create for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube from the same take. Switch cameras mid-recording on compatible formats.

Professional recording
Choose ProRes, HDR, Apple Log or Apple Log 2, and adjustable HEVC bitrate options. Record at up to 60fps in supported formats. On compatible cameras, record full-sensor 4.2K open-gate ProRes RAW internally, without needing an external recorder. Apple Log 2 and ProRes RAW require iOS 26 or later and supported camera hardware.

Preview your look
Import .cube LUT files and preview your Apple Log footage with your chosen look while recording.

Manual control, clearly presented
Adjust focus, shutter speed, ISO, white balance and brightness. Lock exposure with a tap for consistent results. Aperture control requires a compatible iPhone 18 Pro camera, iOS 27 or later and OpenCam Pro.

A teleprompter that follows you
Keep your script over the camera view with customizable text, fixed-speed scrolling or voice following. Your script stays out of the recorded video. Voice following uses on-device recognition and requires iOS 26 or later and a supported language; a language download may be needed. Teleprompter requires OpenCam Pro.

See exposure and sound
Check your shot with a live RGB histogram and audio level meters.

Move with control
Use Glide Zoom for smooth, controlled zoom and dramatic dolly-style shots. Cinematic stabilization is available with Pro on compatible non-RAW formats.

DockKit support
Use compatible DockKit gimbals for subject tracking and supported recording, camera-switching and zoom controls.

Ready from the Lock Screen
Launch OpenCam from its Lock Screen widget. Compatible systems also support Control Center and Action button shortcuts.

Privacy first

it.name: Pixelmator Classic iOS
it.d:
Pixelmator is a powerful, full-featured, layer-based image editor that lets you add shapes, images, and text to create beautiful image compositions, touch up and enhance images, sketch, and paint on iPad and iPhone alike.

Designed exclusively for iOS and iPadOS, Pixelmator takes full advantage of the latest iOS and iPadOS 17 features and technologies, giving you innovative, fast, and powerful tools.

Create Eye-Catching Designs

- Combine words, shapes, and images to create breathtaking artwork right on your iPhone and iPad
- Apply non-destructive layer styles like shadows, outlines, gradient fills, and more
- Insert, group, and blend layers of an image
- Easily add, combine, and customize shapes
- Blend layers, shapes, and text using any of the blending modes
- Use precise selection tools to edit areas of an image
- Automatically select subjects in images with the machine learning-powered Select Subject
- Crop, arrange, and rotate objects and layers with pixel-perfect precision
- Easily remove the background of images or cut and paste objects from one image to another

Add Shapes and Text

- Create flyers, logos, and other compositions using vector shapes and their styling options
- Customize Smart Shapes with easy-to-use controls
- Add text and make it look gorgeous with 24 pre-designed text styles
- Change the font, size, alignment, line spacing, use custom fonts, and more

Paint and Sketch

- Paint stunning images right on your iPhone and iPad
- Choose from over artist-designed brushes and numerous painting techniques
- Paint with near-natural wetness effect of watercolor and crayon brushes
- Create stunning pixel art images with the custom-designed Pixel brush
- Paint with incredible detail thanks to the double texture brush technology
- Vary the speed of your stroke to change the thickness of some of the brushes
- Easily select and fine-tune colors with a full-featured color picker
- Instantly choose colors right from your image with the Eyedropper
- Paint more naturally than ever with the Apple Pencil, featuring palm rejection, pressure, tilt, and acceleration sensitivity

Edit and Enhance Photos

- Get started with dozens of beautifully designed templates
- Instantly improve your photos with single-tap color presets
- Take full control over the tonal range of your image with levels and curves
- Easily remove color casts and set the right white balance
- Wipe away image imperfections, skin blemishes, and unwanted objects with the Repair tool
- Duplicate areas of your image with the easy-to-use Clone tool
- Pinch, bump, twirl, or warp areas of an image with powerful, Metal-based Distort tools
- Blur, sharpen, lighten, or darken areas of an image
- Choose from dozens of breathtaking effects to subtly improve or completely change the look of an image
- Open and edit images of up to 256 megapixels

Export and Share Images

- Optimize images for the web using quality, color depth, and size settings
- Export images to Files, iCloud, or open in other apps using a file format of your choice
- Using the integrated share extension, easily share your artwork with friends and family using Mail, AirDrop, or post it to social platforms like Instagram, Twitter, or Facebook

Compatibility

- Open and save images using HEIF, JPEG, PNG, and TIFF formats
- Work with multilayered Pixelmator Pro and Adobe Photoshop documents
- Save your edited images directly to Photos
- Create, edit, and keep all your images up to date on all your devices thanks to iCloud support
- External keyboard support with over 70 keyboard shortcuts

Built for iPhone and iPad

- Pixelmator is meticulously thought through and created from the ground up for iPhone and iPad devices
- Designed to take full advantage of powerful iOS and iPadOS features and technologies — iCloud Drive, Photos extension, Split View, and more
- Thanks to Apple silicon, Metal, Core Image, and Core Animation, Pixelmator delivers state-of-the-art performance and real-time responsiveness

• Add filters and captivating effects to your images

Breakthrough brushes:

• Packed with hundreds of beautifully crafted brushes

Color without compromise:

• Easily import all your favorite fonts

Animation and Page Assist

• Easy frame-by-frame animation with customizable onion skinning
• Create storyboards, GIFs, animatics, and simple animations
• Sketch page-by-page concepts, or begin a comic, with Page Assist
• Import, edit, and share PDFs

Dramatic finishing effects:

• Gradient Map — remap your image’s colors with a customizable gradient

Time-lapse replay

• Relive your creative journey with Procreate’s Time-lapse Replay
• Export your Time-lapse recording in 4K for high-quality video production
• Share a shorter 30-second Time-lapse on your socials

Reference Companion:

• Keep a full canvas or reference image with you at all times

• Share your art as TIFF, transparent PNG, multi-page PDF, web-ready JPEG, and animated GIFs, PNGs, and MP4s

Accessibility

• Global stroke stabilization, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, and color naming

Easy to Share

For everyone around the world who wants to draw and animate, freely and without pressure.

ibisPaint X is a full-featured illustration and animation app for smartphones and tablets, with over 500 million cumulative downloads across the series.

RunCut — Animated Routes. Dynamic Stats.

Turn your runs and rides into stunning videos with animated recaps or real-time workout overlays.

RunCut transforms your workout data into beautiful videos with animated routes, dynamic stats, and real-time workout overlays. Choose between Recap or Sync with Video mode, then export in up to 4K for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and more.

Whether you're tracking a morning run, a long cycling ride, or a personal best effort, RunCut helps you turn your workout into a video worth sharing.

KEY FEATURES

• Beautiful stats overlays
Add distance, pace, speed, elevation, heart rate, calories, cadence, and more directly to your videos.

• Animated routes & workout data
Visualize your route and performance metrics with smooth animations and dynamic map flyovers.

• Sync with Video
Overlay your workout data on recorded videos in real time, or create classic animated recap videos.

• Up to 4K export
Export in Full HD, 2K, or stunning 4K resolution for the best quality on social media.

• Health & FIT file import
Import activities from Apple Health, or FIT files from supported fitness platforms and devices.

• Privacy by design
Rendered locally. Your workout data never leaves your device.

• Templates & visual styles
Choose from professionally designed templates, overlays, and effects.

• Built for social sharing
Export high-quality videos optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and more.

• Your personal workout archive
Keep your routes, highlights, and workout memories in one place.

SUPPORTED ACTIVITIES

• Running
• Cycling

WHY YOU’LL LOVE RUNCUT

• Share more than just a screenshot.
• Turn workout data into engaging videos.
• Showcase your routes, stats, and achievements.
• Create beautiful workout videos in seconds.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Import an activity from Apple Health or a FIT file.
2. Choose Recap or Sync with Video mode.
3. Customize your video with templates, overlays, and styles.
4. RunCut automatically generates your video.
5. Export in up to 4K and share anywhere.

RunCut — Your Workout. Your Story.

desc: Chức năng đã thêm: Pro - IPA đã được kiểm tra và tổng hợp bởi TTJB Team

it.name: Artstudio Pro: Draw, Paint
it.d:
Introducing Artstudio Pro, the most powerful painting and photo editing app available for both iOS and macOS. The successor to our famous ArtStudio app has been redesigned bringing many new features and improvements taking full advantage of the latest technologies Metal, iCloud Drive, Apple Pencil, and optimized for 64-bit multi-core processors to achieve the smoothest possible workflow.

Powerful engine
App is based on the powerful GPU accelerated ArtEngine developed by Lucky Clan. It allows working with multiple documents, supports large canvas sizes and an unlimited number of layers. Incredible optimization ensures smooth work even with large canvases.
• Realistic Color Pigment Blending
• Canvas size up to 64Mpix
• Unlimited layers
• Multiple open documents
• 27 tools: Move, Select, Crop, Eyedropper, Paint, Wet Paint, Eraser, Bucket/Pattern/Gradient Fill, Smudge, Dodge, Burn, Sponge, Text, Heal, Clone, and more
• Full iCloud integration

Flexible layer system
Artstudio Pro introduces a new layer system with grouping, non-destructive layer effects, and adjustment layers.
• Groups
• Masks, clipping masks
• Adjustment Layers
• 9 layer effects: Bevel/Emboss, Stroke, Inner Shadow, Inner Glow, Outer Glow, Color/Gradient/Pattern Overlay, Drop Shadow
• Text layers

Advanced Brush engine
Perfectly optimized, lag free mechanism generating smooth, real looking strokes, making the most of Apple Pencil.
• Brush size up to 4000x4000
• 64-bit painting with pattern, double stamp, wet brush, dynamics
• Brush editor with over 100 customizable settings
• Over 150 built-in brushes divided into multiple groups: Pens, Pencils, Oil Painting, Inking, Charcoals, Airbrushes, Watercolor and many more
• Symmetric painting

Professional photo editor
Photo editing options developed in cooperation with professional photographers. Each feature was tested in several scenarios and light conditions.
• 15 adjustments available as non-destructive layer or simple adjustment: Brightness/Contrast, Levels, Curves, Exposure/Gamma, Shadows/Highlights, Vibrance, Hue/Saturation, Color Balance, Temperature/Tint, Black and White, Gradient Map and more
• 4 auto adjustments: Auto Contrast, Levels, Lightness, Saturation
• Transform: Basic, Perspective, Warp
• Dozens of filters with realtime preview and the ability to generate seamless patterns
• Inpaint, Elastify (Liquify)
• Retouching tools: Heal, Dodge, Burn, Sponge and more
• Image resize, Canvas resize
• Crop and Trim

Animation
Create animation from layers or groups and finally export it to one of the most popular animation format
 • Scrollable timeline view with Play/Pause
 • Onion skin
 • Customizable Frame duration
 • Always visible layers
 • Export to MP4, HEVC, Animated GIF/PNG

Import/Export
We have implemented many parsers from the most popular assets/images formats and we are especially  proud of our ABR/TPL parser which not only reads brush stamps and patterns, but also most settings which are converted to Artstudio Pro brush engine values.
Import
• Images - PNG, JPEG, PSD, HEIC, TIFF, GIF, PDF, most raw formats
• Brushes - ABR, TPL
• Color swatches - ASE, ACO
• Patterns - PAT
• Gradients - GRD
• Fonts - TTF, OTF
Export
• Images - PNG, JPEG, PSD, TIFF, PDF

Other features
• Floating panels for Colors, Layers, Brushes etc
• Screen recording
• Customizable Quick menu
• Customizable Shortcuts
• Snapping to guidelines, dynamic guidelines, grid
• Perspective grid assist
• Mirror (flipped) view
• Support of iPad Drag and Drop, Split View, Sharing Extension, Open In, Clipboard

Free version limitations:
• locked Saving
• canvas size limited to device screen size
• layers count limited to 3
• export only to jpg
• locked animation export

Minimum System Requirements
Artstudio Pro for iOS requires iPhone or iPad running iOS 15.0 or above

Think, plan & create – Concepts is a flexible vector-based sketchbook where you can take your ideas from concept to reality.

Concepts reimagines the ideation process – offering a safe and dynamic workspace to iterate and explore your ideas, organize your thoughts, and experiment with designs. 

With our infinite canvas, you can:
• Sketch plans and whiteboard ideas
• Make notes, doodles, and mindmaps
• Draw storyboards, product sketches and designs

Concepts is vector-based, making every stroke editable and scalable. With our Nudge, Slice and Select tools, you can easily change any element of your sketch without redrawing it. 

Talented creators at Disney, Playstation, Philips, HP, Apple, Google, Unity and Illumination Entertainment use Concepts to develop and realize extraordinary ideas. Join us!

Concepts has:

• An infinite canvas with optional paper types and grids
• Realistic pens, pencils and brushes that flow with pressure, tilt and velocity or create your own
• A tool wheel or bar you can personalize
• HSL, RGB and COPIC color wheels
• Editable vector-based sketching – move, organize and edit the tool, color, size, scale, smoothing, opacity; transform or nudge lines to shape them 
• Unlimited layers
• Scale and measurement tools that calculate real-world dimensions

With Concepts, you can:
• Drag + drop images + PDF files 
• Create, store and share vector Object libraries 
• Export images, vector SVG + PDFs to scale for printing or efficient flow between apps (including Procreate, Sketchbook, AutoCAD and Adobe)
• Share directly to email, text, Files, cloud, photos, or your favorite social apps and present with AirPlay or a second screen
• Store your work safely in your personal iCloud Drive

FREE FEATURES
• Infinite canvas
• A selection of paper, grid types & tools to get you started
• The full COPIC color spectrum, RGB and HSL color wheels
• Five layers
• Unlimited drawings
• JPG exports

PAID FEATURES
Subscription:
• 200+ brush and Object libraries, features, and services
• Enjoy Team Sharing for smooth collaboration, including live-sharing of object libraries, color palettes & brushes, with new updates arriving all the time
• Unlocks everything across platforms
• TRY PREMIUM FREE FOR 7 DAYS

it.name: DoubleTake - Multicam video
it.d:
DoubleTake transforms your iPhone into a multi-cam studio allowing you to capture video from two cameras at the same time on recent devices*

*NOTE:  Per iOS 15 capabilities, multi-cam video is restricted to the following devices only:  iPhone 13 series devices, iPhone 12 series devices, iPhone 11 Pro Max, 11 Pro, 11, Xs Max, Xs, Xr, SE 2. iPad Pro 2018 and newer.  While this app will install and function on all devices supported by iOS 15, all devices outside of this list will be restricted to recording video from on a single camera.

Use DoubleTake to record video in new ways:

- Camera Visualization:  Better than a director’s viewfinder!  Use DoubleTake’s camera picker view to visualize all available cameras for your device.  Use this view to help decide how to frame your shot and which cameras you will select.

- Shot/Reverse shot:  To capture all the organic and intimate interaction between two actors or interviewer and interviewee.  Traditionally, filmmakers would need to employ two cameras and place these in cumbersome ‘over the shoulder’ locations.  With DoubleTake you can place one device in between your actors and place the audience right in the middle of the conversation.

- Multi-cam:  Capture two different focal lengths of the same subject at the same time.  Use DoubleTake with the Ultra Wide lens (iPhone 11 Pro Max, 11 Pro and 11 only) and the Tele to capture both an establishing shot and a punch-in on your subject simultaneously. Or use any other combination of front and rear lenses for unrivaled multi-cam capture.

- PiP or Discreet:  The DoubleTake interface allows you to see both cameras of your video capture at the same time through the use of a Picture in Picture (PiP) window.  You can move this PiP around the screen, tap to zoom in, or swipe it away if it’s distracting (the second video will continue to record).  With DoubleTake you can decide if you want to record your videos as separate discrete files or if you want the video recorded as a composite video that includes the PiP window animated as you see it on the screen.

- Split-screen: Doubletake also allows you to use any two cameras to create a 50/50 split-screen effect that is saved as a single video. This is great for capturing engaging interviews, or any scenario where two sides of the story need equal weighting on screen.

- Focus & Exposure Controls: DoubleTake allows you to set and lock your focus and exposure on both cameras during multi-cam capture with our unified reticle. Just tap anywhere to set an area of interest with the reticle, then tap again to lock or unlock. Our easy to use camera switcher lets you effortlessly move between your A and B cams during a recording to adjust the focus and exposure for each independently of one another.

Video Specs:
- Full frame focus and exposure for smooth and easy automated focus and exposure adjustments.

- Selectable broadcast frame rates:  24fps, 25fps, and 30fps depending on your project requirements.

- 1080p video at high bitrate encoding for maximum quality.  (note: 1080p video is the maximum resolution supported by the Apple API for multi-cam capture).

- Composited PiP or separate discreet video files recorded as .h264 .mov files are saved to DoubleTake’s internal library which supports batch export to the Camera Roll.

Minipaper is a wallpaper maker for iPhone and iPad. Pick a style, change whatever you want, and export a custom Lock Screen or Home Screen wallpaper that fits your screen exactly. No design skills, no templates to fight with, and no two exports alike.

Over 30 styles, every one of them built to be taken apart and rebuilt.

STICKERS
Put anything on your wallpaper. Start from the RetroTech pack or a curated set of SF Symbols, type your own with text and emoji, or drop in a photo and watch subject isolation lift it straight off the background. Drag, pinch and rotate to place, resize from the corners, then finish with a clean white border or a holographic foil. Select several at once, copy a layout from one design to another, or hit sticker-bomb and let them scatter.

OBJECTS, NOT JUST GRADIENTS
An iPod with a click wheel and anodized case, worn from pristine to pocket-scratched. A vinyl record. A handheld console. An AC remote, a CRT monitor, an airplane seat-back screen. The skeuomorphic styles are laid out so their screens sit exactly where your Lock Screen clock lands, and the whole phone reads as the object.

GRADIENTS, GLASS AND SHAPES
Aurora, Mesh Gradient, Pro Gradient and Japanese Gradient. Liquid Glass, Fluted Glass, Legacy Glass and Glass Bricks. Arch, Bento, Capsules, Plateau, Rects, Grid, Notes, Text, Tide, Topography, Mountains, Polka, Prism, Calendar and Vision OS.

IPHONE AND IPAD
The same app on both, laid out for each. On iPad the browse list gets a sidebar, the skeuomorphic styles keep their true proportions in the middle of the canvas instead of stretching, and the controls stay in reach. Your saved designs follow you across.

MAKE IT ACTUALLY YOURS
Every style opens up. Colours, layout, texture, wear, type, the lot. Nudge one setting or rebuild the thing from scratch. Save your designs and come back to them later, because a wallpaper is never quite finished.

EXPORTS THAT FIT
Wallpapers render at your device's full resolution and follow your device's real display corner radius, so nothing is cropped, squashed or resized to fit. Export a still or a Live Photo, save it to Photos, and set it from there.

ALWAYS SOMETHING NEW
New styles land regularly, along with collabs with apps and designers we like. Everything you have already made keeps working.

Minipaper speaks English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Dutch and Arabic.

Here are some of the powerful features of NOMO RAW.

* 16-Bit Image Processing Pipeline: On iOS we can only store 8-Bit colors into HEIF and JPEG files, however, before the final saving, NOMO RAW used end-to-end 16-Bit pipeline to maintain the color depth from ProRAW and improve the final result.

* Image Refinement: With ProRAW as the starting point, NOMO RAW could further remove the artifacts on your mobile photos, including over sharpening, luminance noise, detail loss, etc.

* RAW + HEIF/JPEG: To make document management much easier, you can choose to save RAW and HEIF/JPEG images to the one file or two separated files, meanwhile, you can turn off the saving of RAW and compressed images seperately.

* Compression Ratio: Low, Medium, or High. Now you can save larger compressed files compared to the iOS camera. Or smaller files to save your storage space.

* Auto Assistants: NOMO RAW has all the visual assitants to help you taking better pictures -- Histogram, Horizon Indicators, Focus Peaking & Zoom, Zebra Stripes, Thirds, etc.

it.name: Retro — Photos with Friends
it.d:
Retro is a radical new idea: a social app where you share real photos with real friends.

It's the app that we wanted for our own family and friends, and for you, it should feel like a breath of fresh air.

Retro is a weekly photo journal that (1) brings you closer to the people you actually care about and (2) helps you appreciate your own life - all without the distractions and pressure of big social media. 

So dust off those photos that are just sitting in your camera roll and spread some joy in the world. 

Say hi to us at founders@retro.app

And if you’re still reading, here are some reasons to try Retro:

- EASY TO START: Start by choosing photos you’ve already taken and backfill the weeks on your profile with the photos and videos you want to remember. 

- NO PRESSURE: Everything was designed with your comfort in mind. Your friend list is private. Likes on your posts are private. No captions required. Update any part of your profile anytime. 

- PRINT & SHIP POSTCARDS: Spread some joy through snail mail by printing your photo as a high quality postcard and sending it to anyone in the world via USPS first class.

- MONTHLY RECAPS: Create a beautiful photo collage or video slideshow from the photos you’ve shared from the week, month, or year. Then share via text or Instagram in a tap.

- GROUP ALBUMS: Start a private album and drop the link in your group chat to collect and share photos after events. Perfect for parties, projects, friends, parents, and couples. 

- GROUP MESSAGING: Retro is now an all-in-one home for groups large and small, with the ability to share photos, videos, and notes privately in Albums and start group chats in Messages.

- HOME SCREEN WIDGETS: See the newest posts from friends or time hop back to your own memories with our new widgets.

We've poured our hearts into this, and we hope you love it.

Terms of use: https://retro.app/terms

Create beautiful images for sharing screenshots, social posts, text, source code, podcasts and more so quickly it seems unreal.

UNLIMITED FREE USE WITH NO WATERMARKS on single framed screenshots.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

* Add a perfectly fitted device frame to screenshots from iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and more. Perfect for sharing lock & home screen setups, promoting apps or adding device images to web content. Use batch mode to process many images instantly with consistent results.

* Hide or blur personal information like names, faces and bank details with a single tap.

* Instantly create images from social post links for reposting or adding to presentation slides, with option to include original links and QR Codes. (Supports X, BlueSky, Mastodon)
* Add text or Markdown to post online as images using the supplied themes for announcements or promotions.

* Paste source code fragments to get syntax-highlighted images for sharing online or in presentations.

* Import links to automatically create attractive "card" images for sharing.

All standard device bezels are included for free, always.

A Pro subscription removes restrictions on more advanced features including: batch mode, custom background images, custom frame images, and Shortcuts.

BACKGROUNDS
* Add a pretty background — with thousands of gradient variations, striped patterns, and LGBTQ+ and solidarity flags to show off your screenshot.
* Highlight your image with the light position control for shadow and lighting effects in the background.
* Use any custom image as a background. (*)

MAGIC IMPORT
* Paste, Drop, Open or directly type in text that is automatically rendered as an attractive image.
* Text and Markdown is converted to an image using themes provided.
* Source Code is drawn with syntax highlighting.
* Links to Social Posts produce social "cards" without having to crop a screenshot (X, BlueSky and Mastodon).
* Apple Music, Apple Maps, App Store, YouTube and podcast links all create shareable card images.

BATCH MODE (*)
* Import many images in batch mode, apply the same style settings to all and
see the changes instantly with automatic file naming.
* Customize per-image settings like device frame, corner radius and privacy redactions.
* Create framed or text-based image carousels by dropping/importing multiple files and drag out the resulting images directly into another app to post them.

PRIVACY
* Automatic detection of Identification, Financial information and Faces.
* Always automatically hides Financial information.
* Tap a button to hide a piece of information or show it.
* Multiple redaction styles.

THE PERFECT FRAME
* Device frames always fit the resolution of the screenshot, no janky stretched or cropped images.
* Add your own custom frame with a clear area where the screenshot should be — frame any images!
* Use any image if no frame is required, or choose "No frame" if you prefer to go without.

SHORTCUTS & SIRI
* Automate batch processing with powerful Shortcuts actions to frame each screenshot in the input.
* Many powerful Shortcut Intents: "Frame last screenshot", "Open Shareshot with most recent screenshot", "Frame Screenshots", "Frame Screenshots with a custom background", "Create Image from Text", "Create Image from Links" and "Create Image from Source Code".
* Siri "App Shortcut" support for saying "New Shareshot" to frame the last screenshot, opens the app ready for you to tweak the background.

 (*) - Requires Pro

For Terms of Use see: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

it.name: Upflix - Streaming Tracker
it.d:
Your guide to what's new on streaming. Discover what premiered today on the services you already subscribe to and find your next favorite movie or series.

Upflix is the ultimate smart companion for streaming subscribers. If you are a subscriber to Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video, Max, or Hulu, Upflix helps you stop wasting time searching and start watching what matters.

PLEASE NOTE: UPFLIX IS AN INFORMATIONAL GUIDE, NOT A STREAMING SERVICE. WE DO NOT STREAM OR HOST MOVIES.

Stop the "infinite scroll" and let our intelligence find your next favorite title.

- SMARTER DECISIONS WITH APPLE INTELLIGENCE:
 Don't guess if a movie is good. Powered by Apple Intelligence, Upflix analyzes and summarizes thousands of critic and user reviews into a single "Smart Verdict." Know in seconds if a title is worth your time.

- WHERE TO FIND (NO GUESSWORK):
 Instantly discover which legal platform has the movie or show you’re looking for. We track availability across Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video, Max, Hulu, AppleTV+, Paramount+, and Crunchyroll. Not sure on which platform your favorite movie or series is available? Our tool allows you to save time and find where to watch your favorite content. 
   • Did you know that "Lord of The Rings" is available on Netflix, Hulu, and Max? 
   • And that HBO's "Ballers" is on Netflix? 
   • Oh, did you hear that Netflix removed "My Neighbor Totoro"?

- UNIFIED SEARCH ENGINE:
Search all your streaming services in one single hit. More than 50.000 movies and TV shows are available with trailers, descriptions, cast, reviews, ratings and more.

- PRO EPISODE TRACKER:
 Never miss a release. Follow your favorite series and receive real-time notifications the moment a new episode or season drops on your specific streaming service.

- UNIFIED WATCHLIST:
 Keep your cinema life organized. Create a single, powerful watchlist that combines titles from all your different subscriptions into one unified place.

- EXPERT RATINGS:
 Access accurate, up-to-date scores from IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, and TMDB. Filter the best-rated content and skip the "fillers."

- ROULETTE DUO:
 Can’t decide what to watch with your partner? Use Roulette Duo to swipe Tinder-style through your combined watchlists until you get a "Match!"

- WHAT UPFLIX DOES NOT DO:
   • It is NOT a streaming player or a "Free Movie" app. 
   • It does NOT provide access to content without a legal subscription. 
   • It does NOT host or transmit any video files.

Upflix is the brain behind your TV, helping you manage and enjoy your legal subscriptions more efficiently.

Supported platforms: Netflix, Max, Disney+, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, AppleTV+, Paramount+, and Crunchyroll.

All film-related metadata, including actor/director names, synopses, and trailers, is supplied by The Movie Database (TMDB). Upflix uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

it.name: VinylStudio: Record Mockups
it.d:
Turn your music and ideas into stunning physical art.
Design custom vinyl records, ultra-realistic mockups, and unique visual concepts right from your device. Whether you are a musician visualizing your next physical release, a designer building a portfolio, or a dedicated vinyl enthusiast, this app is your ultimate creative studio.

Endless customization
Take complete control over every single detail of your vinyl pressing. With over 10 base styles and more than 100 unique effects, the creative possibilities are limitless.
– Shape and size: Choose from default shapes including Circle, Heart, Star, Flower, Broken, Fire Heart, and Razor, or design your own custom shapes to match your vision.
– Base types: Build your foundation with types like Picture Disc, Solid, Half Split, Tri Split, Quad Split, Stripe, and Twist.
– Visual effects: Layer your choice of effects, featuring Cloudy, Color In Color, Cornetto, Glitter, Inkplosion, Liquid Filled, Marble, Ripple, Smoke, Splatter, Starburst, Swirl, and many more.
– Authentic details: Customize everything from the record size to the surface layer, shrink wrap, hype stickers, and a custom center label.

Smart design tools
– Auto-generate from cover: Just drop in an album cover. The app automatically extracts the dominant color palette and generates a unique starting design for you to tweak.
– Zoetrope preview: Visualize mesmerizing frame-stepped motion with the built-in zoetrope preview while your record spins.

Export in 3D and high resolution
– Image mockups: Export crisp, high-quality images of your custom vinyl to use for merch, social media, or presentations.
– 3D spinning videos: Render and export stunning 3D videos of your record spinning. Further customize your video presentations using pre-made templates and slipmat options.

Try before you upgrade
VinylStudio includes a free experience that lets you explore the app before subscribing. You’ll get two Collection slots and two exports at no cost, giving you the opportunity to discover the creative tools and decide if VinylStudio Pro is worth it for you. Pro unlocks unlimited access to all features.

it.name: Film Camera - Vintage Camera
it.d:
Film Cam is a vintage analog film camera app, where every shutter press delivers an element of surprise.

The joy of photography shouldn't be limited by equipment. That's why we bring the charm of vintage cameras to every enthusiast. Film Cam features a diverse collection of classic cameras—instant, CCD, disposable, toy cameras, slide projectors, etc.

We integrate rich effects and frames to recreate real camera textures and colors, simulating film visuals. Live Photos, video, RAW, Frame Drop, negative editing, and collage templates are all waiting for you.

# Classic Cameras
- FNC: Recreating the Fujifilm's NC filter, it adds warmth and storytelling to the image
- K Funs: A nod to Kodak's FunSaver disposable camera, it offers a high-saturation vintage feel
- FC 100: Bringing back the iconic color science of Fujicolor 100, it's your go-to for everyday shots
- GRN: Inspired by the Ricoh GR series' Negative Film mode, it brings elegant, crisp, and soft blue tones
- Peel: It recreates the ritual of peel-apart film, where the waiting becomes a tiny thrill
- Halo 800: Channel the legendary look of CineStill 800T cine film for a cinematic romance
- NOKIA: Recreating the lo-fi aesthetic of a Y2K Nokia phone lens and bring back the nostalgia
- G7X: Mimic the Canon G7X series, a favorite for portraits, and capture a clean, airy look
- Inst M: It recreates the feel and little ritual of Instax Mini prints with just one tap
- Pola N: A throwback to the nostalgic Polaroid Now series, it delivers warm and real colors
- H Glow: It simulates the charm of Holga’s lo-fi plastic lens, producing unpredictable, uniquely perfect frames
- FQS: Inspired by the Fujifilm QuickSnap 1986, it recreates the texture of this disposable film camera
- CCD: Reviving the crisp tones with soft focus of CCD images, it touches your memories with a digital glow
- VHS: Inspired by old-school VHS camcorders, it brings warmth to the memories
- H 500C: A tribute to the iconic Hasselblad 500C, it captures understated, timeless colors and rich tonal depth
- CAS: Channeling the Canon Autoboy S, it captures the nostalgic beauty of '90s street photography

Explore more vintage cameras and creative features in our App!

# Key Features
- Capture photos, Live Photos and videos with real-time preview to check the final result before you shoot
- Create artistic looks with double exposure, RAW mode, Frame Drop, and fisheye lens
- Import multiple photos and batch edit them with vintage filters, effects, and frames
- Fine-tune colors: adjust brightness, contrast, highlights, shadows, saturation, and more.
- Collect and manage your favorite retro cameras for a personalized experience
- Preset camera settings to suit your needs: exposure, focal length, white balance, aspect ratio, flash, timer, mirror, etc.
- Add trendy effects to express your style: timestamps, light leaks, flares, noise, scratches, stars, animated doodles, etc
- Frame your masterpieces with different styles: film, instant, cover, etc.
- Keep negatives to edit freely: switch camera filters, effects, or frames, and crop, rotate, or adjust as you wish
- Get designed collages: wrap your shots in slideshows, peel-aparts, slide films, etc. and edit your way
- Recover deleted photos: recover them anytime within 30 days.

Each vintage camera comes with a unique story and tips to guide your shooting.

Tag #filmcam on social media, and our team may feature your shots!

If you have any questions, please contact us via email at: iosfilmfeedback@gmail.com

- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period, unless canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends

Create logos, illustrations, graphics and more. Illustrator on the iPad works intuitively with your Apple Pencil so you can design on the go from anywhere, even offline - it’s never been easier to take your creativity to new places.

Design with precision, as naturally as you would with pen and paper. Create vector lines, shapes, type, gradients, and effects. Merge or cut graphics with quick, intuitive Pencil gestures to remove unwanted areas. Make your graphics pop with effects, and access over 18,000 fonts, 20+ color palettes, up-to-the-minute live streams from famous creatives, and guided tutorials.

Work on a project across Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and Fresco. Plus, your Illustrator work is automatically synced to the cloud, so you and your team can always access the latest version from your desktop or iPad.

This app is part of Adobe Creative Cloud. It’s free for Creative Cloud members who have a plan that includes Illustrator.

INTUITIVE AND PRECISE DRAWING WITH APPLE PENCIL 
• Natural ways to draw — Make lines and curves using the Pen, Pencil, and Brush tools
• Art and Calligraphic Brushes — Create and apply brush strokes to add artistic elements to your artwork.
• Pinpoint editing — Create perfect graphics without quality loss with Smart Delete, Simplify Path, and more
• Point precision — Edit graphics down to the point, radius, or angle level

NEW WAYS TO MAKE STUNNING PATTERNS AND SHAPES
• Vectorize —  Convert raster images or paper sketches into vector images.
• Radial, grid, and mirror repeat — Turn graphics into sophisticated patterns
• Polygon shape creation — Make objects out of circles, triangles, squares, and stars
• Transform as Shape — Transform paths and curves without manual manipulation of anchor points.
• Blend Tool — Smoothly blend one shape into another across a specified number of steps.

THE MOST COMPREHENSIVE TYPE TOOLKIT FOR IPAD 
• 18,000+ fonts — Use one of the thousands of high-quality fonts included in the Adobe Fonts library
• Fonts of your own — Upload and design with any of your own licensed fonts and use them on both desktop and iPad 
• Type on a path — Bend and flow text onto the surface of lines and shapes 
• Outlined text — Turn text into an editable format that can be modified without limits
• Variable fonts — They’re infinitely customizable
• Color fonts — Explore gorgeous color variations and gradients that are built into the font

BRILLIANT COLORS AND GRADIENTS
• Point gradients — Drag and drop colors to create dynamic blends of diffused colors
• 20+ color books — Use industry-standard color swatches or incorporate your own

SEAMLESS MOVEMENT BETWEEN DEVICES AND APPS
• File syncing between Illustrator on the desktop and on the iPad — Projects are automatically synced and accessible across devices
• Photoshop import — Easily place a Photoshop image into your Illustrator design
• Standard file format export — Create, save, and open Illustrator (AI) files with no loss of quality, and export in the most common formats, including SVG, PDF, PNG, and PSD.

KEEPING TABS ON THE LATEST CREATIVE TRENDS
• Livestreaming — Watch and learn from top design-industry creatives daily, right within the app
• Trends to discover — Explore projects by other creatives

it.name: Night Vision - LiDAR Camera
it.d:
Night Vision is an app that enables photo and video capture in complete darkness, leveraging the LiDAR scanner and TrueDepth camera technology on iPhone and iPad. Unlike other night vision apps, it uses the device's built-in depth sensors to scan the surroundings, delivering genuine night vision imagery that far surpasses the simulated effects of standard camera filters.

Features:
- Multiple camera modes: Freely switch between LiDAR, TrueDepth sensor, and standard camera modes for dark exploration, close-up viewing, and everyday shooting
- Imaging Mode: Switch between 2D Plane, 3D Spatial, and Object Outlines to view depth in the way that best fits the scene
- Photo and video capture: Take LiDAR night vision photos or record LiDAR night vision videos with one tap, then save them to the system Photos library
- 3D Night Vision: Visualize spatial structure through point cloud imaging, with support for rotating and zooming to inspect 3D outlines in the dark
- Distance measurement: Measure the distance between the target and your device in real time to better understand object position and spatial depth
- Live streaming: Stream the night vision view in real time to Apple Watch, phones, tablets, and computers so you can monitor the scene anytime

How It Works:
In well-lit environments, the app combines imaging from the rear standard camera with LiDAR/TrueDepth sensors to enhance image quality.
In complete darkness, only the LiDAR scanner or TrueDepth camera is used to generate images, ensuring clear night vision without the need for external light.

Supported Devices:
Compatible with all iPhones and iPads equipped with a LiDAR scanner or Face ID.

it.name: Lumra - Vintage Film Camera
it.d:
Lumra — Vintage Camera Looks, Film Effects & Analog-Inspired Photos

Capture nostalgia without carrying extra gear. Lumra is an iPhone photography app built around camera-inspired looks and a focused editing pipeline: pick a preset that behaves like a specific era of hardware, optionally stack subtle film-style effects and lens treatments, then shoot new photos or import from your library and get the same processing every time, so your feed stays cohesive whether you are on the street or curating old shots.

AUTHENTIC CAMERA PRESETS (NOT GENERIC FILTERS)
Lumra ships with a curated set of distinct camera personalities, each tuned for a different mood, not one-size-fits-all “vintage.” Choose the washed warmth of 90s Disposable, dramatic shadows and cinematic contrast with Moody Dark, cool metallic clarity with Silvr, a clean neutral baseline with Clean Film, or crisp early-digital character with Digi Cam. Your chosen preset persists across app launches and camera switches, so your creative direction stays locked in.

STACKABLE “FILM ROOM” EFFECTS UP TO TWO AT ONCE
Go beyond color grading with tactile finishing touches you can mix deliberately: Heavy Grain for chunky analog texture; an orange Time Stamp overlay with date and time in a classic digicam-inspired style; cinematic Light Leaks; and natural-looking Lens Flare. Lumra lets you combine up to two effects at a time, perfect when you want grain plus a timestamp, or leaks paired with grain, without overwhelming the image.

LENS CONTROLS FOR POLISHED FINISH
Refine exposure and character with single-select lens modes: an ND Filter–style treatment that smooths bright highlights and balances contrast for a softer daylight snapshot feel; and a Prism look that introduces subtle spectral separation and gentle ghosting, ideal for portraits, backlight, and golden-hour scenes, without turning your photo into a glitch experiment.

POWERFUL, SIMPLE WORKFLOW
Use familiar camera controls flash, timer, aspect ratio, front/back camera, white balance, plus helpers like grid and level, then review shots in a gallery built for browsing: fullscreen viewing, pinch-to-zoom, intuitive dismissal gestures, and filter-by-camera organization so you can see each “roll” separately. Import lets you run Lumra’s pipeline on existing photos so imports match what you shoot live, Ideal for travel dumps, parties, and outfit shots you want to grade consistently.

LUMRA PRO,  EXPAND YOUR TOOLKIT
Lumra Pro unlocks premium camera presets (Clean Film, Digi Cam, etc) plus advanced finishing tools (Light Leaks, Lens Flare, ND Filter, Prism). Heavy Grain and Time Stamp remain available without Pro so everyone can build a recognizable aesthetic before upgrading.

WHO IT’S FOR
Creators chasing Y2K digicam vibes, disposable film nostalgia, moody cinematic portraits, soft daylight snapshots, and curated social feeds without juggling separate editor apps after every capture.

WHY LUMRA
Processing is tuned for performance on device, with a streamlined UI that stays out of your way so you spend less time menu-diving and more time shooting. Whether you call it a retro camera app, film aesthetic editor, or analog-style photo filter, Lumra is built for photographers who want character, consistency, and control preset by preset, effect by effect, lens by lens.

Download Lumra and give your camera roll a timeless signature—starting from the first shutter tap.

Lumy is a modern sun tracker + outdoor activity planner.

- Perfect lighting for photos or videos? Done.
- Sunrise hike or sunset walk? Easy.
- Outdoor yoga or sunlight breaks? Covered.

Whether you’re chasing golden hour* or keeping an eye on moon phases for a night under the stars, Lumy helps you make the most of natural light.

Now redesigned from the ground up - Lumy feels more personal, purposeful, and in sync with how we live. 

Introducing Modes: Switch between profiles like Daily, Photography, or Meditation to shape Lumy around your routine. See only what matters to you.

Lumy also supports iOS’s State of Mind feature, offering sunlight suggestions based on your mood entries in the Health app - a gentle nudge to step out and connect with nature.

And with weather forecasts for the next seven days, you can plan with confidence. Lumy calculates all sun and moon data entirely on-device. No tracking. No server calls. Only the weather needs internet.

Lumy works seamlessly across iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and HomePod. One purchase, full family access.

Features
- Modes: Switch profiles based on your needs... from weekday planning to weekend golden hour.
- Sun + Moon Tracking: Accurate data, solar compass, and future predictions.
- Season Info: Both astronomical and meteorological seasons.
- Remainders: Custom repeatable notifications.
- Apple Watch: Complications, Double-tap, and Live Activities.
- Widgets + Control Center: Quick access via Smart Stack and more.
- Interaction Upgrades: Time travel slider, Quick Access Button, fluid animations.
- Visual Feel: Simulated light, shimmering glows, and enhanced Classic visuals.
- Accessibility: VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, and more.
- Privacy First: Fully offline (except weather). Your data stays with you.
- Localization: Available in Japanese, Chinese, French, and German.

Lumy helps photographers, outdoor lovers, and wellness seekers stay in sync with the sun and moon.

*What's Golden Hour?
Golden Hour (or Magic Hour) is the short time after sunrise or before sunset when the light is soft, warm, and perfect for capturing stunning photos or videos.

Sun Information Available:
Sunrise, Sunset, First Light, Last Light, Golden Hour, Blue Hour, Astronomical Twilight, Nautical Twilight, Civil Twilight, Solar Noon, Solar Midnight.

Moon Information Available:
Moonrise, Moonset, Altitude, Azimuth, Transit, Transit Elevation, Weekly Moon Phase, Next Full Moon, New Moon, First Quarter, Last Quarter.

Got feedback or suggestions? We’d love to hear from you! Reach out at hello@waplestuff.com.

- Kitchen 
- Bedroom

name: mood
desc: mood.camera IPA is the iOS installation file of a photography app designed to create visually expressive and mo

it.name: mood.camera
it.d:
mood.camera is a point-and-shoot camera that captures natural photos full of character, straight out of your iPhone, without any editing. Instead of chasing ever-sharper and perfectly exposed images, mood.camera focuses on making photography fun and giving your photographs soul.

The custom image processing pipeline gives you photos with realistic film grain, cinematic halation and a rich colour palette. mood.camera also has no live "filter" preview or editing tools within the app, encouraging you to enjoy taking photos without worrying about flipping between effects or making the perfect edit.

mood.camera wasn't built to evoke nostalgia, it was built to bring character and serendipity back to the mobile photography experience.

—
“This Camera App Gives Your iPhone Photos Soul.” - New York Times

"It’s Hard to Believe the Photos From Mood.Camera’s New Portrait Mode Were Shot on iPhone" - PetaPixel

"mood.camera emulates the feeling of taking photos on camera film" - Tech Radar
—

TRY FOR 7 DAYS FREE
Please note, mood.camera is not free. We offer a 7-day unrestricted free trial for new users, no subscription required. After your trial you can continue to use the app for free but you will be limited to the “random” emulation mode. To continue using the full version of the app after your trial period you can either purchase a lifetime membership or pay a monthly subscription.

EXPRESSIVE COLOUR EMULATION
Each of the 14 colour emulations have been meticulously crafted to give every photo character and a rich colour palette.

FILMIC DYNAMIC RANGE
Naturally compressed shadows and highlights create images with more contrast, more atmosphere, and a look that feels closer to film.

REALISTIC FILM GRAIN
Film grain algorithms modelled on the physical development process, add texture and physicality to your photos whilst retaining detail.

CUSTOM PRESETS
Add a touch of warmth to your favourite preset, or start from scratch to create an original style.

NEXT LEVEL PORTRAITS
Combined with mood.camera's filmic characteristics, portrait mode gives you photos with smoother object separation and convincing bokeh. (Available on iPhone 11 or newer).

DOUBLE EXPOSURE MODE
7 unique ways to blend photos unlocks new creative possibilities with your photography. 

CINEMATIC HALATION
Using the iPhone’s  dynamic range gain map to accurately identify the brightest highlights, creating a realistic halation effect. (Available on iPhone 12 or newer).

CUSTOM FRAMES
Elevate your photos with a custom frame, automatically added when you snap a photo.

LESS TWEAKING, MORE SNAPPING
Mirroring the classic film camera experience, there is no live preview of your selected film, letting you focus on capturing the moment instead of flipping between filters. After each capture, the element of suspense as you reveal the processed photo is another nod to the analog experience.

INTUITIVE CONTROLS FOR CREATIVITY
At its core, mood.camera is designed to echo the ease of use of a point-and-shoot camera but retains some controls to inspire creativity and personal expression:

it.name: Pearla Verana - Pro Camera
it.d:
Pearla Verana IV is a professional camera app built for photographers and
filmmakers who need complete control and high-quality results.

Every image starts from the same device-calibrated foundation. RealHUE 2
calibrates color for your specific iPhone, and the Pearla Wide Gamut working
space sits behind Log, RAW, HDR, film emulation and custom profiles, so color
is stabilized before the image is shaped, and the result holds through grading,
finishing and delivery.

PearlaRAW captures 14-bit RAW stills and records 14-bit RAW video internally on
every supported iPhone. Burst at up to 25 fps in 14-bit RAW or 40 fps in 12-bit
RAW with pre-capture, or use the intervalometer across any capture pipeline.
Shutter Priority mode locks your shutter speed while ISO adjusts continuously.

Pearla's film emulation engine adds luminance-aware grain and halation in real
time up to 4K60, with detailed tonal control and custom recipes designed to
replicate the look and feel of classic film stocks. For Log capture, Pearla
supports Apple Log 2, S-Log3, LogC3, C-Log3, F-Log/F-Log2, V-Log, N-Log, L-Log,
D-Log, I-Log and Blackmagic Film Gen 5, with waveform and false color
monitoring and tone mapping controls.

A built-in RAW editor lets you grade RAW photos and video shot in Pearla and
export to Photos or Files as Log or as finished deliverables. Photo and video
settings stay separate, external drives and HDMI output are supported, and
files are directly accessible through the built-in media manager.

For many shoots, Pearla's real-time audio mixing replaces the external
microphone. Dialogue lifts clear of the scene at capture, on the iPhone's own
mics. It is non-destructive, so you can always adjust to your liking or pull
the original audio.

Pearla also includes a speech-activated teleprompter, customizable presets on
custom buttons, a customizable Quick Menu, remote capture from a second iPhone,
and Tilta Nucleus-M support.

Whether you're shooting for a client, documenting everyday life, or building a
personal archive, Pearla is designed to support a focused, intentional creative
process.

Subscription pricing and terms:
A subscription is required to use Pearla.
Pearla offers an auto-renewing yearly subscription to provide you with
unlimited access to all features while you maintain an active subscription.

Pearla requires an iPhone device running iOS 18 or later.

Turn your old, blurry photos into high resolution using the advanced AI photo enhancer with just one tap! PhotoApp uses AI technology to unblur, restore, and enhance your photos.
With PhotoApp, you can easily improve photo quality, sharpen blurry images, enhance resolution, and restore old photos in HD.

-------- Key Features --------

【 Enhance Photo Quality 】
Many people ask, “How can I enhance photo quality?”
With PhotoApp's AI Photo Enhancer, you can improve photo quality and clarity with just one tap. You can also enhance recently taken photos for clearer details and better resolution.

【 Fix Blurry Photos 】
Many people ask, “How can I make a picture less blurry?”
PhotoApp helps you sharpen portraits, selfies, and group photos with AI. Reduce blur, improve details, and make out-of-focus pictures clearer with just one tap.

【 Realistic AI Photos 】
Create realistic AI photos inspired by your own images. Explore different looks and generate high-quality portraits in just a few minutes.

【 Improve Photo Resolution 】
Improve the resolution of your photos and upscale your pictures to HD quality.

【 Colorize and Restore Old Pictures 】
Add color to old black-and-white photos with just one tap. Enhance faded or blurry pictures, improve their clarity, and colorize them to give old memories a refreshed look.

【 Remove Objects 】
Remove unwanted objects, people, or other distractions from your photos in just a few simple steps.

-------- Other Features --------

- Remove Background from Images and Photos
- Turn Photos into Cartoon Effects
- Sharpen and Enhance Images
- Restore Old Photos
- Improve Photo Resolution

We continuously improve PhotoApp and its AI tools to provide a smoother experience, along with new features and improvements.

We value your feedback! If you have suggestions or feedback to make PhotoApp better, we'd love to hear from you. Don't hesitate to contact us at info@photoapp.org

it.name: PicTrace®: AR Drawing & Sketch
it.d:
PicTrace: AR Drawing & Sketch is your ultimate companion for trace & draw enthusiasts, offering an immersive experience in AR tracing. This app lets you turn any photo or sample into an outline that you can trace, perfecting your skills and creating stunning artworks with ease.

Features:
1. AR Drawing, draw with Camera: Immerse yourself in the world of AR drawing with real-time projections on your drawing surface. Whether it's a real sketch or a fun doodle, our app makes it simple and enjoyable.
2. Turn Photos into Real Sketches: We've added a powerful new feature that allows you to transform any photo into a trace sketch outline. This is perfect for those who want to create detailed, real sketches with precision.
3. Sketch Templates: Explore a wide array of sketch templates from animals to vehicles, Manga to Anime, and more. These templates are perfect for practicing and perfecting your trace drawing technique.
4. Instantly Find and Trace Anything: Import photo from your camrera or gallery or browser. Once you find something inspiring, you can instantly convert it into a traceable sketch and start drawing right away.
5. Capture the Process with Video Recording: Document your creative journey by recording your AR Draw Sketch sessions. This feature allows you to revisit your process or share it with others, providing a unique way to showcase your artistic evolution.
6. Save and Share: Once you've finished your trace to sketch creation, save it to your gallery or share it on social media. Show off your sketch trace to family and friends with just a few taps.


PicTrace: AR Drawing & Sketch is more than just an app; it's your gateway to mastering the art of tracing and sketching. With our newly added features—Turn Photos into Real Sketches and Instantly Find and Trace Anything—your creative possibilities are endless. Whether you're creating a detailed real sketch or a simple outline, our app provides the tools you need to bring your drawings to life with AR tracing.


Download PicTrace: AR Drawing & Sketch today and start your creative journey!

- Experience the best in AR tracing with our cutting-edge technology.
- Transform photos into artistic masterpieces with trace to sketch functionality.
- Create beautiful trace drawings effortlessly using AR draw sketch.
- Perfect your skills with a wide range of sketch templates.

With PicTrace: AR Drawing & Sketch, your creativity knows no bounds. Sketch trace with ease, and explore the world of AR drawing with this powerful app.

Download now and unleash your creativity like never before!

it.name: Safety Photo+Video Pro
it.d:
Safety Photo+Video Pro is the paid edition of our private photo and video vault for iPhone and iPad.

Keep personal photos, private videos, documents, and other sensitive media separate from your everyday photo library. Protect your vault with flexible locking options, add passwords to individual albums, and use a separate decoy vault for extra privacy.

HIDE & LOCK PRIVATE PHOTOS AND VIDEOS

• Keep selected photos and videos in a dedicated private vault  
• Unlock with Face ID, Touch ID, PIN, pattern, or combination lock where supported  
• Automatically lock the vault when the app is closed or inactive  
• Keep private media separate from your everyday photo library  

PROTECT INDIVIDUAL ALBUMS

Add another layer of privacy inside your vault.

• Create and organize private albums  
• Set separate passwords for individual albums  
• Move, rename, import, and export media  
• Mark important photos and videos as favorites  

SEPARATE DECOY ACCESS

Set a different password that opens a separate decoy vault while your main private library remains behind its own access controls.

PRIVATE CAPTURE

Take photos and videos directly inside Safety Photo+Video Pro and keep private captures separate from your public photo library.

OPTIONAL ZERO-KNOWLEDGE CLOUD BACKUP

Cloud backup is optional and may require a separate subscription or purchase.

When enabled:

• Supported backup content is encrypted on your device before upload  
• Access to the protected backup requires the password or recovery information controlled by you  
• Safety Photo+Video support cannot decrypt your zero-knowledge backup without those user-controlled credentials  
• Restore a compatible completed backup when moving to another supported device  

Cloud backup, local vault storage, and iCloud features are separate storage options and may use different security, synchronization, and recovery mechanisms.

MANAGE YOUR PRIVATE MEDIA

• View photos and play videos inside the vault  
• Import existing photos and videos  
• Organize private albums  
• Capture photos and videos directly inside the app  
• Transfer files through a browser on your local Wi-Fi network  
• Move, rename, export, and manage private media  

WHY CHOOSE SAFETY PHOTO+VIDEO PRO?

Safety Photo+Video Pro gives you the paid-upfront edition of our private vault experience, while optional cloud and synchronization services remain available separately where offered.

Use it for:

• Personal and family photos  
• Private videos  
• Identity documents and scans  
• Sensitive work media  
• Media stored on a shared device  
• Private libraries that need additional backup protection  

YOUR PRIVATE MEDIA. YOUR CONTROL.

Hide and lock what you want to keep private. Add encrypted backup only when you need it.

it.name: Auto Video Blur - Filtering
it.d:
Auto Video Blur is an iPhone app that uses AI to automatically detect faces, eyes, mouths, people (full body) and text in your videos, then blurs or pixelates them. Just pick a video and tap what to hide, with no need to mark areas frame by frame. Blur kids' faces, censor strangers who wander into the shot, and hide name tags or addresses before posting to social media or video sites.

The core features are free. All detection and editing happens on your iPhone, and your videos are never uploaded to a server. Saved videos have no logo or watermark.

GREAT FOR
• Blurring other kids' faces in videos from field day or a dance recital before sharing them online
• Blurring the faces of people who prefer not to be shown (Pro)
• Blurring strangers' faces in travel vlogs and street footage
• Hiding text caught on camera, like name tags, house numbers, addresses, license plates and signs
• Hiding names and messages in screen recordings
• Blurring only the background so people stand out (Pro)
• Covering faces with cute emoji stickers

KEY FEATURES

■ What the AI detects automatically
• Face
• Eyes (cover just the eyes)
• Mouth
• People (full body)
• Text (signs, license plates, on-screen text)
• All (apply a filter to the whole video)
Detection runs on every frame, so the blur follows its target even when people or the camera move.

■ Choose People to Hide
Blur selected faces and keep others visible. Confirm the same person in other scenes as needed. Scenes awaiting review keep all detected faces blurred. Try selection and preview for free; saving requires Pro.

■ 30 ways to hide (filters)
Pixelate, Blur, Sparkle, Monochrome, Motion H, Motion V, Motion D, Zoom, Crystallize, Hexagonal, Triangle, Pointillize, Halftone, Dither, CRT, VHS, Holo, Sketch, Painting, Woodcut, Edges, Rain Glass, Liquid, Prism, Chromatic Aberration, Double, Saturation, Sepia, Posterize, Duotone. Adjust the strength with a slider.

■ Stickers that follow faces (49 types)
Besides black or white squares, hide faces with emoji like smiling faces, sunglasses, animals and hearts. Stickers move with each face, and you can resize them.

■ Manually select blur area
Drag on the preview to draw a box, and that area stays hidden from start to finish. A handy backup for anything auto-detection misses.

■ Fine-tuning
• Padding: enlarge the hidden area so nothing peeks out
• Edge blur: soften the border of the hidden area
• Invert area: hide everything except what was detected (Pro)
• Multiple targets at once, e.g. faces and text together (Pro)

■ Editing and saving
• Trim: keep only the part you need
• Audio on/off
• Quality: 720p / 1080p / 4K (4K is Pro). Never exported above the original resolution.
• File type: MOV / MP4 (MP4 is Pro)
• Recording date and location are removed when you save (Keep date & location is Pro)
• Import from Photos or the Files app / iCloud Drive
• On iOS 26 or later, exporting continues even if you switch apps while saving

FREE VS. PRO EDITION

EDIT VIDEO WITH AI

No menu hunting — tell CutStory by voice or in chat what you want: "add music to the whole video", "add transitions", "cut this video into one-minute clips", "make it ready for TikTok". The AI assistant understands 113 editing commands and runs them on your timeline.

A FULL VIDEO EDITOR
