it.name: Da Vinci Eye: AR Trace & Draw
it.d:
As seen on Shark Tank and featured in Apple's Apps We Love, Watercolor Artist Magazine, Handmade Seller Magazine, LifeHacker, MakeUseOf, Fast Company (Innovation Award winner), Apple News and more!

Da Vinci Eye is used by millions of creatives from painters to bakers to make incredible artwork. The app is not just for tracing, it offers a wide range of drawing tools, lessons, daily drawing prompts, and a supportive community to share your artwork!

IMPORTANT!: Please read how this app works below and the device requirements for AR Mode BEFORE purchasing.

HIGHLIGHTS

• Create incredible artwork from your own photos
• Make hyper-realistic drawings with our strobe feature
• Record time-lapse videos of your drawings
• Separate images into layers by color value, then view those areas on your canvas
• Easily learn the fundamentals of drawing
• Breakdown any image into step-by-step instructions
• Video tutorials
• Use filters to make drawing even easier
• Zoom in to capture micro details in your drawings
• Connect with our community to share your artwork
• Insanely fast customer support!

PERFECT FOR ANY ARTIST

• Bakers
• Cartoonists
• Tattoo Artists
• Illustrators
• Fiverr Designers
• Hobbyists
• Makeup artists
• Nail Technicians
• Animators

No matter what skill level you’re at — Da Vinci Eye is here for you!

OVERVIEW

How many times have you been drawing a portrait for hours only to realize that the nose or the eye is in the wrong place? You can use Da Vinci Eye to layout artwork before you begin or even check your work as you progress.

Having a hard time seeing where lights or darks go? Breakdown images into layers by color value. Then virtually project those layers on top of your image. You can see exactly where to place the darkest darks, mid-tones, and highlights.

CAN'T THINK OF WHAT TO DRAW?

Check out our inspiration section for user uploaded reference photos. If you have a great pic, you can even upload your own content for other artists to draw.

LEARNING HOW TO DRAW?

We have lessons using our unique patent-pending learning method. You can also turn ANY photo into a step by step shading drawing lesson.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

Based on a tool that has been used by artists for centuries, this app is a digital version of a Camera Lucida.

You suspend your iPhone or iPad above or in front of your canvas with a stand, tall glass, or other objects easily found around your house. 

When you look through your phone, you will see both the image and the canvas simultaneously. It's similar in functionality to an art projector or light box, but with the ability to do so much more.

You can draw on any surface, zoom in to draw micro details in your drawing, and you don't have to draw in the dark.

WILL THIS HELP ME LEARN HOW TO DRAW?

Using Da Vinci Eye, you will be training your eye to recognize proportions and draw with shading while training your hand to translate precise lines and strokes on paper. You’ll learn faster and more efficiently using our proven techniques compared to any other app.

AR MODE REQUIREMENTS

To use AR mode, you must have an A10x or A11 processor and above. We recommend using:

– iPhone 8 and newer (iPhone 7 and below will not work)
– iPad Mini 5th Generation and newer
– iPad Air 2019 and newer
– iPad Pro 3rd Gen (Any pro made after 2018) and newer

AR & CLASSIC MODE

AR mode anchors your image to an object in the real world. This lets you move your canvas or phone, and the drawing and projected image will stay aligned.

Classic mode is like a normal art projector, where if you move your phone or canvas, the drawing will no longer be aligned.

AR mode is especially useful for drawing or painting on an easel. However, in most cases, Classic mode will achieve the same result.

TAKE YOUR DRAWING TO THE NEXT LEVEL

Download Da Vinci Eye today! No one ever regretted sharpening their drawing skills.

it.name: Final Cut Camera
it.d:
Final Cut Camera puts you in the director’s chair with intuitive pro controls for your entire video production. Seamlessly start a Live Multicam session by connecting up to four devices running Final Cut Camera to preview, record, and sync your video angles in Final Cut Pro for iPad. Capture with powerful settings including shutter speed, ISO, white balance, and manual focus. Easily customize your resolution, frame rate, color space, and more. Quickly monitor your video with focus peaking and overexposure indicators. Dial in the perfect shot for your professional videos with Final Cut Camera.

Capture professional footage with full manual control
• Easily record in a range of resolutions, frame rates, and codecs including ProRes and Apple Log*
• Capture ProRes RAW in open gate for full-frame resolution and incredible editing performance**
• Set your exposure with ISO and shutter speed controls
• Adjust your white balance using presets or set a custom color temperature
• Pull focus to follow the action and keep subjects sharp
• Enable timecode options including Time of Day, Record Run, or external timecode

• Flexibly frame your shot in portrait or landscape with the Center Stage front camera without moving your iPhone***
• Record with Spatial Audio for videos with even more immersive sound****
• Reduce shakiness and movement during capture by enabling stabilization
• Lock orientation to ensure your framing is consistent regardless of device position

Preview, record, and sync up to four devices with Live Multicam in Final Cut Pro for iPad
• Quickly start a Live Multicam session by connecting your device to Final Cut Pro for iPad*****
• Remotely preview, adjust pro controls, and initiate recording on all your connected devices right in Final Cut Pro
• Instantly edit your multicam clips with preview media that is automatically synced in the Final Cut Pro browser
• Save time in post with background media transfer that seamlessly replaces preview media with originals as you work

Confirm videos look and sound perfect with powerful monitoring tools
• Level videos with tilt and roll indicators or crosshairs for overhead shots
• Preview your Apple Log video in SDR or HDR by applying the Apple Log LUT*
• Enable focus peaking to ensure footage looks sharp
• Properly expose videos using zebra indicators
• Frame your shot with aspect ratio guides or grid overlays
• Monitor available recording time and audio meters

Easily review and transfer media right in the browser
• Save videos to Files or record onto a connected external storage device*
• Browse and review your footage directly in the Final Cut Camera browser
• Quickly connect to Final Cut Pro for iPad and transfer media directly into a project
• Conveniently pause and resume media transfers

Upgrading to the latest iOS or iPadOS is recommended
* Requires iPhone 15 Pro or later
** Requires iPhone 17 Pro or later
*** Requires iPhone 17 or later or iPhone Air
**** Requires iPhone 16 or later
***** Requires Apple Creator Studio subscription

desc:
Better photos start before the shutter.

Point Framed at any scene and choose how you frame it. Tap scan and Framed reads the light, the subject and the composition, then finds the shot worth taking. Or draw your own frame around what caught your eye. Either way, Framed guides you into it: where to move, how far to…

it.name: Framed - Take Aesthetic Photos
it.d:
Better photos start before the shutter.

Point Framed at any scene and choose how you frame it. Tap scan and Framed reads the light, the subject and the composition, then finds the shot worth taking. Or draw your own frame around what caught your eye. Either way, Framed guides you into it: where to move, how far to zoom, when to shoot.

Then make it yours, with a full editor, film looks and frames, all on the photo you actually took.

FIND THE SHOT
- Auto frame: one tap scans the scene and finds the best composition, with framing, zoom, exposure and angle.
- Your frame: tap the viewfinder and draw the shot you want. Framed guides you to it the same way.
- Adjust either one: resize or move the frame before you shoot.
- Live tracking: the frame stays on your subject as you move, and the shutter lights up when you're lined up.

SHOOT LIKE A PRO
- RAW capture on iPhone Pro models.
- Manual shutter, ISO, flash control, and exposure compensation.
- Shoot in 3:4, 4:5, 1:1 or 9:16.

DEVELOP IT
- Film looks, each one a starting point you can take apart and adjust.
- Light: exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites, blacks, fade, temperature and tint.
- Color: HSL mixer, color grading, curves and calibration.
- Effects: grain, halation, glow, light leaks, scratches, dust, motion and vignette.

FINISH IT
- Frames: Plain, White, Paper, Black, Negative, and Specs, which prints the lens and settings you shot with.
- A date stamp from the day you took it.

KEEP IT
- Your Framed library keeps every edit, so you can come back and change it, from the RAW.
- Import from Photos, save back to your camera roll, or share straight to Instagram.

Point. Shoot. Develop.

Google Photos is the home for all your photos and videos. Easily store, edit, organize, and search your memories with the help of Google AI.

• PRINT YOUR FAVORITE MOMENTS:
From your phone, to your home. Turn your favorite memories into photo books, photo prints, canvas wall art and more. Price varies by product. Printing services available in the US, EU, UK, and CA only.


• GOOGLE LENS: Search what you see. This preview enables you to identify text and objects in your photos to learn more and take action.

PicCollage - the app that lets you create anything to celebrate everything!

With PicCollage, you can turn your photos and videos into memories you want to save and share. Whether you’re looking to flex your creativity with a freestyle collage, stitch together a photo dump of your adventures, or create a quick card for a birthday. PicCollage is the perfect app for the job. Plus, you can even add videos to your collages and create video collages and slideshows that will make your friends and family say, “OMG, where’d you get that?”

It's easy, fun, and completely free. Start right now and create your first collage or card!

PicCollage at a glance
- Create collages, cards and much more
- Edit photos and videos easily - filter, cutout, retouch
- Use ready-to-use layouts, grids & animated templates
- Personalize with fonts, stickers and doodles
- Get VIP access for unlimited creativity

Try PicCollage now! Our free starter pack is full of new stickers to help you edit photos and videos, create collages and design cards instantly.

CREATE COLLAGES, DESIGN CARDS AND MORE
You can let your creativity run wild! Whether you want to make a freestyle collage, create a picture collection, or design a card for a birthday, PicCollage offers you the perfect solution!

EDIT VIDEOS AND PHOTOS - CUT, FILTER, RETOUCH
You can personalize any creations to make your photo and video fit perfectly into your collages with features like cutouts, doodles and animations, and even add videos to your collages to create stunning video collages and slideshows. Enhance your creations by adding pages and save them as a video or slideshow.

USE TEMPLATES OR CREATE FREESTYLE
You can use a grid, or animated template to create unique cards for any occasion. Add frames around your photos and spice up your collage with fun animations. Our new AI-powered highlight detection keeps the focus of the photo front and center. Of course, you can also design in freestyle mode.

REMOVE BACKGROUNDS WITH AI
With our cutout tool, you can easily remove the background from a photo to isolate people and pets! But our cutout tool isn’t just a background eraser, it also has fun designs that let you cut photos into stars, hearts, squares and more. We’re always updating this feature to give you the sharpest finish possible.

CHOOSE FROM A VARIETY OF FONTS
Add more fun to your collage with text! We offer a variety of fonts for you to choose from, from handwritten to formal. If you want something special, explore our curved text editor to effortlessly display your text in a rounded arc, circle, around your photos, or in other creative ways. AI-powered font pairing in our speedy suggested layouts mode will take your designs to the next level.

ADD BACKGROUNDS AND STICKERS
Thanks to our worldwide collaboration with famous artists and illustrators, PicCollage offers you thousands of exclusive backgrounds and stickers. Add a background to your photos and collages and embellish everything with trendy stickers!

PERSONALIZE WITH DOODLES
To add a personal touch to your collage, card or slideshow, you can create your own drawings and doodles. This is the perfect way to add the finishing touch to your creation.

USE TEMPLATES FOR YOUR INSTAGRAM STORY
Whenever you're on Insta and want to create impressive posts, try our templates. Create an Instagram story or reel and share it directly with your followers!

PICCOLLAGE VIP
PicCollage VIP is a subscription that offers advanced features and removes watermarks and ads. With the 7-day trial version, you can test it for free! As a VIP, you get access to thousands of stickers and backgrounds, as well as exclusive fonts and layouts.

Get the PicCollage photo and video editor and let your memories shine!

it.name: Picsew - Screenshot Stitching
it.d:
An App Store Editors’ Choice app, also recommended by MacStories and TidBITS.

More than screenshot stitching. Picsew brings scrollshots and photo stitching together in one focused, flexible workspace.

Turn chats, articles, receipts, webpages, notes, and comment threads into clean scrollshots. Then use the same app to arrange travel photos, recipes, outfits, tutorials, product comparisons, before-and-after stories, and social posts into polished vertical or horizontal images.

Whether you are saving something for later or creating something worth sharing, Picsew helps you move from a folder full of images to one finished piece—without tedious cropping, manual alignment, or switching between several apps.

SCROLLSHOTS WITHOUT THE BUSYWORK
• Scroll through content in any app and Picsew turns it into one complete scrollshot.
• Save an entire webpage in one step when you need the full article, guide, receipt, or order page.
• Select existing screenshots and let Picsew detect the overlapping areas and stitch them automatically.
• Fine-tune every join yourself when a complex layout needs a more precise result.
• Keep long conversations, research, instructions, and reference material together instead of scattered across your photo library.

TURN PHOTOS INTO A STORY
• Arrange photos vertically for a long-form post, step-by-step tutorial, travel diary, recipe, or product showcase.
• Join photos horizontally for comparisons, panoramas, timelines, and before-and-after presentations.
• Combine screenshots and regular photos in the same project when your story needs both context and visuals.
• Work with up to 300 images at once and keep the finished result in high resolution.

MAKE EVERY IMAGE READY TO SHARE
• Hide names, faces, account details, addresses, and other private information with blur or mosaic.
• Add text, arrows, shapes, annotations, watermarks, and borders to explain what matters.
• Place screenshots inside polished device mockups for presentations, portfolios, app updates, and social media.
• Adjust the result before export so you can share a finished image instead of sending it through another editor.

EXPORT IT YOUR WAY
• Save a high-resolution image when quality matters.
• Export as PDF for documents, instructions, archives, and easy sharing.
• Split an extra-long image into neatly sized slices for social platforms and messaging apps.

Picsew fits into the way you already work. Open it from the Share Sheet, jump in from a widget, and navigate with VoiceOver. From a quick scrollshot to a carefully arranged photo story, the tools you need stay together in one app.

it.name: Razr - Street Camera
it.d:
Razr is an iPhone camera for street and travel photography, combining film-inspired color, Snap Focus and reusable recipes. Preview your look before the shot, save your settings as a recipe, and choose RAW when you want more room to edit.

From a morning walk to a busy night market, build a shooting setup around the scenes you notice. Explore a different color palette, prepare a focus distance, or return to a saved recipe as you find your own approach to photography.

Take a familiar route with a new look, and give ordinary moments a different perspective.

SEE YOUR LOOK BEFORE THE SHOT
Choose a film-inspired look and adjust its intensity directly in the viewfinder. See how the palette works with the scene in front of you, then fine-tune it before pressing the shutter. Keep the effect subtle or give the photograph a strong color direction.

Shape the texture and glow with separate grain, halation, and bloom controls. Pair a gentle look with daylight, add atmosphere to bright lights, or create a treatment for an entire series of photographs.

BRING YOUR OWN COLOR
Import compatible .cube LUTs to extend your color library. Use a palette you already enjoy or explore a new look for a particular location. Adjust the strength to suit the light and subject instead of treating every frame the same way.

MAKE RECIPES YOU WILL USE AGAIN
Combine a LUT with your preferred effects, give the combination a name, and save it as a recipe. Build one for afternoon walks, another for night scenes, or a signature look for a trip. Return to the combination without rebuilding every slider setting.

Share a recipe as a card so you can show others the look and settings behind your photograph. Your recipes keep creative choices close at hand while you concentrate on framing the next shot.

SET FOCUS BEFORE THE MOMENT
Snap Focus lets you choose a focus distance before you shoot. Prepare for a subject passing through a doorway, a person approaching a patch of light, or a scene you are waiting to unfold.

Lens calibration helps refine the distance setting for your device. Choose a distance that suits your subject and composition; the result still depends on the lens, light, and where your subject stands.

MAKE COLOR PART OF THE STORY
Try a warm palette for afternoon light or a softer look for quieter scenes. Use LUT intensity to balance the treatment with the colors already in your frame. Watch how your chosen look affects skin tones, bright areas, and shadows, then save a combination you would like to use again.

CHOOSE A PHOTOGRAPHIC STARTING POINT
Use Standard for a neutral base, explore Negative or Positive for a different color response, or choose a black-and-white profile. Work with gentle tones or stronger monochrome contrast to suit shapes, shadows, architecture, and portraits.

These image profiles give developed photos a starting character. Combine your choices thoughtfully, using the viewfinder to judge the scene as you compose.

KEEP ROOM FOR THE EDIT
Capture HEIF or JPEG for a developed image, or select RAW DNG and Apple ProRAW on supported devices for later editing. Choose the format around how you plan to use the photograph, from sharing a finished frame to refining exposure and color afterward.

LAYER TWO MOMENTS
Explore double exposure with Lighten and Darken blending. Combine a silhouette with texture, place light across a shadow, or bring two compositions into one photograph. Experiment with the relationship between the layers to find a result that feels your own.

ACCESS AND COMPATIBILITY
Some features require a paid upgrade. Yearly subscription and lifetime purchase options are available; see the app for current local pricing and included features. Capture formats and controls vary by device, lens, and iOS version. Apple ProRAW requires a compatible device.

MORE THAN JUST A PRETTY FACE

it.name: Televise: TV & Movie Tracker
it.d:
Track every show and film in one place. Get notified the moment new episodes air — and when the movies on your watchlist hit release. Build watchlists that tell you exactly what to watch next, right from your home screen. Rank finales, rate films, follow friends, and finally close the loop on everything you started.

Televise is a TV show, anime and movie tracker for everything you watch — across every streaming service, in one app. It's powered by TVDB, so even the obscure titles other trackers don't have are covered.

The next episode awaits.

WHAT TELEVISE DOES

- Track shows, episodes and films watched across every streaming service
- Films, done right - tracked separately from your shows, with half-star ratings, reviews and per-film discussion
- Rewatch anything - mark an episode or film more than once and keep the full history of every watch
- A watchlist that tells you exactly what to play next
- Home-screen widget - check and mark your next episode without opening the app
- Weekly calendar of upcoming episodes - plus film release countdowns - for everything you follow
- Push notifications the moment new episodes drop
- See where every show is streaming
- Rank your shows - build tier lists, rate finales and films, write reviews
- Discuss episodes and films, react, and vote for your favourite characters (no spoilers, real opinions)
- Follow friends and see what they're tracking, rating and reviewing in your feed
- Translate any comment or review into your language - on-device and private
- Discover trending and recommended shows and films worth your time
- Roll the Dice to randomise what to watch from your unwatched watchlist
- Custom lists for favorites, holiday rewatches, comfort shows
- Make it yours - pick a custom poster or backdrop for any show or film
- Import your watch history, films, comments and character votes from other tracking apps - TV Time, Trakt, Letterboxd and IMDb
- Streak tracking, watch stats, heatmaps and achievements
- Built for TV, anime and film fans - handles anime titles in both original and English

Televise is free to use.

TELEVISE PLUS

A one-time purchase - no subscription. Unlock:

- Deep stats - lifetime watch history, hours watched, genre breakdowns, and separate film stats
- Export your lifetime stats as a shareable card
- Unlimited custom lists (free includes up to three)
- Alternate app icons

Buy once, keep it forever.

Its flexible layer system allows you to combine the charm of hand-drawn traditional animation with keyframes that automatically animate layer properties over time. With a library full of beautiful, blazing-fast and fully customizable pixel and vector brushes, animatable effects, a smudge tool, animated text and vector shapes, bones with inverse kinematics, video and audio layers, camera movements, symbols and many more features, ToonSquid makes it easy to bring your vision to life.

Traditional Animation
- Create hand-drawn frame-by-frame animations
- Control how long you want to show each drawing in the timeline
- Draw in resolutions of up to 4k

Keyframe Animation
- Add keyframes to automatically animate layer and effects properties over time
- Choose from an extensive list of customizable easing curve presets to create organic motion between keyframes
- Easily loop your keyframe animation

Powerful Layer System
- Define the order and length of each element in your animation using layers and drawings and a flexible timeline
- Organize your layers into groups for a clean workflow or to animate multiple layers at once
- Use the camera layer to quickly define the visible portion of your animation in the export
- Mask layers to other layers, even when their contents are animated
- Choose from 27 industry-standard layer blend modes for beautiful compositing effects

Fully-customizable Brushes
- Draw gorgeous brush strokes with ToonSquid's state-of-the-art digital brush engine
- Take full advantage of Apple Pencil's pressure and tilt sensitivity and the iPad Pro's 120Hz display for lag-free drawing
- Use vector brushes to create brush strokes that are sharp at every zoom level
- Edit the 60+ brush settings and import custom textures to create a brush library that is perfectly tailored to your art style
- Blend your strokes together using the smudge tool
- Draw in a variety of styles such as sketching, inking, wet mixing, pixel art, and more
- Export and share your custom brushes with others
- Import your existing library of Adobe® Photoshop® brushes

Vector Shapes
- Create custom shapes using the path tool by placing and editing each curve control point
- Quickly add common vector shapes from the shape library
- Import SVG files
- Fill and stroke your shapes with beautiful gradients and edit them directly on the canvas
- Animate the visible length of a path using its trim properties

Animatable Effects
- Create character rigs using bones and add inverse kinematics constraints
- Create custom meshes to deform pixel layers when they are part of a bone rig
- Animate perspective and warp effects
- Apply adjustments, blur, pixelation, drop shadow, chroma key, halftone, parallax and more effects

Efficient symbol workflow
- Split your animation into separate clips that you can then reuse multiple times using symbols
- Make edits to an animation clip and immediately see the changes in all of its symbol instances
- Use frame markers to speed up your lip-syncing workflow

Text
- Add text layers and animate their appearance
- Import your favorite fonts

Color
- Use ToonSquid's powerful color picker with plenty of different interfaces to choose the exact colors you need
- Create custom color palettes and share them outside the application
- Pick colors straight from the canvas using the pipette tool
- Fill connected regions quickly with the fill tool

Audio and Video
- Add audio clips to your timeline and perform lip-syncing animations
- Import videos, GIFs and images into your project and work with them through symbols

Transform
- Animate a layer's position, rotation and scale properties using keyframes
- Build transform hierarchies to achieve more advanced movements
- Edit your layer's motion path directly on the canvas

Numerous Export Formats
- Export your work in one of many common file formats such as MP4, MOV, GIF, PNG, JPEG, PSD, and more.

it.name: Web Video Cast | Browser to TV
it.d:
Web Video Caster® allows you to watch on your TV videos from your favorite websites including movies, TV shows, live streams of news, sports.

SUPPORTED STREAMING DEVICES

Web Video Caster® supports the most popular streaming devices, allowing your TV to stream videos directly from the web.

• Google Cast (Chromecast, Android TV, Chromecast built-in)
• DLNA devices like Xbox, Samsung TVs, LG TVs, etc. 
• Roku, Roku stick and Roku TVs
• Apple TV 4
• Fire TV and Fire TV stick
• PlayStation 4 - by using its web browser
• Most web browsers by visiting http://cast2tv.app (PS4, Smart TVs, other consoles and set top boxes)


*If you experience a compatibility issues, contact us and include the brand and model number.

SUPPORTED MEDIA

• HLS live streams in M3U8 format (Chromecast, most DLNA devices lack support for it)
• Authenticated videos including movies and TV shows
• MP4 videos
• Live news and sports
• Any HTML5 videos*


*Your streaming device must be capable of decoding the video you are playing. Web Video Caster doesn't perform any video/audio decoding or transcoding.

HOW IT WORKS

Web Video Cast™ is a browser, which allows you to stream videos of movies, TV shows, and other media from the internet to a streaming device or smart tv. Web Video Caster grabs the video URL inside the web page, sends it to the streaming device (i.e. Chromecast or DLNA device), and then plays the video directly from the content provider. This ultimately saves your mobile device’s battery. It also detects subtitles on the web page. Web Video Cast™ does not host these videos. This is not a mirroring app.


GET STARTED

Follow these simple step-by-step instructions to start streaming:

1. Find a video online that you want to watch.

2. Make sure this video can play on mobile browsers without Flash.

3. Connect to your streaming device.

4. Play the video as you normally would. Or, click the play button on the toolbar.

PREMIUM FEATURES**

• No in-app advertising
• Most visited sites
• Bookmarks
• Set homepage

**This functionality does not apply universally to all streaming devices. 

LIMITATIONS & DISCLOSURES

As with all apps, there are some limitations we are aware of and want you to know about up front.

• We are in no way associated with any web media providers and we do not have control over the content they provide.
• Web Video Caster does not support nor play Flash or FLV videos.
• The app does not support tab casting, like the Chromecast extension for the PC web browser.
• We cannot do anything to fix issues that arise on the server side (media content provider) such as failure to play or buffering, which is especially common during heavy load times and weekends.


SHARE YOUR FEEDBACK

We are committed to open communication with our users. Please contact us first with any questions or support issues before leaving a review. We will respond and address your concern promptly. Contact us through our website http://www.webvideocaster.com/contactForm

it.name: AerioTV

AerioTV is a native IPTV streaming application for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and macOS (using the iPad app). It connects to your own server via Dispatcharr API, Xtream Codes, and/or M3U playlists to deliver live TV, movies, and series with a full electronic program guide (supplied by user).

Features:

Live TV

Stream live channels with MPV-powered playback. Browse channels in a scrollable list or a full EPG guide view (iPadOS, tvOS, and macOS) with program titles, descriptions, and time slots. Minimize playback to a picture-in-picture style mini player while browsing other content.

Electronic Program Guide

tvOS supports grid and list views while iOS supports list view for viewing channels and programs. Program data is cached locally and configurable from 6 hours to the full available window.

Movies and Series

Browse and filter on-demand content by category. Categories are pulled from the server's VOD library and can be toggled on or off through the filter menu.

iCloud Sync

Server configurations and preferences sync across devices using iCloud Key-Value Storage. Set up once on one Apple device and your subsequent Apple devices will pick up the same servers automatically if you select to import during the onboarding process.

Apple TV Optimized

Full support for the Siri Remote with directional navigation, focus management, and context menus. The guide view extends edge to edge and text is sized for the living room viewing distance.
Supported Server Types

it.name: TikTok - Videos, Shop & LIVE
it.d:
TikTok is the global discovery platform for videos, streaming on LIVE, shopping, and more. Our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. Over a billion people come to TikTok to share what they love, learn new things, and find ideas that make everyday life more interesting.

Your experience on TikTok is built around what you're into, not who you know. Just watch, like, and scroll to discover videos, creators, and communities you are delighted to discover. From quick recipes to game highlights, fashion tips to music and trending sounds, your For You feed reflects your current interests and changes based on what surprises and inspires you.

Creating is simple. Capture and post everyday moments and turn them into something special with easy editing tools, effects, sounds, and music. Use our free library of sounds and music in your videos, plus filters and creative tools that help your content stand out. On TikTok, anyone can create, and ideas that inspire pick up momentum.

TikTok is also where discovery becomes part of your everyday life. Find creators to follow, new ideas to try, and products you will love from small businesses and brands around the world. TikTok offers more than 50 preset safety and privacy features, from private accounts and content filters to screen time tools and Family Pairing, so you can choose an experience that works for you. TikTok provides extra support for teens and families on the app, letting you set time and content preferences that feel right for your family. 

■ Personalized discovery
A For You feed that learns what you enjoy. Discover videos, creators, LIVE streams, shopping, and communities based on what you watch, like, and share.
■ Entertainment, learning, and everything in between
Comedy, gaming, DIY, beauty, sports, music, lifestyle, education, and more. Find content that makes you laugh, think, and try something new.
■ Simple, powerful creation tools
Record in clips, pause and resume, trim and merge, add text and stickers, and fine tune your video without leaving the app.
■ Sounds, music, and effects
Use our free library of sounds and music in your videos, plus filters, effects, and creative tools that help you express yourself and make your videos stand out.
■ A global community of creators
Follow your favorite creators and discover new voices every day. Share your own story or support the people who inspire you.
■ Discover and shop with TikTok Shop
Explore trending products, exclusive deals, and seamless shopping experiences inspired by creators and brands you love, all in one place. Shop directly from videos, LIVE, and the Shop tab, track your orders, and enjoy a safe, secure shopping experience.
■ Go LIVE and connect in real time
Start a LIVE to chat with your community, share moments as they happen, and unlock special features and benefits where available.
■ Tools to shape your experience
Use more than 50 safety and privacy features, from private accounts and content filters to screen time tools, Family Pairing, and other controls, to choose how TikTok works for you and your family.

Ready to see what you discover next? Download TikTok to start watching, creating, and exploring your world in a new way.

Clone your voice in seconds. Then make it speak, sing, and star in lifelike videos — all from your phone.

Clony is the AI voice studio that turns 30 seconds of audio into your own expressive voice model, ready to speak any text, cover any song, and bring any photo to life as a talking video. Built with state-of-the-art voice AI, wrapped in a very-simple workflow: record, tap, create.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

VOICE CLONING
Upload a voice memo, a recording, or an audio file — Clony builds a natural, high-fidelity voice clone in under a minute.

TEXT TO SPEECH
Type anything, pick a voice, and hear it read aloud. Multilingual support, punctuation-aware pacing, studio-quality output.

TALKING VIDEOS
Drop in a photo, choose an audio memo, and watch the face come alive with synced lips and natural expressions. Powered by our brand-new AI video model.

AI SINGING & COVERS
Train a singer from a vocal sample, then have your voice cover any track. From radio hits to your own demos — ready in minutes.

SPEECH-TO-SPEECH
Record yourself saying anything. Clony repeats it in the cloned voice, preserving tone, rhythm, and emotion.

WHY CLONY

• 30-second clones — fast, accurate, lifelike
• Works in 20+ languages
• Shareable audio and video, ready for social

PERFECT FOR

• Content creators building voiceovers at scale
• Podcasters filling gaps without a mic session
• Musicians experimenting with vocal covers
• Anyone who wants to hear a photo speak — or make a funny birthday greeting video

RESPONSIBLE USE

Clony is built for creators. Only clone voices you own or have explicit permission to use. We do not allow impersonation, fraud, or voices of public figures without consent. Misuse results in a permanent ban.

SUBSCRIPTION (auto-renewable)

The Clony Subscription unlocks unlimited voice memos, longer clips, higher character limits, AI singing/covers and the creation of AI talking videos. Plans are billed monthly and auto-renew unless cancelled 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

it.name: DreamPlayer - Video Player
it.d:
DreamPlayer — the video player for your entire collection.

Plays virtually any video and audio file you throw at it — MKV, MP4, TS, AVI,
WebM and more, with hardware decoding and a buttery native refresh rate.

AUDIO THAT JUST PLAYS
DTS, DTS-HD MA, TrueHD (incl. Atmos), E-AC3 JOC, AC3, FLAC, AAC. No codec hunting.

YOUR FILES, WHERE THEY ARE
• Local: Files app, SD card, USB — add any folder to Your Library
• NAS / Network: SMB, WebDAV, Jellyfin/Emby, FTP/SFTP, UPnP/DLNA, or direct http(s) URL
• iPad: Files "Open with", bookmarked folders, WebDAV/Jellyfin/SMB
• TMDB posters, backdrops, cast, trailers, season/episode stills — cached offline

PLAYER THAT STAYS OUT OF THE WAY
• Gestures: brightness, volume, horizontal seek
• Subtitles: embedded + sideloaded (SRT, ASS, VTT, TTML, SAMI, MPL2)
• Continue watching, watched marks, Picture-in-Picture, background audio

LIBRARY, NOT A FILE BROWSER
Add folders once — DreamPlayer groups series, fetches TMDB metadata and keeps
resume state. Pull to refresh, manual groups, per-episode details.

PRIVACY & NO ACCOUNT
Passwords stored in Keychain, never logged. No login required — core playback
and all sources work free, connections are only to servers you own.

it.name: Final Cut Camera
it.d:
Final Cut Camera puts you in the director’s chair with intuitive pro controls for your entire video production. Seamlessly start a Live Multicam session by connecting up to four devices running Final Cut Camera to preview, record, and sync your video angles in Final Cut Pro for iPad. Capture with powerful settings including shutter speed, ISO, white balance, and manual focus. Easily customize your resolution, frame rate, color space, and more. Quickly monitor your video with focus peaking and overexposure indicators. Dial in the perfect shot for your professional videos with Final Cut Camera.

Capture professional footage with full manual control
• Easily record in a range of resolutions, frame rates, and codecs including ProRes and Apple Log*
• Capture ProRes RAW in open gate for full-frame resolution and incredible editing performance**
• Set your exposure with ISO and shutter speed controls
• Adjust your white balance using presets or set a custom color temperature
• Pull focus to follow the action and keep subjects sharp
• Enable timecode options including Time of Day, Record Run, or external timecode
• Genlock multiple video sources with precise frame alignment using a compatible sync generator**
• Flexibly frame your shot in portrait or landscape with the Center Stage front camera without moving your iPhone***
• Record with Spatial Audio for videos with even more immersive sound****
• Reduce shakiness and movement during capture by enabling stabilization
• Lock orientation to ensure your framing is consistent regardless of device position

Preview, record, and sync up to four devices with Live Multicam in Final Cut Pro for iPad
• Quickly start a Live Multicam session by connecting your device to Final Cut Pro for iPad*****
• Remotely preview, adjust pro controls, and initiate recording on all your connected devices right in Final Cut Pro
• Instantly edit your multicam clips with preview media that is automatically synced in the Final Cut Pro browser
• Save time in post with background media transfer that seamlessly replaces preview media with originals as you work

Confirm videos look and sound perfect with powerful monitoring tools
• Level videos with tilt and roll indicators or crosshairs for overhead shots
• Preview your Apple Log video in SDR or HDR by applying the Apple Log LUT*
• Enable focus peaking to ensure footage looks sharp
• Properly expose videos using zebra indicators
• Frame your shot with aspect ratio guides or grid overlays
• Monitor available recording time and audio meters

Easily review and transfer media right in the browser
• Save videos to Files or record onto a connected external storage device*
• Browse and review your footage directly in the Final Cut Camera browser
• Quickly connect to Final Cut Pro for iPad and transfer media directly into a project
• Conveniently pause and resume media transfers

Upgrading to the latest iOS or iPadOS is recommended
* Requires iPhone 15 Pro or later
** Requires iPhone 17 Pro or later
*** Requires iPhone 17 or later or iPhone Air
**** Requires iPhone 16 or later
***** Requires Apple Creator Studio subscription

it.name: LANreader for LANraragi
it.d:
LANreader is a native reader client for LANraragi, built for people who keep their manga and comic archive on a self-hosted server.

Connect to your LANraragi instance, browse your full library, search by tags, organize by categories, and read comfortably on iPhone, iPad, and Apple silicon Mac.

Key features:
- Connect directly to your LANraragi server
- Browse archive covers, titles, progress, and metadata
- Sort your library with the order that matches your workflow
- Search with fast tag autocomplete
- Open categories, favorites, and saved collections
- Read with smooth page navigation, page previews, and progress tracking
- Split wide pages for easier phone reading
- Cache archives for offline reading
- Use optional translation settings with compatible image translation services
- Keep your library private: LANreader does not collect your data

LANreader is for users who already run or plan to run a LANraragi server. Configure your server URL and API key, then use your iPhone or iPad as a focused manga/comic reader for your self-hosted collection.

it.name: LensLink Camera
it.d:
LensLink Camera turns your iPhone or iPad into a camera for OBS Studio. Mount the phone, open the app, and it appears in OBS as a video source over Wi-Fi or a USB cable — with the picture quality the phone's camera is actually capable of.

Picture first
Up to 4K at 60 fps, HEVC or H.264, with 120 and 240 fps available where the camera has them
10-bit HDR (HLG) and Apple Log on supported devices
Balanced or Maximum quality: Maximum finds the most your connection can carry
Every lens, with the Camera app's lens buttons

Controls that stay out of the way
Tap to focus, hold to lock focus and exposure, drag for brightness, pinch to zoom
One tray for exposure, shutter, white balance and focus, with faces-first autofocus
The same controls in a browser panel on your computer, and in OBS itself
Remember camera settings: a shot dialed in once stays dialed-in

Built for production
Remote start: OBS starts the camera while the app sits idle
Tally light: a colored border says when you're on air
Pause with a held picture instead of a frozen frame
Keeps streaming beside other apps on iPads that support it
Automatic lip-sync: the plugin measures latency and aligns your real microphone
Virtual green screen, right on the phone
Mirror your whole screen with app audio
Siri and Shortcuts

Private by design 
Nothing is recorded on the phone, and nothing leaves your local network. No account, no sign-in, no analytics.

Requires OBS Studio and the free, open-source LensLink plugin for Mac, Windows or Linux: https://lenslink.cam

Go Live on Likee to express yourself to the world. Live stream your life and engage with your audience. Show your talents, boost your fan base and receive gifts. You might just be Likee's next Internet Sensation!

it.name: Manatan
it.d:
Turn what you watch and read into active language immersion.

Manatan is an all-in-one video player, manga and comic reader, EPUB reader, dictionary, OCR tool, and study companion for iPhone and iPad. Look up a word the moment you encounter it, capture the sentence that made it memorable, and keep moving through the story.

ONE LIBRARY FOR THE MEDIA YOU LOVE

• Import videos, subtitles, manga, comics, and EPUB books from Files

• Connect Kavita and Komga reading libraries, plus Jellyfin, Emby, and Plex video libraries, using Manatan's native on-device integrations

• Browse, search, filter, and organize the sources you configure from one interface

• Build personal libraries, follow your progress, and download supported media for offline use

WATCH AND LEARN

• Play your own video files with advanced subtitle support

• Tap subtitle words for instant dictionary results without leaving the player

• Adjust subtitle timing and move between lines with precise playback controls

• Find Japanese subtitles through Jimaku when you connect your own account

• Create study cards from a sentence with its audio and visual context

READ MANGA AND COMICS

• Turn text inside a page into selectable words with private, on-device OCR

• Look up dialogue directly over the page and return to reading without breaking focus

• Choose continuous, paged, webtoon, single-page, or double-page layouts

• Organize titles into categories and keep chapter progress together

READ EPUB NOVELS

• Import EPUB books directly from the Files app

• Read in horizontal or vertical Japanese layouts where supported

• Customize themes, fonts, spacing, margins, and navigation

• Select text for immediate dictionary lookup and study-card creation

• Resume exactly where you left off

POWERFUL LANGUAGE TOOLS

• Install dictionaries for the language you are learning

• Use deinflection, frequency information, pitch-accent data, and dictionary audio when available

• Create and review cards with Manatan's study system

• Connect AnkiMobile or AnkiConnect and customize your card fields

• Track manga and video progress with supported tracking services

BUILT FOR IMMERSION

Manatan keeps the player, readers, dictionary, OCR, and study workflow together. There is less app switching, less setup, and more time spent understanding real language in context.

MANATAN MEMBERSHIP

Manatan is free to download and includes core reading and playback features. Optional monthly memberships are offered in six tiers: Stone (5,000 service credits), Crystal (9,000), Emerald (20,000), Sapphire (32,500), Ruby (70,000), and Diamond (150,000). All tiers use the same StoreKit 2 purchase, restore, verification, account-linking, and subscription-change flow. Membership unlocks paid service features and supporter/profile benefits; higher tiers provide more monthly service credits and benefits.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID when the purchase is confirmed. Membership renews automatically each month unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple subscription settings.

Manatan does not provide or sell a catalog of commercial media. Connect only services you are permitted to access, and import or download only media you own or are authorized to use.

Privacy Policy: https://manatan.com/privacy

it.name: Moonfin
it.d:
Moonfin brings your Jellyfin and Emby experience to iOS, MacOS, and tvOS in one polished app.

Whether you’re on the couch or on the go, Moonfin makes it easy to browse, stream, and manage your personal media library with a fast, modern interface built for every screen size.

To use Moonfin, you’ll need your own Jellyfin or Emby server.

With Moonfin, you can:

• Watch movies, shows, and music from your personal library
• Use one app across tvOS and mobile
• Download media for offline playback
• Browse and play Live TV and DVR content (server setup required)
• Watch trailers directly in the app
• Request new content with Seerr integration
• Connect multiple servers and browse them in one place
• Customize your home screen, navigation, and playback behavior
• Sync compatible settings across devices with the Moonfin plugin
• Use advanced playback controls for subtitles, audio tracks, and more

Moonfin is a third-party client built with love for the Jellyfin and Emby communities.

name: PicStrip
desc:
Blur faces and text in photos and videos, and remove the hidden location, device and date before you share. Free and on your device: no account, no ads, no tracking.

Share the moment, not the story behind it. PicStrip finds what a photo or video gives away — faces, phone numbers, email addresses, card numbers, QR…

it.name: PicStrip: Blur Faces in Video
it.d:
Blur faces and text in photos and videos, and remove the hidden location, device and date before you share. Free and on your device: no account, no ads, no tracking.

Share the moment, not the story behind it. PicStrip finds what a photo or video gives away — faces, phone numbers, email addresses, card numbers, QR codes, where it was taken and the device that took it — and helps you cover or remove it before you share. Processing happens on your iPhone or iPad.

VIDEOS, COVERED AS THEY MOVE
Record with PicStrip's camera or pick a video — or many, to clean them all at once. PicStrip finds faces, text, codes and your Always Cover words, follows them frame by frame and covers them: faces with a strong blur, a solid box or an emoji you choose. Draw a box around anything else — a person, a car, a screen, a sign — and it is tracked forwards and back. A video-editor timeline shows every cover and sound edit as a clip you can trim; select a stretch of sound to bleep or mute it. The preview is drawn the way the copy is saved, and the copy leaves without its location, device and dates.

RECORD WITHOUT COMPROMISE
One camera for photos, video and documents. Video mode records like the Camera app: 4K or HD, 24 to 120 fps, HDR, enhanced stabilization, every lens with pinch to zoom, focus and exposure, the flashlight, and the volume buttons or Camera Control to start and stop. Recordings go straight to cleaning and are never saved to your library as they are.

SEE IT BEFORE YOU SHOOT
Photo mode's live viewfinder outlines and names what it would redact, with its match strength, and can preview the result. After capture, the photo gets a full scan and review.

REVIEW BEFORE YOU SHARE
Scan for faces, barcodes, contact details, financial identifiers and common developer secrets. Review match strength and scan status, then decide what to cover. Name suggestions depend on Apple Intelligence and are not covered automatically.

MAKE THE COPY YOURS
Draw a box, or tap an object on iOS 27, then move and resize it with accessible controls. Choose solid, crosshatch, pixelate, blur or an emoji, with colors, strength and undo/redo. Solid coverage is recommended for secrets: blur and pixelation can leave details recognizable. Leave the last digits of a card or phone number showing if you like, and compare with the original before sharing. Add words to Always Cover — your name, a plate, your street — and they are covered wherever PicStrip reads them.

REMOVE HIDDEN DETAILS
Review location, camera, date, caption and device metadata. Choose what to remove and check the output. Export PNG, JPEG, HEIC or a supported source format, with a visible file size. Sharing presets help choose a format for photos, screenshots and documents. Keep a Live Photo's motion when nothing in it is covered.

MORE WAYS IN
Try the fictional built-in sample. Pick photos and videos — one or many, or just your screenshots — scan a document, browse Files, paste or drag and drop. Clean many photos and videos at once with a shared policy, use the Share Extension, or start from Shortcuts — the background action removes metadata only.

ON-DEVICE PRIVACY
No account, ads, tracking, subscriptions or developer photo server. An optional object-selection model on supported systems may download from Apple after you agree. Importing from cloud providers, saving to a synced library, and sharing to an app you choose follow those services' settings. Protected temporary files are cleaned up as described in the privacy policy. PicStrip is open source, with verifiable build provenance for published releases.

Automatic detection can miss details, and covering what it finds does not make anyone anonymous. Always review the whole photo or video before sharing.

it.name: Pixel Pals Widget Pet Game

Pixel Pals is an incredible app for customizing your Home Screen and Lock Screen, as well as Live Activities, allowing you to place adorable pets called Pixel Pals that you can customize and enjoy as you swipe through your apps or unlock your phone, making each interaction just that much happier!

They're beautiful pixel art renditions of animals, a nostalgic art style that's really delightful to take in.

Pixel Pals includes a variety of animals for you to customize and enjoy:

- Dog (named Rupert)
- Cat (named Hugo)
- Hedgehog (named Chortley)
- Fox (named Finnegan)
- Axolotl (named Mochi)
- Otter (named Nugget)
- Bat (named Fu-Fu)
- Parrot (named Kiwi)
- Tiger (named Herbert)
- Platypus (named Penny)
- Panda (named Poe)
- Raccoon (named Oliver)
- Butterfly (named Freya)
- T-Rex (named Rory)
- Bunny (named Thumper)
- Red Panda (named Bao)
- Pet Rock (named Dwayne)
- Penguin (named Bubbles)

You can also change any of the names!

The dog and cat are included for all, and Pixel Pals Premium includes the other pals, as well as the option to pin two animals at once for supported devices.

This app offers subscriptions for "Pixel Pals Premium". They're available (in United States pricing) for $1.49 monthly or $9.99 yearly. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period (and charged to your iTunes account). You can turn off auto-renew/manage subscriptions in your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. it.d:
App of the Year winner Procreate Pocket is the most feature-packed and versatile art app ever designed for iPhone. 

Procreate Pocket has everything you need to create expressive sketches, rich paintings, gorgeous illustrations, and beautiful animations. Offering hundreds of handmade brushes, a suite of intuitive artistic tools, an advanced layer system, and the powerful Valkyrie graphics engine. Work on the couch, on the train, at the beach, or while waiting in line for coffee. 

It’s a complete art studio in the palm of your hand.

Highlights:
• High resolution canvases — up to 16k by 4k on compatible devices
• Intuitive Dark Mode interface made for iPhone
• Revolutionary QuickShape feature for perfect shapes
• Smooth and responsive smudge sampling
• Powered by Valkyrie, the lightning-fast 64-bit painting engine 
• Create art in stunning 64-bit color
• 250 levels of undo and redo
• Continuous auto-save — never lose work again

Breakthrough brushes:
• Packed with 100s of beautifully crafted brushes
• Brush sets keep your painting, sketching, and drawing brushes organized
• Over 100 customizable settings for every brush
• Brush Studio — design custom brushes
• Import and export custom Procreate brushes
• Import Adobe® Photoshop® brushes, and run them faster than Photoshop®

Full-featured layering system:
• Layer your art for precise control over details and composition
• Create Layer and Clipping Masks for non-destructive editing
• Stay organized by combining layers into groups
• Transform objects simultaneously across multiple layers
• Access over 25 layer blend modes for industry-grade compositing

Color without compromise:
• Fill your line work with ColorDrop
• Disc, Classic, Harmony, Value, and Palette color panels
• Import color profiles for color matching
• Assign Color Dynamics to any brush

Precision design tools:
• Add vector text to your illustrations
• Easily import all your favorite fonts
• Crop and resize your canvas for perfect composition
• Perspective, isometric, 2D, and symmetry visual guides
• Drawing Assist perfects your strokes in real time
• StreamLine smooths your strokes for beautiful lettering and expert inking

Animation Assist: 
• Easy frame-by-frame animation with customizable onion skinning
• Create storyboards, GIFs, animatics, and simple animations
• Export your animations in the full resolution of your canvas

 Dramatic finishing effects:
• Gradient Map — remap your image’s colors with a customizable gradient
• Glitch, Chromatic Aberration, Glow, and Halftone to add new dimensions to your work
• Gaussian and Motion Blur filters for depth and movement, or use Sharpen for perfect clarity
• Advanced Noise filter gives you more control for a classic, retro look
• Adjust Hue, Saturation, or Brightness in real time
• Powerful image adjustments including Color Balance, Curves, and HSB
• Bring your art to life with the fun, intuitive, and creative Warp, Symmetry, and Liquify Dynamics 

Time-lapse replay:
• Relive your creative journey with Procreate's celebrated Time-lapse Replay
• Export your Time-lapse recording in 4K for high-end video production
• Share a short, 30-second version of your Time-lapse on your socials

Reference Companion:
• Keep a full canvas or reference image with you at all times 
• Paint on your face with AR
• Color-pick right from the reference window

Import assets and share your creations:
• Import or export your art as Adobe® Photoshop® PSD files
• Import Adobe® ASE and ACO Color Palettes
• Import images files such as JPG, PNG, and TIFF
• Drag and drop artworks, brushes, palettes, and fonts between applications• Export to AirDrop, iCloud Drive, Photos, iTunes, Dropbox, Google Drive, Facebook, X (formerly Twitter), Instagram, TikTok, Weibo, Mail, and more
• Share your art as PDF, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, GIF, HEVC, or MP4 files

* Safe Lock - Private Photo Vault: The Ultimate Photo Hiding App and Gallery Lock *

Looking for a reliable solution to protect your personal photos and videos?

Safe Lock - Private Photo Vault, the most secure and private app in the App Store. With features like PIN-code, Touch ID, Face ID, DotLock, numeric, or alphabetic passwords, this app ensures your hidden photo album remains locked and inaccessible to prying eyes.

Safe Lock - Private Photo Vault offers a secret folders where you can securely store your private photos, videos and notes. Capture new pictures using the built-in hidden camera within the app and instantly add them to your locked photo album. We do not have access to your secrets, photos and videos are saved only on your device.

Discover of Safe Lock - Private Photo Vault:

/Protect Your Memories/: Safeguard your private photo and video memories with our secret folders.

/Secure Important Photos, Videos/: Keep copies of essential documents, such as driving license, passports, ID, and bank cards, protected from unauthorized access.

/Plan Surprises and Gifts/: Use the app to plan surprises and keep gift ideas securely tucked away. Store and organize essential notes with ease, knowing they are kept safe within  Safe Lock - Private Photo Vault.

Key App Features:

/Multiple Lock Options/: Choose from a range of secure locks including PIN-code, DotLock, Numeric, Alphabetic, Passcode, Touch ID, and Face ID to ensure privacy for your hidden photo vault.

/Innovative Locking Methods/: Take advantage of unique gestures like shaking or flipping to instantly lock your photos and hide app.

/Hidden Photo Camera/: Capture photos discreetly within the app using the secret camera with a zoom option, allowing you to add exclusive content to your hidden photo vault.

/Easy Data Management/: Transfer files through WiFi or easily export/import from popular Cloud platforms like Dropbox, Google Drive, Yandex.Disk, iCloud, and Box.

/Slideshow and Sharing/: Showcase your secret photos and videos with a stunning slideshow and easily export or import them to/from your Photo Roll, Email, or any Cloud platform.

/Anti-Theft Measures/: Receive break-in reports with photos, empowering you to take swift action if any unauthorized access attempts occur.

/Additional Features/: Benefit from GIF and PDF support, customize your app icon, jot down secret notes, enjoy dark mode support, and use the fake password feature that opens a fake gallery for added security.

Download  Safe Lock - Private Photo Vault today and experience the peace of mind that comes with keeping your personal photos and videos secure. Your memories deserve the utmost protection.

+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

/Premium Subscription/

Premium subscription unlocks all features to manage your personal content within Safe Lock. Also app includes number of cool features such as seven different patterns of locks, Touch ID, immediate lock button, extra security features for the internal albums, on the go photo camera and etc.

No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.

Restore Your Memories with SHARP AI – The Ultimate AI Photo Editor and Enhancer App
Turn back the clock on your old, blurry, or damaged photos with SHARP AI! Whether a faded childhood memory or a pixelated selfie, our state-of-the-art AI technology transforms any image into a stunning, enhanced, restored high-resolution masterpiece in just one tap.

Why SHARP AI is a Must-Have

Reshoot Your Photos: Fix a weak look using your favorite selfie. 
Easily boost your portrait photos by switching your face to a better facial expression with our advanced AI!
Enhance your photos with a single tap!

Improve image resolution smartly with AI enhancer for sharper, detailed photos in a click.

Magically add elements to photos:
Effortlessly remove or add elements to your photos with smart fill precision for seamless AI edits.

Exciting Features

SHARP AI is constantly evolving, and new features are on the horizon! Get ready to experience even more ways to fix, restore, and enhance your cherished photos.

- Enhance Overall Photo Quality: Instantly upgrade any low-resolution or pixelated photo into a crystal-clear image.
- Perfect Selfies and Portraits: Achieve flawless facial details and smoother skin textures on all your pictures.
- Erase Objects and Repair Damage: Restore old or damaged photos by removing imperfections and objects.
- Expanded Horizons: Go beyond your photo’s edges with AI technology for a seamless, high-quality visual enhancement.
- Digitize Physical Prints: Scan your favorite printed photos and enhance them digitally for safekeeping.
- Witness Stunning Before & After Comparisons: See the incredible difference our AI makes, side by side.
- Customizable AI Enhancements: Control your results with an option to activate or deactivate AI facial enhancements.

Your memories deserve to shine, and SHARP AI is here to make it happen.

Simple and Flexible Subscription Plans
Choose a plan that works for you:
Weekly Plan: Perfect for short-term projects or quick fixes.
Yearly Plan: Ideal for long-term use and the best value for photo enthusiasts.
Hassle-Free Payment and Cancellation
Cancel Anytime: Manage your subscription directly through your account settings.
Seamless Auto-Renewal: Subscriptions automatically renew at the end of the billing period, unless canceled 24 hours before.
Transparent Charges: Subscription fees are charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase.
No Refunds for Unused Periods: Free trials are forfeited upon purchasing a subscription.

We Value Your Feedback
We’re always striving to improve! Have suggestions or questions? Contact us at iOS.support@loopsie.it.

Read Our Policies
Terms & Conditions: https://bit.ly/2PWcXgi
Privacy Policy: https://www.iubenda.com/privacy-policy/8126812

Download SHARP AI now and experience the magic of photo restoration and enhancement like never before!

it.name: SmartShot Camera
it.d:
Set it down. Join the shot.

No timer to set and no sprint back to the group. Prop up your iPhone, iPad or Mac, press the shutter once and walk into the picture. SmartShot takes the photo when everyone is in place, settled and looking, and keeps shooting while you pose.

NO TIMER NEEDED
• Press once, then take your time getting into the shot
• With the back camera, it waits for you to step in

IT KNOWS WHEN YOU'RE READY
• Watches every face: in position, holding still, looking at the camera
• Live hints show who's still looking away, moving or blinking
• Takes the photo on a frame where nobody is mid-blink

KEEP POSING
• A new photo every time the group settles again, until you press stop
• Change poses as much as you like, then pick your favourite

FULL QUALITY
• HEIF or ProRAW at up to 48 MP, as your device allows
• Zoom buttons, pinch to zoom, tap to focus and exposure, flash
• Front and back cameras; on Mac, any built-in or external camera

A PHOTOS VIEWER YOU ALREADY KNOW
• Swipe, pinch and double-tap through your shots
• Info, favourites, share the original, hide and delete
• Non-destructive editor: exposure, contrast, saturation, warmth, crop, straighten, rotate and flip

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Faces are analysed on your device and never leave it. No account, no cloud, no tracking.

it.name: TikTok - Videos, Shop & LIVE
it.d:
TikTok is the global discovery platform for videos, streaming on LIVE, shopping, and more. Our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. Over a billion people come to TikTok to share what they love, learn new things, and find ideas that make everyday life more interesting.

Your experience on TikTok is built around what you're into, not who you know. Just watch, like, and scroll to discover videos, creators, and communities you are delighted to discover. From quick recipes to game highlights, fashion tips to music and trending sounds, your For You feed reflects your current interests and changes based on what surprises and inspires you.

Creating is simple. Capture and post everyday moments and turn them into something special with easy editing tools, effects, sounds, and music. Use our free library of sounds and music in your videos, plus filters and creative tools that help your content stand out. On TikTok, anyone can create, and ideas that inspire pick up momentum.

TikTok is also where discovery becomes part of your everyday life. Find creators to follow, new ideas to try, and products you will love from small businesses and brands around the world. TikTok offers more than 50 preset safety and privacy features, from private accounts and content filters to screen time tools and Family Pairing, so you can choose an experience that works for you. TikTok provides extra support for teens and families on the app, letting you set time and content preferences that feel right for your family. 

■ Personalized discovery
A For You feed that learns what you enjoy. Discover videos, creators, LIVE streams, shopping, and communities based on what you watch, like, and share.
■ Entertainment, learning, and everything in between
Comedy, gaming, DIY, beauty, sports, music, lifestyle, education, and more. Find content that makes you laugh, think, and try something new.
■ Simple, powerful creation tools
Record in clips, pause and resume, trim and merge, add text and stickers, and fine tune your video without leaving the app.
■ Sounds, music, and effects
Use our free library of sounds and music in your videos, plus filters, effects, and creative tools that help you express yourself and make your videos stand out.
■ A global community of creators
Follow your favorite creators and discover new voices every day. Share your own story or support the people who inspire you.
■ Discover and shop with TikTok Shop
Explore trending products, exclusive deals, and seamless shopping experiences inspired by creators and brands you love, all in one place. Shop directly from videos, LIVE, and the Shop tab, track your orders, and enjoy a safe, secure shopping experience.
■ Go LIVE and connect in real time
Start a LIVE to chat with your community, share moments as they happen, and unlock special features and benefits where available.
■ Tools to shape your experience
Use more than 50 safety and privacy features, from private accounts and content filters to screen time tools, Family Pairing, and other controls, to choose how TikTok works for you and your family.

Ready to see what you discover next? Download TikTok to start watching, creating, and exploring your world in a new way.

Note: If you subscribe via Apple, payment will be charged to App Store Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the selected plan. Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase.

Learn more about our safety tools, resources, and policies at the TikTok Safety Center: https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en

it.name: Twitch: Live Streaming
it.d:
Twitch is where thousands of communities come together for our favorite streamers, for the games we love, for the lulz, for each other, for whatever. Download Twitch and join millions enjoying live games, music, sports, esports, podcasts, cooking shows, IRL streams, and whatever else crosses our community’s wonderfully absurd minds. We’ll see you in chat.

Here’s a convenient list of other awesome things about Twitch:

Everyone is “about” community. We actually are one: Whatever you nerd out about, you can find your people on Twitch. 
Give support, get support: Find new streamers and subscribe to your favorites. Plus,  unlock exclusive perks for your support. 
Start your own channel: The Twitch app is one of the easiest ways to start streaming. Just create an account, go live directly from the app, and bring people together around whatever you’re passionate about. 
You never know what you’ll find: Popular games are always live, but so are music festivals, rocket launches, street tours of Tokyo, and goat yoga. Yes, really. 
Dark mode: Y’all love this one. Black and purple have never looked this good together.

Twitch's Terms of Service are available at https://www.twitch.tv/p/legal/terms-of-service/
For feedback and assistance, please visit our Support Center: https://help.twitch.tv
 
Please note: This app features Nielsen’s proprietary measurement software which contributes to market research, like Nielsen’s TV Ratings. Please see http://priv-policy.imrworldwide.com/priv/mobile/us/en/optout.html for more information

It can play all your movies, shows and music in most formats directly without conversion.

VLC is completely free and open source.
